title: Manager - Premiere Agency
description:
Designation: Chief Manager


Location: India Maharashtra ABHI One India Bulls


Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Purpose:**

  

To drive recruitment of high\-quality insurance agents through effective planning, execution and governance of the FLS (Front Line Sales) network. The role focuses on building a strong agency workforce, ensuring consistent talent inflow, improving agent productivity, and strengthening the recruitment capability of the field sales team.

**Key Responsibilities:**

 **1\. Recruitment Strategy \& Planning**

* Design and implement a comprehensive recruitment strategy to achieve monthly and annual agent recruitment targets.
* Translate organizational growth objectives into regional and branch\-level recruitment plans.
* Develop FLS capacity and productivity plans to ensure optimal manpower availability for agent recruitment.
* Identify new sourcing channels (referrals, digital, campus, local activations) to broaden recruitment reach.

 **2\. Execution \& Governance**

* Drive FLS hiring effectiveness and ensure each FLS meets agent recruitment productivity norms.
* Monitor recruitment funnel metrics – prospecting, interviews, licensing, and activation – and address drop\-offs.
* Conduct weekly/monthly recruitment reviews with Zonal/Regional/Branch Heads to track performance and action plans.
* Implement recruitment dashboards and MIS for real\-time performance visibility.

 **3\. Capability Building**

* Strengthen recruitment capability of the FLS and Sales Leaders through training, tools, and best practices.
* Partner with L\&D to design and roll out Recruitment Excellence Programs for the sales force.
* Develop recruitment champions and reward high\-performing FLS for consistent agent onboarding.

 **4\. Process Excellence \& Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with IRDAI licensing norms and documentation requirements.
* Drive adherence to recruitment SOPs, background checks, and quality standards for agent onboarding.
* Collaborate with Operations and HR to ensure seamless agent onboarding and activation processes.

 **5\. Analytics \& Insights**

* Use data analytics to forecast recruitment trends, identify underperforming zones, and predict shortfalls.
* Track recruitment cost metrics (cost per agent hired, active agent ratio, etc.) to ensure efficiency.
* Provide strategic insights to leadership for decision\-making and manpower planning.

title: Apprentice
description:
**Who we are looking for**

Our program is designed for Apprentices to gain valuable experiences alongside on\-the\-job training both technically and professionally towards becoming our future leaders and technology experts. You’ll learn from some of the most respected highly qualified people in the industry and be supported by individual mentors and development programs.


The role requires attention to detail and good understanding of coding, design, development of applications and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodologies. Our Apprentices will get an opportunity to work with State Street Technology Services at Hyderabad and Bangalore office locations.


**Why this role is important to us**

Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence, and robotics process automation. We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end\-to\-end, next\-generation financial services company.


Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems, and make your mark on our industry.


**What you will be responsible for**

As an Apprentice you will be:


* Analyzing the business/ technical requirement documents
* Contributing to the application design, development, testing and deployment
* Participating in agile team meetings such as Stand\-up calls and retrospective meetings
* Preparing the technical documentation required for adopted SDLC process.
* Collaborating with various State Street internal teams
* Develop and maintain applications with Java and SQL.
* Functional Testing, Database SQL, Manual TestingReactJS/AngularJS with node
* Presentation Skill, Excel Reporting/PowerBI/Tableau, Communication skill, SharePoint, Power Automate
* Automation QA, Selenium, Java, Python, Rest assured QA Automation
* PowerBI/Tableau, SQL, Data Modelling
* Core Java with strong knowledge of OOPS concepts and Data Structures
* Monitoring Tools \- Splunk/Dynatrace \& Grafana for Presentation/Dashboards

**What we value**

These skills will help you succeed in this role:


* Combination of academic aptitude, analytical capabilities, and excellent communication
* Strong critical thinking, problem solving and decision\-making skills.
* Display a culture of individual ownership of tasks to embed a clear individual sense of accountability in performing the role.
* Ensure that the highest level of the Code of Conduct is displayed in your behavior.
* Support the ‘Risk Excellence’ culture within the business.
* Adhere to limits of delegation and escalation procedures required by your manager so that you comply with internal policies and external regulations.

**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**

* B.Tech/M.Tech/MCA degree or equivalent or related field
* Working knowledge and skills in GUI development with Java middle and databases back\-end to create an end\-to\-end solution desirable.
* Understanding software development lifecycle and software development common practices (code reviews, unit testing etc.)
* Good understanding of SQL performance tuning techniques including query plan understanding and management, SQL tracing, DB stats, indexing techniques etc., highly preferred
* Good in managing and resolving problems on a live production system.
* Candidates must be fresher and available to work on a full\-time basis from Sept 2025\.

**About State Street**

**What we do.** State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data \& analytics, investment research \& trading and investment management to institutional clients.


**Work, Live and Grow.** We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance, and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.


**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.** We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift programs and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.


State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.


Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers


**About State Street**
======================

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

==============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).

* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio

* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.

 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.

* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.

--------------------------------------------------


We are seeking a Talent Acquisition Sourcer to join our Global Talent Acquisition Center of Excellence (COE). This role will support our global hiring needs across all functions on the business. You will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and building strong pipelines of qualified talent across functions such as technology, engineering, and other corporate functions. You will work closely with the recruiters, hiring teams, and HR partners to develop sourcing strategies, conduct talent market research, and build diverse candidate pipelines to support current and future hiring needs globally.  


### **What You'll Do**


* Develop and execute proactive sourcing strategies to identify qualified candidates for career opportunities across multiple business and global regions.

Build and maintain strong candidate relationships to enhance the overall candidate experience and employer brand.

* Bachelor's degree required; professional certifications in HR or talent acquisition is a bonus
* 5\+ Years of experience in full\-cycle (End to End) recruitment.
* Sourcing experience in technology and engineering/operations required \- other business functions preferred \- with proven ability to engage candidates through creative sourcing techniques including LinkedIn, Social media, and other technical sourcing methods such as GitHub, Stack Overflow, and others.

**About the Role**
------------------

  

We’re looking for a high\-energy, organized and people\-friendly HR Executive who wants to build a strong foundation across Talent Acquisition and HR Operations.

  

This is a hands\-on role where you’ll work closely with Plum’s People Team and get exposure to the employee lifecycle—from identifying and coordinating with candidates to onboarding employees and supporting day\-to\-day HR operations.

* Coordinate with employees and internal stakeholders for HR\-related requirements.
* Support exit documentation and separation formalities.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Ability to work with multiple stakeholders and priorities.

title: Manager - Admin
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**
--------------------


This position drives strategic and operational excellence across all BOT VFX facilities and workplace infrastructure. The ideal candidate is a highly organized, process\-driven self\-starter who balances long\-term strategic planning with meticulous daily execution.
Reporting directly to the **Head of Administration and HR**, this role requires a disciplined leader with a coaching mindset to mentor internal teams, enforce service levels, and interface regularly with executive management. The position demands strong financial acumen to drive frugality and cost\-optimization while ensuring absolute operational stability, strict compliance, and seamless cross\-functional coordination.*Note: This position involves regular domestic travel, primarily between the company’s India facilities.***POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------

* **Facility Operations :** Manage multi\-location facility operations, ensuring the in\-house administrative team and service contractors (security, housekeeping, utilities, etc.) flawlessly execute day\-to\-day needs.
* **SOPs \& Training :** Establish, implement, and document standard operating procedures (SOPs) for routine operations. Provide continuous training to in\-house teams and outside contractors to ensure absolute alignment.
* **SLA Enforcement :** Define clear facility service Level Agreements (SLAs) with performance targets. Track metrics systematically and firmly enforce compliance.
* **Employee Satisfaction :** Drives employee satisfaction by ensuring all facility service \& incident tickets are resolved thoroughly, tracked to proper closure, and communicated clearly to the team.
* **Asset Management :** Oversee all non\-IT assets across locations, ensuring rigorous tracking, regular lifecycle audits, and maintenance logs.
* **Lease \& Landlord Management :** Manage office space lease terms and landlord relationships for current properties in close coordination with the Finance team.
* **Space Evaluation :** Support the evaluation of new office space options at the direction of the executive team, including broker engagement, term sheets, LOIs, and basic financial analysis.
* **Fit\-Outs \& Build\-Outs :** Oversee office renovation and fit\-out projects from inception to completion. Hold primary contractors strictly accountable to budgets, quality standards, and timelines while coordinating key updates with the executive team.
* **Utilization Analytics :** Leverage data and dashboards to monitor and report key seat utilization metrics (available, utilized, billable, non\-billable, and cost per seat) to proactively optimize capacity.
* **Financial Acumen \& Budgeting :** Manage annual facility upkeep budgets. Identify and execute cost\-effective measures, vendor rationalization, and cost\-per\-seat benchmarking.
* **Automation :** Drive facility automation and smart building initiatives to reduce manual effort, optimize utility costs, and improve tracking efficiency.
* **Content Security Audits :** Ensure the company strictly adheres to stringent content security audits as they relate to physical security, access control, and visual barriers.
* **Safety \& Compliance :** Implement regular facility audits, risk assessments, and inspections to proactively identify compliance gaps and maintain general workplace safety.
* **Executive Reporting :** Provide regular, structural, data\-driven updates to executive management regarding costs, SLA performance, schedules, and project milestones.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**
-------------------

* **Bachelor’s degree** in Engineering, Management Studies, Business Administration, or a closely related field.
* **10\+ years of experience** related to facility management, corporate operations, or infrastructure support is highly preferred.
* Proven experience **managing facilities** across multiple geographic locations (exposure to creative studios or large corporate offices is an advantage).
* Commercial **real estate management** experience (negotiating leases, analyzing term sheets) is considered a strong plus.
* **Exceptional problem\-solving** skills; focuses on structural prevention over daily firefighting.

description:
**Store Associate / Store Executive**

Company: **Crestview Adventure Hotel \& Resort Pvt. Ltd.**

Department: **Store**

Position: Store Associate / Store Executive

Reports To: Store Manager / Executive Chef / Purchase Manager / Accounts \& Finance, as applicable

Employment Type: Full\-Time

**1\. JOB PURPOSE**

The Store Associate / Store Executive is responsible for the receiving, checking, storing, issuing, recording, and maintaining all hotel and resort inventory in a systematic and controlled manner.

The position ensures that all materials required by different departments are available on time, properly stored, accurately recorded, and protected from damage, wastage, pilferage, or unauthorized use.

The Store Associate / Executive must maintain proper coordination with Purchase, Accounts, Kitchen, Food \& Beverage, Housekeeping, Engineering, Front Office, HR, and other operating departments to ensure smooth hotel operations.

**2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

A. **Receiving of Materials**

Receive all materials delivered to the hotel against approved Purchase Orders, Purchase Requisitions, and delivery documents.

Check the quantity, quality, specifications, brand, packaging, expiry date, and condition of received materials.

Verify received items against the Purchase Order and supplier invoice/challan.

Report any shortage, excess quantity, damaged goods, wrong items, or quality discrepancies immediately to the Store Manager/Purchase Department.

Ensure proper documentation of all inward materials.

Maintain the Goods Received Note (GRN) or applicable receiving records.

B. **Storage \& Inventory Management**

Arrange all materials in their designated storage locations in a clean, organized, and easily identifiable manner.

Follow proper FIFO (First In, First Out) and FEFO (First Expiry, First Out) methods wherever applicable.

Maintain proper segregation of food items, beverages, chemicals, housekeeping supplies, engineering materials, stationery, and other inventory.

Ensure appropriate storage conditions for temperature\-sensitive, perishable, fragile, and chemical items.

Monitor expiry dates and report near\-expiry or slow\-moving stock.

Ensure that storage areas remain clean, dry, hygienic, secure, and pest\-free.

Follow hotel safety, hygiene, and fire\-safety standards.

C. **Issuing of Materials**

Issue materials only against properly authorized Material Requisition / Store Requisition.

Verify the requesting department, item description, quantity, and authorization before issuing materials.

Record every issue accurately in the stock register/system.

Ensure that unauthorized persons do not collect or remove materials from the Store.

Maintain proper departmental issue records for audit and reconciliation purposes.

D. **Stock Control**

Maintain accurate physical and system stock records.

Conduct regular physical stock verification.

Assist in monthly, quarterly, and annual stock\-taking activities.

Identify discrepancies between physical stock and book/system stock.

Immediately report shortages, excess stock, damaged materials, or unexplained variances.

Maintain minimum and maximum stock levels as instructed by management.

Inform the Store Manager/Purchase Department when stock reaches the reorder level.

Monitor slow\-moving, non\-moving, excess, and obsolete inventory.

E. **Documentation \& Records**

Maintain and update relevant records, including:

Purchase Orders

Goods Received Notes (GRN)

Store Requisitions

Material Issue Records

Stock Registers

Bin Cards

Return/Replacement Records

Damage/Breakage Records

Expiry Records

Transfer Records

Physical Stock Verification Reports

Daily/Monthly Store Reports

Other records required by management

F. **Coordination with Departments**

Coordinate with all hotel departments regarding their material requirements.

Ensure timely availability of essential operating supplies.

Communicate stock shortages or expected delays to concerned departments.

Coordinate with Purchase regarding pending orders and replenishment requirements.

Coordinate with Accounts for invoice/document verification wherever required.

Support departmental stock audits and investigations.

G. **Quality, Hygiene \& Safety**

Ensure that no expired, damaged, contaminated, or unfit material is issued for operational use.

Maintain cleanliness and hygiene within all Store areas.

Follow proper handling procedures for chemicals and hazardous materials.

Ensure food and consumable items are stored according to applicable hygiene requirements.

Follow hotel fire, health, safety, and emergency procedures.

Report any unsafe condition, leakage, pest activity, damage, or security concern immediately.

H. **Security \& Loss Prevention**

Maintain strict control over Store access.

Prevent unauthorized removal, misuse, wastage, or pilferage of hotel materials.

Ensure proper documentation for all inward, outward, return, transfer, and disposal transactions.

Immediately report suspected theft, manipulation, or stock discrepancies to management.

**3\. DAILY DUTIES**

The Store Associate / Executive shall:

Check pending deliveries and expected materials.

Receive and inspect incoming materials.

Complete required receiving documentation.

Store materials in their designated locations.

Process authorized departmental requisitions.

Issue materials and update stock records.

Check critical stock levels.

Monitor expiry dates and perishable items.

Maintain cleanliness and organization of the Store.

Report shortages, damages, discrepancies, and unusual incidents to the reporting manager.

Complete required daily Store reports and handover.

**4\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

Accuracy of inventory records.

Stock availability and timely replenishment.

Reduction of wastage and stock losses.

Proper FIFO/FEFO implementation.

Accuracy of receiving and issuing procedures.

Physical stock vs. system/book stock reconciliation.

Timely completion of stock\-taking.

Proper documentation and record maintenance.

Compliance with hotel SOPs and audit requirements.

Cleanliness, hygiene, and organization of Store areas.

Prevention and reporting of pilferage/damage.

Coordination and service provided to operating departments.

**5\. AUTHORITY \& RESPONSIBILITY**

The Store Associate / Executive is responsible for maintaining proper control over materials entrusted to the Store.

The employee shall not:

Issue materials without proper authorization.

Alter stock records without approval.

Receive materials without proper verification.

Allow unauthorized persons access to Store areas.

Hide or ignore stock discrepancies.

Accept damaged/incorrect materials without reporting the issue.

Remove hotel property or materials for personal use.

Any suspected discrepancy, theft, damage, manipulation, or unauthorized transaction must be immediately reported to the concerned reporting manager.

**6\. QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCE**

Minimum Qualification:

Graduate / Diploma / relevant vocational qualification preferred.

Candidates with Hotel Management, Inventory Management, Supply Chain, or Store\-related education will be preferred.

***Experience***:

**1–3 years** of relevant experience in hotel/resort stores, inventory, warehouse, or material management preferred.

Freshers with suitable knowledge and attitude may be considered for the Associate level.

**7\. REQUIRED SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES**

Basic inventory and stock\-control knowledge.

Knowledge of FIFO/FEFO.

Basic computer skills.

MS Excel and inventory software knowledge preferred.

Good numerical and record\-keeping ability.

Attention to detail.

Good communication and coordination skills.

Ability to work under pressure.

Honesty and integrity.

Ability to maintain confidentiality.

Good organizational skills.

Ability to follow SOPs and management instructions.

Physically capable of handling routine Store operations.

**8\. BEHAVIOURAL EXPECTATIONS**

The employee is expected to:

Maintain punctuality and regular attendance.

Maintain professional conduct at all times.

Follow the hotel's rules, regulations, policies, and SOPs.

Maintain proper grooming and uniform standards.

Treat all colleagues and vendors respectfully.

Maintain confidentiality of company information.

Demonstrate honesty and accountability.

Take responsibility for assigned Store materials and records.

Cooperate with internal and external auditors.

Perform any other reasonable duties assigned by management in the interest of hotel operations.

**9\. WORKING CONDITIONS**

The position may require:

Working in shifts according to hotel operational requirements.

Working on weekends and public holidays as per duty roster.

Physical movement within Store and hotel operational areas.

Handling cartons, packages, supplies, and other materials.

Working in refrigerated/cold storage areas where applicable.

Supporting stock\-taking beyond normal operating hours when required.

description:

**Company:** KOKA Software Technology Pvt. Ltd.  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 10\+ Years  
**Qualification:** MBA – Business Administration / HR / Marketing / Operations / Finance or equivalent  
**Location:** Chennai  
**Department:** Business Operations \& Strategy  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director

About the Role

KOKA Software Technology Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced, highly responsible and result\-oriented **Head of Business Operations \& Strategy** to manage and drive the overall business operations of the company.

This is a **senior leadership position** for a candidate with minimum 10 years of experience who can independently manage people, business operations, revenue, sales, HR, recruitment, marketing coordination, product strategy and business growth.

The selected candidate will work closely with the **Managing Director** and will be responsible for converting the company's business objectives into measurable execution plans.

The candidate must be comfortable **travelling for customer meetings, business development, market research, strategic meetings and company requirements.**

Core Responsibility

The person will be responsible for:

**People → Sales → Revenue → HR → Recruitment → Marketing → Product Strategy → Business Strategy → Operations → Performance**

The goal is to ensure that the entire organisation operates with clear targets, accountability and measurable results.

Key Responsibilities1\. Overall Business Operations

* Manage day\-to\-day business operations across departments.
* Ensure all departments are working according to company objectives.
* Establish processes, accountability and reporting systems.
* Identify operational bottlenecks.
* Solve interdepartmental issues.
* Monitor overall company performance.
* Ensure management decisions are properly implemented.
* Create SOPs and operational processes where required.
* Report important business issues and opportunities directly to the MD.

2\. People \& Team Management

Manage and coordinate teams across:

* Sales
* Marketing
* HR
* Recruitment
* Development
* Project Management
* Customer Support
* Product
* Administration

Responsibilities include:

* Set team objectives.
* Define KPIs.
* Review individual and department performance.
* Conduct performance reviews.
* Improve employee productivity.
* Resolve team conflicts.
* Identify leadership gaps.
* Improve employee accountability.
* Build a high\-performance work culture.
* Support recruitment of key positions.
* Develop team structures as the company grows.

3\. Revenue \& Sales Management

Work closely with the Sales \& Revenue Manager to ensure achievement of company targets.

Monitor:

* Monthly revenue
* Sales pipeline
* Qualified leads
* Product demos
* Quotations
* Negotiations
* Closures
* Collections
* Customer renewals
* Upselling
* Cross\-selling

Review sales performance regularly and identify corrective actions.

The candidate should be capable of understanding:

**Lead → Demo → Proposal → Negotiation → Closure → Revenue → Collection**

4\. HR \& Recruitment Management

Take overall responsibility for HR operations and recruitment strategy.

* Plan manpower requirements.
* Approve recruitment priorities with management.
* Monitor recruitment performance.
* Review critical hires.
* Improve recruitment processes.
* Monitor employee attendance and discipline.
* Support performance management.
* Review employee KPIs.
* Handle employee escalations.
* Improve employee retention.
* Coordinate with HR for company policies and processes.
* Build a strong organisational structure.

5\. Business Strategy

Work with the MD to develop and execute business strategies.

Responsibilities include:

* Annual business planning.
* Revenue planning.
* Market expansion strategy.
* Customer acquisition strategy.
* Product positioning.
* Industry targeting.
* Geographic expansion.
* Partnership strategy.
* Pricing strategy.
* Growth planning.
* Business performance analysis.

Convert strategic objectives into:

**Goal → Strategy → Action Plan → Owner → KPI → Result**

6\. Product Strategy

Work closely with the Product and Development teams to improve KOKA's products.

Research and analyse:

* Customer requirements
* Market trends
* Competitor products
* Industry requirements
* New technologies
* AI opportunities
* SaaS trends

Help define product priorities for:

* KOKA ERP
* KOKA CRM
* KOKA HRMS
* KOKA Books
* KOKA Task \& Project Management
* KOKA Ticketing
* KOKA Visitor Management

Identify:

**What should KOKA build?**

**Why should KOKA build it?**

**Who will buy it?**

**What is the business value?**

7\. Competitor Analysis

Continuously monitor competing SaaS and ERP products.

Analyse:

* Features
* Pricing
* Product positioning
* Marketing strategy
* Sales strategy
* Customer segments
* Industry solutions
* AI features
* Automation
* User experience
* Strengths and weaknesses

Prepare strategic recommendations for management.

8\. Marketing Management

The candidate will oversee the Marketing \& Business Growth team and coordinate activities including:

* SEO
* Google Business Profile
* WhatsApp marketing
* Email marketing
* LinkedIn marketing
* Content marketing
* Industry research
* Lead generation
* Competitor research

Review marketing performance based on:

**Marketing Activity → Qualified Leads → Demos → Sales → Revenue**

Marketing should be measured by business results rather than activity volume alone.

9\. Financial \& Commercial Awareness

The candidate should have a strong understanding of business numbers.

Monitor:

* Revenue
* Expenses
* Gross margin
* Sales targets
* Collections
* Customer acquisition cost
* Employee cost
* Department budgets
* Product profitability
* Renewal revenue

Work with Accounts/Finance to identify financial risks and opportunities.

10\. Customer \& Strategic Relationship Management

* Participate in important customer meetings.
* Handle strategic customer escalations.
* Support high\-value negotiations.
* Maintain relationships with key customers.
* Understand customer satisfaction and retention issues.
* Identify upselling and cross\-selling opportunities.
* Travel when required for important customers and business opportunities.

Management Reporting

The candidate will provide the MD with a structured management dashboard covering:

Daily

* Revenue achieved
* Sales pipeline
* Critical customer issues
* Recruitment status
* Employee issues
* Project/operations issues
* Critical business blockers

Weekly

* Department\-wise KPI
* Sales performance
* Revenue forecast
* Recruitment performance
* Marketing performance
* Product priorities
* Customer escalations
* Operational issues

Monthly

* Revenue vs target
* Department performance
* Employee performance
* Recruitment
* Sales conversion
* Marketing ROI
* Product strategy
* Competitor analysis
* Business risks
* Growth opportunities
* Management recommendations

**Minimum 10 years of professional experience**, with significant experience in managing multiple business functions.

Strong experience in at least several of the following is required:

* Business Operations
* Sales Management
* Revenue Management
* HR Management
* Recruitment
* Team Management
* Business Strategy
* Product Strategy
* Marketing
* SaaS / IT / Software
* B2B Business

Business

* Business development.

Strategy

* Market research.
* Business growth strategy.
* Strategic planning.

Operations

* Process management.

* Reporting.
* SOP development.
* Cross\-functional coordination.

Communication

* Excellent English communication.
* Strong presentation skills.
* Excellent negotiation skills.
* Ability to communicate with customers, employees and senior management.

AI \& Technology Skills

The candidate should be comfortable using modern AI and business technology.

Knowledge of tools such as:

* ChatGPT
* AI productivity tools
* CRM
* HRMS
* Project Management Software
* Business Intelligence / Reporting Tools

will be an advantage.

The candidate should be able to use AI for:

* Business analysis
* Competitor research
* Strategy development
* Reporting
* Data analysis
* Market research
* Product research
* Management decision support

Travel Requirement

**Willingness to travel is mandatory.**

Travel may be required for:

* Customer meetings
* Strategic business meetings
* Sales negotiations
* Industry visits
* Market research
* Partner meetings
* Business expansion
* Team meetings
* Conferences and events

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a **strong business leader** who is:

* Highly responsible
* Mature and professional
* Confident in decision\-making
* Strong in people management
* Business\-oriented
* Target\-driven
* Excellent at follow\-up
* Strong in negotiation
* Analytical
* Strategic
* Comfortable managing multiple departments
* Comfortable travelling
* Able to work directly with the MD
* Capable of independently identifying and solving business problems

The candidate should have the mindset:

**"If there is a problem, I will find the solution and make sure it gets executed."**

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 3–6 months, the successful candidate should be able to:

* Establish clear departmental KPIs.
* Improve team accountability.
* Create structured management reporting.
* Improve sales and revenue visibility.
* Strengthen recruitment processes.
* Improve employee productivity.
* Establish operational processes.
* Improve coordination between Sales, Marketing, Product and Development.
* Provide competitor and market intelligence.
* Support product strategy.
* Identify new business opportunities.
* Reduce operational dependency on the MD.

Career Growth

**Head – Business Operations \& Strategy → COO → Chief Operating Officer / Business Director**

**₹75,000 – ₹1,50,000 per month**, depending on experience, leadership capability and proven business results.

Performance\-based incentives can be structured around **revenue growth, operational improvement, team performance and business targets**.

This is **not a traditional HR Manager, Sales Manager or Operations Manager position**.

KOKA is looking for a **business leader who can take ownership of the company's day\-to\-day execution across multiple functions and work as the MD's key operational partner.**

The ideal candidate should be able to:

**Think Strategically → Plan → Delegate → Execute → Monitor → Solve Problems → Report → Improve**

**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**About the Role**

Lakshya Institute of Technology is looking for a dynamic and experienced **Soft Skills Training – Assistant Manager / Manager** to lead the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of soft skills, communication, behavioural and corporate\-readiness programs for undergraduate students.

The role will focus on improving **student employability, internship readiness and placement outcomes** through structured training, experiential learning, mentoring and measurable readiness interventions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and manage **semester\-wise soft skills and corporate\-readiness training plans**.
* Deliver and facilitate training in:
* Communication \& Spoken English
* Confidence \& Presentation Skills
* Public Speaking
* Teamwork \& Leadership
* Critical Thinking \& Problem Solving
* Workplace Etiquette \& Professional Behaviour
* Prepare students for **resumes, LinkedIn profiles, Group Discussions, interviews, assessment centres and workplace expectations**.

* Conduct experiential learning activities including **role plays, mock interviews, presentations, debates, case discussions and business simulations**.

* **3–5 years of relevant experience** in Soft Skills Training, Learning \& Development, Campus Training, Employability or Corporate Training.
* **MBA/PGDM or Master's degree** in HR, English, Communication, Psychology, Education or a related field preferred.
* Strong skills in **facilitation, public speaking, coaching, classroom management and stakeholder management**.
* Excellent **spoken and written English** with the ability to engage and motivate undergraduate students from diverse backgrounds.
* Experience working with **BSc, BCA, BTech, BBA or similar student cohorts** will be an advantage.

**Key Success Measures**

*Success in this role will be measured through:*

* Improvement in communication and interview\-readiness scores
* Training participation and engagement
* Student readiness/certification outcomes
* Recruiter feedback
* Internship and placement conversion

**Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for a **hands\-on trainer, coach and manager** who can independently manage the complete student\-readiness journey:

**Assess → Train → Practice → Coach → Reassess → Prepare for Recruitment → Measure Impact**

The ideal candidate should be **student\-centric, energetic, outcome\-oriented and passionate about developing young professionals for the corporate world.**

Join a growing academic institution where you can directly contribute to **student career development, employability and placement success**, while working closely with students, faculty, corporate partners, recruiters, trainers and industry professionals.

**Apply now and become a part of the team shaping the next generation of industry\-ready professionals.**

title: ERP Product Research & Competitive Intelligence Executive
description:
ERP Product Research \& Competitive Intelligence Executive

**Company:** KOKA Software Technology Pvt. Ltd.  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 0–1 Year / Freshers  
**Qualification:** MBA – Business Administration / Marketing / Operations / Business Analytics  
**Location:** Chennai  
**Department:** Product Research \& Strategy

About the Role

KOKA Software Technology is looking for an MBA graduate to join our **Product Research \& Competitive Intelligence Team**.

The candidate will research ERP products available in the market, study competitor features, pricing, workflows and customer requirements, and provide recommendations to improve **KOKA ERP**.

This is an excellent opportunity for an MBA graduate who wants to build a career in **Product Management, Business Analysis and SaaS Product Strategy**.

Key Responsibilities

* Research leading ERP products available in India and international markets.
* Study competitor ERP features, modules and workflows.
* Compare KOKA ERP with competing products.
* Identify missing or improved features required by customers.
* Research industry\-specific ERP requirements.
* Analyse competitor websites, product demos, documentation and marketing materials.
* Prepare competitor comparison reports.
* Create feature comparison matrices.
* Research ERP trends and emerging technologies.
* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT for product research and analysis.
* Collect customer feedback and convert it into product improvement suggestions.

We are looking for a **Quality Engineer** to join our manufacturing facility at Murthal, Sonipat. The candidate will be responsible for supporting and maintaining quality systems across **Incoming Quality Control (IQC), Process Quality Control (PQC), and Outgoing Quality Control (OQC)** and ensuring that defined quality standards, work instructions, inspection procedures, and quality processes are consistently followed on the factory floor. The role will involve conducting incoming material inspections, in\-process and final product inspections, maintaining quality checklists and inspection records, identifying and documenting non\-conformities, handling NCRs, supporting root cause analysis using tools such as **5 Why and Fishbone**, and following up on corrective and preventive actions. The role will require regular monitoring of production lines to ensure operators are following approved work instructions and quality checkpoints, identifying process deviations, and coordinating with Production for immediate containment and corrective action. The candidate will also support customer complaint investigations, returned\-product analysis, defect verification, and implementation of corrective actions to prevent recurrence. In addition, the Quality Engineer will be expected to maintain quality reports, dashboards, rejection data, inspection records, audit findings, CAPA status, and other QMS documentation and assist the Quality Head in ensuring compliance with **ISO 9001:2015 and company quality procedures**. The ideal candidate should have a **B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering, or a related field**, with 0–5 years of experience in quality or manufacturing; experience in **electronics, consumer electronics, EMS, ODM, OEM, or assembly manufacturing** will be preferred. title: Network Security Engineer
description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**
 At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.
   

  

 Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real\-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a PSIRT Engineer Level (IC) 4, you will play a pivotal role in NetApp’s Global Security Product Security Incident Response Team, contributing to the identification, analysis, and resolution of security vulnerabilities across our product portfolio. This senior\-level position requires a seasoned security professional with a deep understanding of product security vulnerability management, incident response, and secure development practices.
   

  

 In this role, you will leverage advanced technologies, including AI\-driven tools, to enhance vulnerability detection, assessment, and remediation. You will also act as a key technical leader, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to drive security initiatives, mentor junior team members, and contribute to the continuous improvement of NetApp’s product security posture.
   

  

 This hybrid role requires the candidate to work onsite three days a week and with the choice of remotely for the remainder.
   

  

 Job Requirements
   

  

**Product Security Incident Response Team**
 Lead the identification, triage, and prioritization of security vulnerabilities across NetApp products and services, leveraging AI\-driven tools and methodologies.
   

  

 Collaborate with engineering, product management, and security teams to assess the impact of vulnerabilities and define effective remediation strategies.
   

  

 Act as a key responder for product security incidents, coordinating cross\-functional efforts to contain, investigate, and resolve issues.
   

  

 Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and processes, incorporating advanced technologies and best practices.
   

  

 Monitor emerging threats and vulnerabilities relevant to NetApp’s ecosystem, providing actionable insights to proactively mitigate risks.
   

  

 Draft and publish security advisories, bulletins, and updates for internal and external audiences, ensuring clear and effective communication during security incidents.
   

  

**Leadership and Collaboration**
 Serve as a technical leader within the PSIRT team, mentoring junior engineers and fostering a culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing.
   

  

 Act as a liaison between the PSIRT team and internal stakeholders, ensuring alignment on security priorities and initiatives.
   

  

 Partner with external researchers, vendors, and industry groups to validate and address reported vulnerabilities.
   

  

**Process Improvement and Innovation**
 Identify opportunities to enhance PSIRT processes, tools, and workflows to improve efficiency and scalability.
   

  

 Drive the adoption of AI\-driven methodologies to enhance vulnerability detection, assessment, and remediation.
   

  

 Contribute to the development and implementation of strategies to address evolving security challenges, including regulatory changes and emerging technologies.
   

  

**Documentation and Reporting**
 Maintain accurate and comprehensive documentation of vulnerabilities, incidents, and remediation efforts.
   

  

 Generate regular reports and metrics to provide visibility into NetApp’s product security posture and the effectiveness of PSIRT activities.
   

  

 Education
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
   

  

 6\+ years of experience in product security, vulnerability management, or incident response, with a strong focus on software and application security.
   

  

 Deep understanding of common security vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10, CVSS) and secure development practices.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with vulnerability scanning tools, static/dynamic analysis tools, and penetration testing methodologies.
   

  

 Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex security issues and develop effective solutions.
   

  

 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
   

  

 Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Advanced certifications such as CISSP, OSCP, or GIAC are highly desirable.
   

  

 Experience with AI\-driven security tools and techniques.
   

  

 Knowledge of secure coding practices and familiarity with programming languages such as Python, Java, or C\+\+.
   

  

 Experience with cloud security and containerized environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker).
   

  

 Familiarity with regulatory and compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, NIST).
   

  

 Experience engaging with external security researchers and managing vulnerability disclosure programs.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 A dynamic and inclusive work environment that values innovation and collaboration.
   

  

 Opportunities for professional growth and development in a cutting\-edge security organization.
   

  

**Competitive Compensation And Benefits Package.**
 At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in\-office and/or in\-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
 NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.
   

  

**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**
 At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.
   

  

 NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise\-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.
   

  

**Our culture**
 We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.
   

  

 If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment \- make your next move your best one. Apply now.
   

  

**Submitting an Application**
 To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.
   

  

**AI Disclosure**
 For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support—rather than replace—human decision\-making.

Location: Sevashi , Ajwa Road Vadodara, Gujarat Job Type: Full\-time, On\-site About the Company Established in 2004, Jagdamba Sales Corporation is a leading electronics, air\-conditioning, distribution and service organization in Central Gujarat. We are expanding our operations through DRT Supermart and are looking for responsible candidates to join our Odoo ERP Operations Team. Job Summary The selected candidates will be responsible for accurately managing daily business transactions and operational activities in Odoo ERP. They will work with the Sales, Purchase, Inventory, Accounts, CRM, Helpdesk and Field Service departments. Key Responsibilities \- Create and verify GRNs against Purchase Orders and supplier invoices. \- Record inward stock with correct quantity, serial number, batch, expiry and damage details. \- Prepare quotations, sales orders, delivery orders and sales invoices. \- Process approved sales returns, credit notes and debit notes. \- Enter new enquiries and leads in CRM. \- Schedule follow\-ups, update customer communication and maintain the sales pipeline. \- Create customer complaints and Helpdesk/Field Service tickets. \- Assign technicians, prepare work orders and update service job status. \- Upload job sheets, service reports, customer approvals and payment details. \- Maintain accurate customer, vendor, product and price\-list information. \- Attach invoices, purchase orders, GRNs, delivery documents and other supporting records in Odoo. \- Assist with stock transfers, inventory checking and reconciliation. \- Ensure that transactions of Jagdamba Sales Corporation and DRT Supermart are recorded under the correct company. \- Prepare daily completed\-work, pending\-work and exception reports. \- Coordinate with Sales, Accounts, Warehouse, Service and Management teams. \- Immediately report stock, invoice, payment or documentation mismatches. \- Support backlog clearance, month\-end reconciliation and management reports. \- Maintain the confidentiality and accuracy of company and customer data. Candidate Requirements \- Graduate or diploma holder in Commerce, Management, Computer Applications, IT or a related field. \- Hands\-on experience with Odoo ERP or another ERP system will be strongly preferred. \- Knowledge of GRN, inventory, invoicing, CRM, accounts or field\-service processes will be an advantage. \- Comfortable using computers, MS Excel, email, scanners and digital documents. \- Good data\-entry speed with a strong focus on accuracy. \- Basic understanding of business documents such as Purchase Orders, GRNs, invoices and delivery challans. \- Ability to communicate in Hindi and Gujarati; basic English is required. \- Experience in electronics, air\-conditioning, retail, distribution, warehouse or service operations will be an added advantage. \- Freshers with excellent computer skills, discipline and a strong willingness to learn Odoo may also apply. Work Expectations \- Complete daily entries and assigned work on the same day. \- Be punctual and maintain regular attendance. \- Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and pending work. \- Follow approval processes; unauthorized deletion, backdating or stock adjustment is strictly prohibited. \- Inform Management in advance about leave, or immediately in case of a medical emergency. \- Work cooperatively with all departments and maintain an organization\-first mindset. \- Be willing to provide additional support during peak business and festival periods. What We Offer \- Structured training in Odoo ERP and company processes. \- Practical exposure to multiple Odoo modules and business functions. \- Long\-term career\-growth opportunities based on skills, ownership and performance. \- Supportive and team\-oriented work environment. \- Statutory benefits and group medical coverage as per eligibility and company policy. Candidates who are interested in building a long\-term career in ERP and business operations are encouraged to apply. While applying, please mention your current location, Odoo/ERP experience, modules handled, current salary, expected salary and notice period.

title: Management Trainee – Business & Strategy
description:
### **Job Information**


* Date Opened 08/23/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry Business Management
* Work Experience 0\-1 year
* City Thane
* State/Province Maharashtra
* Country India
* Zip/Postal Code 400601
### **About Us**


Plum is one of India’s science\-first, vegan, premium beauty brand with a strong portfolio of skincare and haircare products. By smartly combining research\-backed actives with the chemistry of botanical ingredients, Plum creates formulas that truly resonate. At the heart of everything, Plum has a simple message: 'We have chemistry \- with each other, with our product \& especially with our customer.’  

  

  

The brand is driven by a strong leadership and investor team, focused on building value for people, the planet, and profit\-sharing participants.  

### **Job Description**


**About Plum**
--------------

  

At Plum, we're building one of India's most exciting beauty and personal care businesses—and as we grow, we're looking for young minds who can help us solve problems differently. We're looking for high\-potential engineering graduates who are analytical, curious, commercially sharp and excited about solving real business problems. This isn't a traditional engineering role. It's an opportunity to take the problem\-solving ability you've built through engineering and apply it to business, consumers, e\-commerce, supply chain, growth, operations and strategy.

 **What You'll Do**  

You'll work on high\-impact projects across different parts of the business depending on your strengths, interests and business priorities.

  

You could find yourself solving questions like:

  

* How can we improve inventory availability without significantly increasing working capital?
* Why is a particular marketplace/category growing faster than another?
* How can we improve forecasting accuracy across thousands of SKUs and channels?
* Which business processes can be automated or simplified?
* Where should we deploy the next rupee of investment to generate maximum impact?
* How can data help us identify a business problem before it becomes visible?

  

And then you'll be expected to help **implement the answer**, not just present it.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Business Problem Solving**

* Work on ambiguous, cross\-functional business problems and bring structure to them.
* Break complex problems into clear hypotheses and actionable workstreams.
* Use data to identify patterns, opportunities and root causes.
* Translate analysis into practical business recommendations.

### **Data \& Analytics**

* Build dashboards, trackers and analytical models to support decision\-making.
* Analyse business performance and identify trends or anomalies.
* Work with large datasets across sales, inventory, consumers, marketplaces and operations.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement.

### **Business Execution**

* Take projects from **problem identification analysis recommendation execution**.
* Work closely with functional leaders to implement solutions.
* Track outcomes and continuously improve interventions based on results.
* Take independent ownership of projects as you progress.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* B.Tech/B.E. graduate from an IIT or other premier engineering institution.
* Fresher or up to 1 year of experience.
* Strong analytical and quantitative problem\-solving ability.
* Ability to structure ambiguous problems rather than wait for perfectly defined questions.
* Comfort working with data and numbers.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; knowledge of SQL, Python, Power BI or similar analytical tools would be an advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Ability to simplify complex analysis and communicate it to business stakeholders.
* High learning agility and intellectual curiosity.

title: Admissions Associate (Calicut)
description:
**Overview:**

Kerala's first and only dedicated Amazon selling training institute, based in Kozhikode is looking for energetic interns to start a great career in Admission Counseling or Tele\-sales. We offer hands\-on, agency\-based courses in Amazon selling — Amazon Selling Plus (online) and Amazon Selling Prime (offline, at our Kozhikode training center) — preparing students for genuine, practical careers in e\-commerce.

We are scaling fast right now, and building a strong bench of future sales talent is central to that growth. The Launchpad Program is how we do that — a structured, fast\-moving path for freshers to break into a real career, not just take a job.

**Why This Role Exists**

This is a launchpad, built to do exactly what the name says: take someone with no prior sales experience and, in three focused months, turn them into a confirmed, full\-time Junior Executive with real skills and real ownership. Our academy is scaling aggressively, and this program is how we build the next generation of talent to drive that growth — trained properly from day one, evaluated fairly, and promoted on merit.

**Position Details**

**Role Title**

Admissions Associate — Launchpad Program

**Department**

Growth

**Reports To**

Sales Lead

**Location**

Kozhikode, Kerala — On\-site

**Employment Type**

Full\-time, structured 3\-month training and evaluation period

**What's Next**

Top performers are confirmed into a full\-time Junior Executive role at the end of the 3 months

**Experience Required**

None — freshers and recent graduates welcome

**Compensation**

Stipend plus performance incentives during the program; enhanced compensation on confirmation

**Role Overview**

As an Admissions Associate, you're the first real conversation a prospective student has with our Academy — reaching out to leads, understanding what they're looking for, introducing them to the right course, and guiding them toward the next step, whether that's a counselling call, a campus visit, or enrollment itself.

This isn't just a calling job. It's a structured, three\-month program where you're trained properly, coached closely, and evaluated fairly — with a real, confirmed role waiting at the end of it for those who perform.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Outbound Calling \& Lead Engagement**

* Reach out to prospective students, understand their goals, and introduce them to the right course.
* Handle initial questions and hesitations with the scripts and playbook provided — you're never doing this without support.

**B. Guiding the Next Step**

* Book counselling calls, campus visits, or seminar slots — moving genuinely interested leads toward enrollment.

**C. CRM \& Pipeline Discipline**

* Log every call and update lead status the same day — the foundation of good sales habits from day one.

**D. Learning \& Growth**

* Actively apply coaching feedback — the fastest improvers in this program are the ones who treat every call as practice.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

**Education**

* Any degree — recent graduates and final\-year students are both welcome to apply.

**Experience**

* None required. What matters is communication, resilience, and a genuine willingness to learn and be coached.

**Skills, Tools \& Competencies**

**Core Skills — Must Have**

* Clear, confident spoken communication
* Comfortable on the phone, talking to new people all day
* Resilient — doesn't take a “no” personally
* Basic computer literacy and comfort learning a CRM tool
* Coachable — genuinely open to feedback

**Nice to Have**

* Any prior part\-time sales, customer service, or call\-handling experience
* Fluency in Malayalam and English
* A genuine interest in sales, e\-commerce, or entrepreneurship

**What Makes This Different**

* A real, structured path from Trainee to Junior Executive in just 3 months — not a vague promise of “growth opportunities,” a defined program with a defined outcome.
* Be part of Kerala's first and only dedicated Amazon\-selling academy, at a genuinely high\-growth moment — Our academy is scaling admissions aggressively right now.
* Real, transferable sales skills — pitching, objection handling, pipeline discipline — valuable far beyond this one role.
* Performance incentives from day one of training, not just after confirmation.
* Direct mentorship from experienced counsellors and the Sales Lead — you're never learning this alone.
* A young, fast\-moving team environment where effort is visible and rewarded.
* Transparent evaluation — your dashboard numbers speak for you; performance is genuinely what earns the promotion.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
WEBWISE SOLUTION

Business Development / Sales Development Intern ERP \+ Smart MIS for Manufacturing \& Recycling Companies

**Location:** Ahmedabad / Hybrid  
**Experience:** 0–1 year \| Intern / Fresher  
**Type:** Full\-time Internship / Fresher Opportunity  
**Department:** Business Development \& Sales  
**Reporting To:** Co\-Founder / Sales Head

About the Role

We are building technology systems for **manufacturing and recycling companies** — starting with ERP and process digitisation, then adding "Smart MIS, analytics and AI\-driven decision support".

We are looking for a **smart, confident and business\-curious fresher/intern** who can become the first point of contact between us and potential customers.

This is **not a typical telecalling job.**

You will speak with **business owners, directors, plant heads and senior managers** of manufacturing and recycling companies, understand how their businesses operate, identify potential problems around ERP, reporting, production, inventory and decision\-making, and take qualified opportunities forward to a product/demo discussion.

Your job is to make sure that **qualified prospects reach our Co\-Founder with a genuine business requirement and a scheduled demo.**

What You Will Own1\. Prospect Research

You will work with a large, pre\-built database of manufacturing and metal\-recycling companies across India.

Your work will include:

· Understanding the company before approaching them

· Identifying the right person to speak with

· Understanding their industry and manufacturing activity

· Preparing a simple reason for why our solution may be relevant

2\. Initial Outreach

Connect with prospects through:

· Phone calls

· WhatsApp

· Email

· LinkedIn where relevant

The objective is **not to blindly pitch software**.

The objective is to start a relevant business conversation.

3\. Business Qualification

You will learn to ask questions such as:

· How are your production and operational processes currently managed?

· Are you using ERP, Excel, Tally or a combination?

· How is management reporting currently prepared?

· How do you monitor production, inventory, purchases and sales?

· How much manual work goes into MIS/reporting?

· Are different departments working on separate systems?

· Are there reporting or visibility gaps for management?

You will determine:

**Is this company a genuine fit for us?**

4\. Follow\-ups \& Nurturing

Once a prospect shows interest, you will own the follow\-up.

This includes:

· Sending requested information

· Sharing company/profile material

· Sharing relevant case studies

· Coordinating demo schedules

· Following up after conversations

· Maintaining accurate CRM/status updates

· Ensuring interested prospects do not get lost

5\. Demo Booking

Your most important KPI is:

**Qualified Demo Meetings Booked**

A successful handover means the prospect has:

· Genuine business relevance

· A meaningful operational problem or improvement opportunity

· Decision\-maker / relevant stakeholder involvement

· Interest in seeing the solution

· A scheduled demo

Once that happens, **the Co\-Founder takes over for the demo and closing process.**

What You Will Learn

This role is designed for someone who wants to become good at **real B2B sales and business development**, not just calling.

You will learn:

**B2B Sales**  
How companies actually buy software.

**Business Analysis**  
How to identify operational problems inside manufacturing businesses.

**ERP \& MIS**  
How business processes are digitised and converted into management intelligence.

**Consultative Selling**  
How to sell by understanding the customer’s situation instead of pushing a generic product.

**Lead Qualification**  
How to distinguish a genuine opportunity from a dead lead.

**Founder\-Level Communication**  
How to confidently speak with business owners and senior managers.

**CRM \& Sales Operations**  
How to manage a structured sales pipeline.

Who We Are Looking ForMust Have

· Strong communication skills

· Comfortable speaking on the phone

· Good English and Hindi communication

· Gujarati is a strong advantage

· Curious about how businesses work

· Comfortable speaking with senior people

· Willingness to learn sales and business processes

· Good follow\-up discipline

· Basic Excel / Google Sheets skills

· Professional communication on WhatsApp and email

We Will Especially Like You If You

· Ask good questions

· Can understand a business problem quickly

· Are confident without being aggressive

· Can explain things clearly

· Have good listening skills

· Take ownership instead of waiting for instructions

· Are interested in startups, SaaS, ERP, manufacturing or B2B sales

· Can research a company before calling it

Who Should NOT Apply

This role may not be suitable if you:

· Are uncomfortable making phone calls

· Expect a purely desk\-based data\-entry role

· Do not like follow\-ups

· Prefer scripted telecalling with no learning

· Are uncomfortable speaking with business owners

· Do not want sales or customer interaction experience

KPIs

Your performance will primarily be measured on:

**Quality of conversations**

**Qualified prospects generated**

**Follow\-up discipline**

**Demo meetings booked**

**Demo\-to\-opportunity quality**

We care more about **qualified meetings** than simply making a large number of calls.

Typical Daily Work

A typical day could include:

**Research → Call → Understand → Qualify → Follow\-up → Share information → Schedule Demo → Update CRM**

You may speak with:

· Founders

· Directors

· Plant Heads

· Operations Heads

· Finance Heads

· Business Managers

And learn how real companies operate.

Compensation

**Internship:** ₹5,000\+/month depending on capability and experience

**Performance Incentives:** Additional incentives linked to qualified demos / successful outcomes

**Fresher conversion:** Opportunity for a full\-time Business Development role based on performance.

Why This Role Is Different

You will not be selling a simple product from a fixed script.

Our approach is:

**Step 1 — Digitise \& Systemise the Business**  
ERP and process digitisation

**Step 2 — Make the Business Measurable**  
Smart MIS, dashboards and analytics

**Step 3 — Make the Business Intelligent**  
AI integration wherever there is a genuine use case

This means your conversations will be about **how businesses operate and how they can improve**, not just about software features.

Career Path

A strong performer can grow into:

**BD Intern → Business Development Executive → Sales / Business Consultant → Account Manager / Business Development Manager**

The person who performs well in this role will get direct exposure to **real B2B sales, manufacturing businesses, ERP projects and founder\-level selling.**

description:

From predictive maintenance and demand planning to sovereign AI for citizen services, we design systems that thrive in high\-impact environments. title: WEB UI/UX SPECIALIST
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 As a UI/UX Specialist at oCommerce, you'll help shape how customers and employees interact with our products every day. From ecommerce storefronts and checkout experiences to internal business tools and AI\-powered platforms, you'll design experiences that are not only visually polished but thoughtfully crafted around user behavior. You'll work closely with developers, marketers, ecommerce managers, and creative teams to transform ideas into intuitive user experiences. Every project begins with understanding the problem before designing the solution, and every design decision should improve usability, conversion, or efficiency. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong visual design skills with a deep understanding of user psychology, interaction design, and conversion optimization.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design intuitive user interfaces for ecommerce websites, internal platforms, and web applications.
* Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and production\-ready designs.
* Collaborate with developers to ensure pixel\-perfect implementation.
* Improve customer journeys across product pages, collections, checkout, and post\-purchase experiences.
* Design dashboards and internal tools that improve operational efficiency.
* Conduct UX research using analytics, customer feedback, and usability testing.
* Develop and maintain scalable design systems and UI component libraries.
* Work closely with marketing teams to optimize landing pages and conversion funnels.
* Ensure designs are responsive and optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* Continuously iterate designs based on performance data and user behavior.
* Stay current with emerging UI trends, accessibility standards, and AI\-assisted design tools.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* 5\+ years of professional UI/UX design experience.
* Strong portfolio showcasing web, ecommerce, or SaaS design projects.
* Expert proficiency in Figma.
* Strong understanding of typography, spacing, hierarchy, and visual systems.
* Experience designing responsive interfaces across multiple devices.
* Familiarity with UX research methods and usability testing.
* Understanding of user\-centered design principles.
* Ability to create interactive prototypes and developer\-ready design specifications.
* Working knowledge of HTML and CSS is a plus.
* Experience with Shopify or ecommerce platforms is preferred.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.


 What we're looking for
   

  

* Someone who naturally notices poor user experiences and wants to improve them.
* A designer who balances aesthetics with functionality.
* Curious about user psychology and customer behavior.
* Strong attention to detail and craftsmanship.
* Comfortable receiving and giving constructive feedback.
* Collaborative and able to work across creative, marketing, and technology teams.
* Ownership mindset—you care about how designs perform after launch.
* Passionate about continuous learning and improving your craft.
* Excited about AI\-powered design workflows and emerging technologies.
* Thrives in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.


 What we offer
   

  

* Opportunity to design experiences used by customers around the world.
* Work across multiple ecommerce brands, internal platforms, and AI initiatives.
* Direct collaboration with developers, marketers, and executive leadership.
* Modern design tools and the freedom to influence product direction.
* Competitive salary with performance\-based incentives.
* Clear opportunities for career growth and specialization.
* Modern office located in Mumbai.
* Paid time off and company\-recognized holidays.
* Continuous learning and professional development.
* A culture that values creativity, experimentation, and ownership.


 Our hiring process
   

  

* Submit your application and portfolio.
* Introductory interview with our recruiting team.
* Portfolio review with our design and technology leaders.
* Practical design exercise focused on improving a real ecommerce or product experience.
* Final interview with executive leadership.
* Reference checks.
* Offer and onboarding.
