description:
**Job Title**: HR Manager (NON IT Background)

**Location**: \[Mohali]  
**Industry**: Nutraceutical Manufacturing  
**Working Days**: 6 Days a Week (Monday to Saturday)  
**Working Hours**: 10:00 AM \- 7:00 PM

**Position Overview**:

We are seeking a qualified and experienced HR Manager with an MBA in Human Resources to oversee all aspects of human resources and administrative functions at our nutraceutical manufacturing plant. The HR Manager will play a pivotal role in developing and implementing HR strategies, ensuring compliance with labor laws, handling employee relations, enforcing HR policies, and managing administrative tasks to streamline operations within the facility. This position requires excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills. Candidate must be ready to visit labor court and police stations in extreme cases must know industrial laws and preferably for manufacturing industries

**Key Responsibilities**:**HR Functions**:

* **Recruitment \& Staffing**: Manage recruitment processes including job postings, interviewing, and selecting qualified candidates for various plant positions.
* **Employee Relations**: Serve as the main point of contact for all employee\-related issues, resolving conflicts, addressing grievances, and ensuring a positive work environment.
* **Onboarding \& Training**: Coordinate onboarding for new hires, including orientation, job training, and ensuring smooth integration into the team.
* **Performance Management**: Support managers in the implementation of performance appraisal systems, setting goals, and conducting performance reviews.
* **Compliance \& Legal**: Ensure all HR practices comply with local labor laws and industry regulations, including workplace safety and employee welfare standards.
* **Compensation \& Benefits**: Oversee payroll processing, employee benefits administration, and manage compensation strategies in alignment with industry standards.
* **HR Policies**: Develop, implement, and monitor HR policies and procedures that align with company objectives, legal requirements, and best practices. Ensure all employees are familiar with and adhere to these policies.
* **NDA Agreements**: Ensure that all employees sign Non\-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) upon hire and regularly review and update these agreements to maintain confidentiality regarding proprietary information, formulas, and processes specific to the nutraceutical industry.

**Administrative Duties**:

* **Documentation \& Recordkeeping**: Maintain up\-to\-date employee records, contracts, HR documents, and signed NDA agreements in both electronic and paper formats.
* **Reporting**: Prepare and submit regular reports on HR metrics such as turnover rates, absenteeism, employee satisfaction, etc.
* **Inventory Management**: Oversee office supplies and other administrative resources to ensure the smooth operation of daily activities.
* **Communication**: Act as a liaison between upper management and staff, communicating policy changes and ensuring that all employees are informed about company updates.

**General Responsibilities**:

* **Workforce Planning**: Analyze staffing needs and make recommendations for improvements or adjustments to optimize workforce productivity.
* **Health \& Safety**: Promote a safe and healthy work environment by ensuring compliance with safety regulations and conducting regular safety audits.
* **Team Collaboration**: Work closely with other departments to foster collaboration and ensure HR policies support company goals.
* **Other Duties**: Perform any other related administrative duties as required by management to ensure smooth operations.

**Qualifications**:

* **MBA in Human Resources** or related field.
* Proven experience as an HR Manager, ideally in a manufacturing or nutraceutical setting.
* Strong knowledge of HR practices, labor laws, employee relations, and confidentiality agreements.
* Experience in developing and implementing HR policies, procedures, and NDAs.
* In\-depth knowledge of **Employee State Insurance (ESI)** and **Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)**, and experience in managing statutory compliances related to these schemes.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.
* Ability to multitask and manage time efficiently.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

**Skills**:

* Leadership and interpersonal skills.
* Proficient in **Google Workplace (formerly G Suite)**, **ERP systems**, or similar HR software platforms.
* Problem\-solving abilities with a proactive approach.
* Knowledge of safety and health regulations in manufacturing environments.
* Experience in managing a team and working with cross\-functional teams.

**Physical Requirements**:

* Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods.
* Ability to use a computer and telephone.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.

We are looking for a proactive and responsible **HR Executive – Generalist** to manage day\-to\-day HR operations, employee coordination, recruitment, payroll support, documentation, and employee engagement activities. title: Total Rewards Specialist - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**
### **About JumpCloud®**


JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

  

### **About the role:**



JumpCloud’s Total Rewards team is looking for a detail\-oriented team player to help support the day\-to\-day administration, analysis, and compliance of our global compensation and benefits programs, focusing on benefits administration across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas and foundational compensation analysis. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on accuracy, enjoys digging into data, and wants to build a career in Total Rewards.You'll partner with HR, Payroll, Finance, and external vendors while supporting our global benefits programs, compensation cycles, audits, and reporting.


### **What you’ll be doing:**


**1\. Core Benefits Administration \& Lifecycle Support**


* **Enrollments \& Status Changes:** Coordinate and execute end\-to\-end processing of benefit enrollments and status changes across US and international platforms.
* **Onboarding \& Communications:** Generate and distribute benefit enrollment documentation; follow up with new hires to ensure timely registration within mandated windows.
* **Leave of Absence Support:** Assist with administrative tracking and compliance tasks for medical, parental, and maternity leaves.
* **Offboarding \& Terminations:** Manage the benefit termination process across carrier portals and ensure exiting employees receive accurate and timely insurance continuation notices.

**2\. Compensation Analysis \& Support**


* **Market Benchmarking \& Analysis:** Conduct basic compensation analysis, including market benchmarking, pay equity checks, and salary range comparisons.
* **Annual Cycle Support:** Support annual merit, bonus, and equity cycles, including data preparation, validation, and system loading.
* **Job Architecture Maintenance:** Assist with job leveling and job architecture maintenance.
* **Compensation Structure Control:** Help maintain compensation structures (salary bands/ranges) and keep documentation current

**3\. Financial Operations, Billing \& Reconciliations**


* **Invoice Support:** Prepare accurate self\-billing schedules. Retrieve, format, and forward approved premium invoices to the Accounts Payable team while maintaining meticulous compliance records. Partner with Payroll and insurance carriers to research and resolve any billing discrepancies.
* **Payroll Deductions:** Calculate benefit premium adjustments and coordinate directly with regional Payroll teams to execute accurate monthly deductions and contributions.

**4\. Seasonal Programs \& Project Support**


* **Benefits Enrollment \& Renewals:** Deliver comprehensive support during annual enrollment and renewal periods. Compile and organize multi\-country census datasets, clear background system errors, and assist with back\-end setup configurations.
* **Documentation \& Implementation Support:** Coordinate, track, and assist with the completion of insurance carrier paperwork, applications, and implementation forms.
* **Employee Communications:** Help draft, edit, and localize employee\-facing resources and communication materials. Assist in scheduling and supporting informational benefits webinars.
* **Knowledge Management:** Continually update and maintain Total Rewards documentation, process guides, FAQ’s, and employee intranet sites to guarantee accuracy.
* **Special Projects Support:** Support the team with special projects, including system implementations, program redesigns, and vendor evaluations

**5\. Compliance, Auditing \& Data Analysis**


* **Data Integrity Auditing:** Perform structured benefits and compensation data validation audits across HRIS and vendor platforms.
* **Cross\-Functional Reporting:** Pull, validate, and format recurring and ad hoc compensation and benefits reports for HR, Finance, and leadership.
* **Compliance:** Support compliance reporting requirements (e.g., pay transparency, benefits compliance reporting and filings) as needed.
* **Retirement and Savings Plan Support:** Process global pension and 401(k) contribution updates and adjustments for payroll processing; assist with Savings Funds and other global financial products.

**6\. Employee Experience, Wellness \& Shared Services**


* **Employee Support:** Assist in responding to day\-to\-day employee benefits inquiries, resolving carrier access issues, and coordinating claims escalations with brokers.
* **Wellness Programs:** Contribute to and collaborate on company\-wide wellness campaigns and health initiatives.
* **Global Resources:** Research, assemble, and update annual international paid holiday calendars across regions (Americas, APAC, EMEA).

**7\. General Total Rewards Support**


* **Ad Hoc Analytical Support:** Provide general administrative and analytical support across the Total Rewards function as priorities evolve.
### **We're looking for:**


* **Experience:** 1–2 years of experience in compensation, benefits, or a related HR function.
* **Availability:** Ability and willingness to be available for calls in the evenings 2\-3 days per week, in order to align with US/Mexico team members.
* **Compensation Fundamentals:** Working knowledge of compensation fundamentals (base pay, bonus, market pricing, pay equity concepts).
* **Learning Mindset:** Prior exposure to benefits or an eagerness and ability to quickly master varied global statutory frameworks.
* **Analytical Toolkit:** Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, data sorting) to confidently manipulate census data, execute audits, and reconcile invoices.
* **Systems \& Platforms:** Exposure to modern HRIS platforms (ADP preferred). Meticulous document control habits using platforms like Egnyte and DocuSign.
* **Core Traits:** High attention to numeric accuracy, absolute discretion regarding sensitive PII/PHI data, and strong communication skills.

**Where you’ll be working/Location:**
JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.**
**Language:**JumpCloud® has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We are looking for a proactive and result\-oriented Junior IT Recruiter to manage recruitment for technical roles. The ideal candidate should have experience in sourcing, screening, and coordinating IT professionals across different technologies and experience levels.

  

The candidate should be comfortable working in a remote environment, managing multiple job requirements, maintaining regular follow\-ups, and delivering quality candidate profiles within agreed timelines.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Understand technical job requirements and candidate specifications shared by hiring managers or clients.
* Source suitable IT candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, job portals, professional networks, employee referrals, social media, and internal databases.
* Screen resumes and shortlist candidates based on technical skills, relevant experience, project exposure, location, availability, notice period, and compensation expectations.
* Conduct initial screening calls to assess candidates’ communication skills, technical background, job interest, and overall suitability for the role.
* Source candidates for IT roles such as Software Developers, Full Stack Developers, Frontend Developers, Backend Developers, Java Developers, Python Developers, React Developers, Angular Developers, DevOps Engineers, Cloud Engineers, QA Engineers, Data Analysts, UI/UX Designers, Business Analysts, and other technical positions.
* Coordinate interviews between shortlisted candidates and hiring managers.
* Follow up with candidates and stakeholders for interview availability, interview feedback, selection updates, documentation, and joining status.
* Share candidate profiles in the required format, along with relevant details such as current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, location, and availability.
* Maintain accurate candidate records, job status, interview schedules, sourcing details, and recruitment trackers using Zoho Recruit, ATS platforms, Excel, Google Sheets, or other relevant tools.
* Build and maintain a strong database of IT professionals for current and future hiring requirements.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience through clear, timely, and professional communication throughout the recruitment process.
* Assist with offer coordination, document collection, background\-verification follow\-ups, and joining formalities when required.
* Meet assigned sourcing, submission, interview, and closure targets.
* Stay updated on current IT skills, technology trends, recruitment practices, and sourcing methods.

### **Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in IT recruitment, technical recruitment, talent acquisition, or staffing recruitment.
* Experience in sourcing and hiring candidates for technical and IT roles.
* Basic understanding of IT technologies, skills, job titles, and technical recruitment terminology.
* Familiarity with technologies such as Java, Python, .NET, React, Angular, Node.js, SQL, AWS, Azure, DevOps, testing, data analytics, and cloud platforms is preferred.
* Strong experience using LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, job portals, Boolean search, social\-media sourcing, and referral\-based recruitment.
* Familiarity with Zoho Recruit, ATS, HRMS, CRM, or recruitment\-tracking tools will be an added advantage.
* Good verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong follow\-up, negotiation, coordination, time\-management, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple open requirements, and meet deadlines in a remote work environment.
* High level of professionalism, ownership, attention to detail, and confidentiality.

### **Benefits**


If you have a passion for IT recruitment, candidate sourcing, and connecting skilled professionals with the right opportunities, we encourage you to apply for the Junior IT Recruiter role at FyerX.

description:
We are looking for a proactive and business\-oriented Business Analyst Intern to support our business development and client engagement initiatives. This role is ideal for fresh graduates or candidates with up to one year of experience who are passionate about understanding business needs, interacting with clients, conducting market research, and helping transform business requirements into actionable solutions. You will work closely with the Business Development and Project teams to drive business growth and ensure successful project initiation.

Key Responsibilities

* Assist in identifying and qualifying new business opportunities.
* Interact with prospective clients to understand their business challenges and requirements.
* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements for websites, mobile applications, and software solutions.
* Prepare business proposals, presentations, project estimations, and other pre\-sales documentation.
* Conduct market, competitor, and industry research to identify emerging trends and opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure client requirements are clearly communicated.
* Maintain CRM records, track sales activities, and follow up with prospective clients.
* Support the Business Development team in client meetings, product demonstrations, and proposal discussions.
* Assist in preparing reports, business documents, and project handover materials.
* Build and maintain positive relationships with clients through timely communication and follow\-ups.

Requirements

* 0–1 year of experience (Freshers are encouraged to apply).
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical thinking and business acumen.
* Good presentation and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to understand business problems and recommend suitable solutions.
* Self\-motivated, target\-oriented, and eager to learn.

Preferred Skills

* Basic understanding of the software development lifecycle and IT services.
* Familiarity with CRM tools or business documentation is an advantage.
* Knowledge of digital transformation, web applications, or mobile applications is a plus.
* Strong research and presentation skills.

Qualification

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* MBA (Marketing, Business Analytics, or Operations) candidates are preferred.
* Recent graduates and final\-year students are welcome to apply.

Benefits

* Exposure to end\-to\-end business analysis and pre\-sales activities.
* Mentorship from experienced Business Analysts and Business Development professionals.
* Opportunity to work with domestic and international clients.
* Career growth and potential full\-time employment based on performance.

title: Field Test Engineer
description:
The role
   

  

 You are the company’s eyes in the field. You commission the stations, you run acceptance testing with real farmers and pilots, you check what the telemetry says against what the ground says, and you capture the evidence that two signatures rest on. No station opens without your signature on its scripts.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Run the published commissioning scripts in person, on site, with evidence — no step may be signed remotely
* Measure the real boundary of at least ten blocks with a handheld device against the computed polygon
* Time the geofence breach alert with a stopwatch — the published number is one you measured
* Recruit real farmers for acceptance sessions, and recruit past the minimum, because runs are voided by rain and by withdrawn consent
* Spot\-check at least one flight per station per week against the logs
* File any field\-reported defect with steps, screenshots and logs within four hours
* Countersign the acceptance runs and file their evidence folders


 Eligibility
   

  

* One to three years in quality or support
* Fluent Tamil — speaking, reading and writing
* A two\-wheeler and a valid licence, and willingness to travel across districts
* Comfortable around drones, batteries and field kit — not an expert, but not nervous either
* Bug\-report discipline: steps, context, evidence and timestamp, every time
* Patience with checklists, and the alertness to notice when a checklist is itself wrong


 What you get
   

  

* The remote pilot certificate sponsored for the stronger of the two seats
* Company accommodation in Erode during the posting, a proper travel allowance paid on a schedule rather than on claims, and scheduled rest days
* The QA Lead on site twice a week, not on a call

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.

**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.

* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.

**COD \& Documentation Management*** Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.

* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.

**Operational Compliance*** Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.

* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security*** Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.

* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility*** Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation*** Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration*** Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a technically skilled and customer\-oriented **Field Service Engineer** to support our ISP network operations. The role involves installation, commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, and restoration of broadband, FTTH/FTTx, fiber\-optic, Wi\-Fi, and networking services at customer and network locations.

The candidate will work closely with the **NOC, Installation, Customer Care, and Network Operations teams** to ensure timely service delivery, network availability, and customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install and commission **FTTH/FTTx broadband connections**, ONT/ONU, routers, Wi\-Fi devices, and other CPE equipment.
* Perform fiber cable routing, termination, jointing, and basic **fiber splicing** activities.
* Troubleshoot broadband connectivity, low\-speed, signal\-loss, Wi\-Fi, and network\-related complaints.
* Check optical signal levels and identify fiber cuts, attenuation, connector issues, and last\-mile faults.
* Perform testing using **OTDR, Optical Power Meter, VFL, Fusion Splicer**, and other fiber\-testing equipment.
* Configure and troubleshoot routers, ONT/ONU, Wi\-Fi routers, switches, and basic networking equipment.
* Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance of the access/last\-mile network.
* Attend customer complaints and service requests within the defined **SLA/TAT**.
* Conduct site surveys and feasibility checks for new customer connections.
* Coordinate with the **NOC/L2/L3 teams** for issues requiring backend or advanced technical support.
* Support fault restoration for OFC, distribution boxes, FDPs, splitters, and other access\-network infrastructure.
* Maintain proper records of installations, complaints, fault restoration, materials, and customer sign\-offs.
* Ensure proper utilization and maintenance of company tools, equipment, vehicles, and network materials.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Basic knowledge of **FTTH, FTTx, GPON, OFC, LAN/WAN, Ethernet, and TCP/IP**.
* Knowledge of **ONT/ONU, OLT, routers, switches, Wi\-Fi, and CPE**.
* Basic understanding of IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, VLAN, and network troubleshooting.

* Ability to identify and troubleshoot fiber cuts, optical power loss, and connectivity issues.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Social Media Manager — BabyosaurAbout Babyosaur

Babyosaur is a **young, homegrown brand for little ones aged 0–5**, built around mindful parenting, sustainable choices, meaningful play and beautifully designed everyday essentials.

We’re still at the beginning of our journey — which is exactly why this role is exciting.

We’re not looking for someone to simply “manage our Instagram.” We’re looking for someone who wants to **help build a brand from the ground up**, experiment, learn, create, and grow alongside us.

If you see potential before everyone else does, understand why a Reel works before it goes viral, and love turning an idea into content — we’d love to hear from you.

The Role

We’re looking for a **Social Media Manager / Content \& Social Media Executive** who can take ownership of Babyosaur’s digital presence across:

* Instagram
* Facebook
* YouTube
* LinkedIn
* Babyosaur’s website

You’ll work closely with the founders to translate our brand ethos into content that is **fresh, relatable, engaging and distinctly Babyosaur.**

What You'll Do

**Content \& Social Media**

* Follow and execute a structured monthly content calendar.
* Plan and create Reels, carousels, static posts, Stories and short\-form videos.
* Edit Reels and social videos using tools such as Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar.
* Write captions, hooks and engaging copy.
* Schedule and publish content consistently across platforms.
* Repurpose content intelligently across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and LinkedIn.
* Keep our website content fresh and aligned with campaigns.

**Trend Spotting \& Growth**

* Stay constantly updated on Instagram and social media trends.
* Identify viral audio, formats, memes, hooks and content styles **before they become saturated.**
* Think ahead about what parents will be talking about next.
* Experiment with new formats and ideas rather than simply copying competitors.
* Track analytics and understand what is working — and, importantly, why.
* Help grow our followers, reach, engagement and ultimately our customer base.

**Ads \& Campaigns**

* Assist with creating and scheduling Meta ads and promotional campaigns.
* Develop creative variations for ads.
* Monitor basic performance metrics and suggest improvements.
* Support launches, offers, exhibitions, collaborations and seasonal campaigns.

Who We're Looking For

This role is especially suited to a **fresher or someone in the early stages of their career** who has strong social media instincts.

You don't necessarily need years of experience.

We care much more about whether you:

* **Understand social media naturally.**
* Know what makes people stop scrolling.
* Can spot a trend before it peaks.
* Have a strong eye for aesthetics and storytelling.
* Are creative, curious and willing to experiment.
* Can edit a Reel from start to finish.
* Are comfortable with Canva, CapCut or similar tools.
* Have good writing and communication skills.
* Are organised enough to stick to a content calendar.
* Can work independently without needing to be told what to do every step of the way.
* Are willing to learn quickly.
* Actually enjoy social media rather than simply using it.

Most Importantly — We Want a Co\-Builder

Babyosaur is **small, young and bootstrapped.**

This isn't a corporate job where you'll be handed a brief, execute it and go home.

Sometimes you'll be planning next month's content.

Sometimes you'll be filming a product.

Sometimes you'll be brainstorming a crazy Reel.

Sometimes you'll notice a trend at 10 AM and we'll want to jump on it by lunch.

And sometimes you'll have to figure something out with limited resources.

We want someone who is **comfortable with that.**

Someone who doesn't say:

“That's not my job.”

description:
At Dscout, we're building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world's top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us.
   

  

 AI native product is fundamentally different engineering problem than building deterministic software: the same input won't always produce the same output, and "working" means the agent behaves well across the full distribution of real world scenarios, not that it passes a fixed test suite.
   

  

 We're looking for an
 **Applied AI Engineer** 
 with 2\-5 years of experience building and shipping AI systems used by professionals at enterprise. You're comfortable working with modern LLM\-based systems and agentic workflows, and you know how to turn powerful models into reliable product features. You have strong product judgment and think deeply about tradeoffs between LLM approaches and traditional ML when designing solutions. You care about evaluation, iteration speed, and making sure AI systems actually drive measurable business impact
 **reliably** 
 .
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Own the production improvement loop across agent behavior, customer and operator feedback, evaluation, experimentation, and verified business outcomes
* Instrument agent workflows so model interactions, tool use, decisions, failures, human edits, and downstream outcomes can be understood in context
* Define meaningful quality standards, representative evaluation datasets, regression coverage, and production monitoring.
* Investigate why agents underperform across context, knowledge, instructions, tools, routing, guardrails, or workflow design
* Design and ship targeted behavior improvements, including changes to prompting, context construction, decision logic, tool use, and human\-review paths
* Build backend services, APIs, data models, and feedback pipelines that make agent behavior observable, steerable, and reproducible
* Run controlled experiments, production replays, or staged rollouts to measure whether changes improve quality and downstream business results
* Partner with Product, Data Science, and Sales to prioritize high\-value problems and define customer and business success
* Ship with appropriate safeguards for privacy, security, reliability, human oversight, and safe operational rollout


 What you bring
   

  

* 2\-5 years of software engineering experience, with hands\-on experience building or operating LLM\-powered features or agents in production \- not just prototypes or demos
* Fluency with prompting and context engineering as an engineering discipline: you iterate on prompts, context construction, and tool definitions the way you'd iterate on code
* Experience building or maintaining evaluation harnesses for AI systems: offline eval sets, LLM\-as\-judge or human\-in\-the\-loop scoring, regression detection
* Genuine comfort with non\-determinism: you reason about agent behavior across a distribution of production traffic, not a fixed set of test cases, and you don't treat variance as a bug to be argued away
* Experience running experiments (A/B, staged rollouts, production replay) to validate whether a change actually improved outcomes, not just whether it shipped
* A track record of shipping features real users depended on, and owning what happened after launch
* A high\-agency mindset: comfortable investigating an ambiguous "why is this underperforming" problem across context, tools, routing, and workflow design without a fully\-scoped ticket
* Comfort using AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) as a real part of your workflow


 Nice to have
   

  

* Experience with voice or real\-time conversational AI systems
* Familiarity with LLM observability/tracing tools (e.g., Braintrust, LangSmith, Datadog LLM Observability)
* Experience with agentic orchestration frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph or similar)
* Exposure to MCP\-based tooling or agentic data workflows

description:
The role

* Three or more solo proofs of concept taken from nothing to a written finding
* Lab discipline: documented, reproducible setups and honest negative results
* Willing to travel to Erode for field validation in October and November

**Position Overview**

Statcon Electronics India Limited is seeking a Quality Control / Process Quality professional to support quality assurance activities across the production process. The selected candidate will be responsible for in\-process inspection, final inspection, defect identification, process monitoring, and maintaining quality records on the shop floor.

The role requires a practical understanding of Process Quality Control, engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, inspection methods, and basic measuring instruments. The candidate will work closely with the Production and Quality teams to identify and resolve quality issues and ensure that products meet defined specifications.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Monitor and maintain quality standards at different stages of the production process.
* Perform in\-process and final inspection of products as per defined quality standards.
* Inspect product dimensions, fitment, assembly, appearance, workmanship, and overall quality.
* Read and interpret engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, and specifications.
* Use basic inspection and measuring instruments such as Vernier Caliper, measuring tape, meter tape, and other relevant tools.
* Identify production defects, quality issues, and process deviations during manufacturing.
* Coordinate with the Production and Quality teams to identify root causes and resolve quality\-related issues.
* Ensure that production activities are carried out as per approved drawings, specifications, and quality requirements.
* Maintain inspection records, check sheets, rejection reports, and other quality\-related documentation.
* Report quality deviations and non\-conformities to the concerned team or reporting manager.
* Support corrective and preventive actions for recurring quality issues.
* Conduct regular shop\-floor checks to ensure adherence to defined process and quality standards.
* Assist in maintaining proper documentation and traceability of inspection activities.

* Diploma in Electronics is mandatory.

* Basic understanding of engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, and specifications.
* Familiarity with basic measuring and inspection instruments.
* Good observation and attention to detail.
* Basic problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Basic knowledge of quality documentation and inspection reports.
* Willingness to work in a shop\-floor / manufacturing environment.

· **Employment Type**: Full\-time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled and detail\-oriented **Mechanical Draftsman** with a strong background in the **metal fabrication industry**. In this role, you will convert complex engineering concepts and rough sketches into highly accurate, detailed 2D production drawings and 3D models. The ideal candidate understands sheet metal fabrication, structural steelwork, welding symbols, and machining processes, ensuring that the workshop team can manufacture products with zero errors.

**Key Responsibilities**

· **Production Drawings**: Create detailed manufacturing drawings, including assembly drawings, part drawings, structural layouts, and cross\-sections for the fabrication shop floor.

· **Bill of Materials (BOM)**: Generate precise and comprehensive Bills of Materials, cutting lists, and material take\-offs to assist the procurement and accounts teams.

· **3D Modelling \& Modelling**: Develop accurate 3D models of fabricated structures, enclosures, and mechanical assemblies to check for interferences and fitment.

· **Welding \& Machining Symbols**: Apply standard welding symbols, geometric dimensioning and tolerance (GD\&T), and surface finish symbols accurately according to international standards (ISO/ASME/IS).

· **Design Optimization**: Collaborate with fabrication supervisors and project engineers to optimize designs for cost\-effective manufacturing and easier assembly.

· **Revision Control**: Maintain an organized engineering database, ensuring strict version control and tracking changes made to drawings during the production cycle.

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**

· **Education**: ITI (Draftsman Mechanical) or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.

· **Experience**: 1 to 2 years of solid experience as a draftsman specifically within a **heavy fabrication, sheet metal, or structural steel industry**.

· **Industry Knowledge**: Strong understanding of fabrication shop\-floor practices, raw material types (MS, SS), plate thicknesses, and bending allowances.

**Technical Skills \& Competencies**

· **CAD Software Mastery**: Proficiency in 2D and 3D software such as **AutoCAD**, **SolidWorks**, or **Solid Edge**.

· **Sheet Metal Design**: Expertise in creating flat\-pattern developments, calculating bend deductions, and designing sheet metal enclosures.

· **Standards \& Code Compliance**: Familiarity with industrial detailing codes and standards (e.g., ASME Section VIII for pressure vessels or IS codes for structural steel).

· **Attention to Detail**: Exceptional precision to minimize material wastage, re\-work, and dimensional errors on the factory floor.

**What We Offer**

· Competitive salary aligned with fabrication industry standards.

· Safe, structured, and growth\-oriented engineering work environment.

· Statutory benefits, including ESIC, and annual performance bonuses.

title: Purchase Manager- Redy Mix Concrete
description:
Job Summary

The Purchase Manager – RMC will be responsible for managing the **end\-to\-end procurement of Ready Mix Concrete (RMC), cement, aggregates, admixtures, and other construction\-related materials** required for ongoing projects.

The position will be responsible for **vendor development, rate negotiation, purchase planning, supplier performance, material availability, cost optimization, quality coordination, delivery scheduling, and commercial management**.

Key Responsibilities  
1\. RMC \& Material Procurement

* Manage end\-to\-end procurement of Ready Mix Concrete for construction projects.
* Coordinate procurement of different concrete grades such as **M20, M25, M30, M35, M40 and higher grades**, as required by project specifications.
* Procure cement, aggregates, manufactured sand/M\-sand, admixtures and other RMC\-related raw materials.
* Review material requirements received from project sites and prepare procurement plans accordingly.
* Ensure uninterrupted availability of RMC and critical construction materials.
* Plan procurement based on project schedules, concrete pouring requirements and consumption forecasts.
* Coordinate with RMC plants and suppliers for daily/weekly delivery schedules.
* Monitor dispatches and ensure timely delivery at project sites.

2\. Vendor Development \& Management

* Identify, evaluate and develop reliable RMC suppliers and raw material vendors.
* Maintain an approved vendor database for RMC, cement, aggregates, admixtures and related materials.
* Conduct vendor evaluations based on **price, quality, capacity, delivery performance, financial stability and service capability**.
* Negotiate and finalize commercial terms with suppliers.
* Monitor vendor performance and take corrective action for recurring delays, quality issues or commercial discrepancies.
* Develop alternate suppliers to avoid dependency on a single vendor.
* Maintain strong professional relationships with key suppliers and RMC manufacturers.

3\. Price Negotiation \& Cost Control

* Obtain and compare quotations from multiple vendors.
* Negotiate **RMC rates, transportation charges, pumping charges, escalation clauses, taxes, discounts and payment terms**.
* Negotiate volume\-based rates and long\-term rate contracts wherever applicable.
* Analyze market trends for cement, aggregates, sand, admixtures, diesel and transportation costs.
* Identify opportunities for cost reduction without compromising quality or project requirements.
* Maintain approved rate contracts and periodically review supplier pricing.
* Prepare comparative statements and obtain necessary approvals before finalizing purchases.

4\. Purchase Orders \& Commercial Management

* Prepare and release Purchase Orders / Work Orders in accordance with approved procurement procedures.
* Ensure POs clearly specify:
* Material description
* Concrete grade/specification
* Quantity
* Rate
* Applicable taxes
* Transportation charges
* Delivery location
* Payment terms
* Quality requirements
* Testing requirements
* Other commercial conditions
* Track PO quantities and values against actual consumption.
* Monitor pending orders and ensure timely closure of completed POs.
* Coordinate with Finance and Accounts for invoice verification and payment processing.
* Resolve billing, rate, quantity, tax and delivery\-related discrepancies with vendors.

5\. RMC Delivery \& Logistics Coordination

* Coordinate with project sites and RMC suppliers for daily concrete requirements.
* Monitor scheduled concrete pours and ensure adequate RMC availability.
* Coordinate transit mixers, concrete pumps and delivery schedules wherever applicable.
* Track vehicle dispatches and delivery status during critical pours.
* Take immediate corrective action in case of delivery delays, plant breakdowns, traffic issues or supply shortages.
* Maintain backup arrangements for critical concrete requirements.
* Minimize waiting time, rejected loads and concrete wastage.

6\. Quality \& Technical Coordination

* Coordinate with QA/QC and Civil Engineering teams to ensure procurement is as per approved specifications.

Required Skills

or

“The detection accuracy drops because of lighting, camera angle, vibration, or carton variation. Should we solve it with AI, optics, lighting, hardware, or a combination of all four?”

You will get the opportunity to work on **real AI products deployed in warehouses and factories**, rather than only working on datasets or academic projects.

* Computer Vision
* Artificial Intelligence
* Edge AI
* NVIDIA Jetson
* Cameras and Machine Vision
* Hardware Integration
* Industrial Automation
* Real\-world AI deployment
* Product Development

You will work directly on building and improving products used by real customers and see your work move from an idea to a functioning system in the field.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a **builder, experimenter, and problem solver**.

If you enjoy AI but also want to connect cameras, test hardware, open devices, experiment with sensors, optimize edge computers, visit real sites, and figure out why something is not working—we would love to hear from you.

**This role is ideal for someone who wants to build real\-world AI systems, not just write code.**

title: Android Engineer
description:
The role
   

  

 Two offline\-first Android applications in under eight weeks — a Tamil\-first Farmer app and a Pilot app — running on real handsets in real fields, where most agricultural applications in India quietly fail. A full working day with no signal is a requirement, not an aspiration.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Own the Farmer app: onboarding and consent, pin\-drop and saved fields, booking, payment, invoice, proof media and history
* Own the Pilot app: offline job list, credential check\-in, custody capture, material draw, navigation, telemetry relay fallback, acreage and proof capture, collections and incident reporting
* Own releases, crash reporting, and the conflict policy — the server wins on money and custody, the device wins on captured media and timestamps, because the phone was there and the server was not
* Surface every conflict in an operations queue rather than resolving it silently
* Hit eight hours fully offline across six jobs, then a clean sync inside a three\-minute window on a poor connection — no lost media, no silent conflicts, no manual repair
* Get a first\-time farmer through a booking unaided in four minutes or less, observed in silence
* Hold crash\-free sessions above 99\.9 per cent, measured on rugged devices and on pilots’ own handsets — never on the developer’s phone


 Eligibility
   

  

* Three to five years of native Kotlin, with at least two apps published and live
* Offline\-first proven in production — sync, conflict handling, deletion semantics — and you can describe a conflict bug you shipped and then fixed
* Location, camera and push, and a crash\-reporting tool used properly
* Release discipline: version codes, signing, staged rollout
* You test on at least five real devices, not an emulator


 What you get
   

  

* Two applications owned outright, used by people you can go and watch
* Field visits to Erode during commissioning — the fastest known cure for writing software for an imagined farmer


 How the process runs
   

  

* Fill in the short form on this page.
* We read it ourselves. Every application is read.
* If we want to meet you, we call you.

description:
We are hiring an Human Resources Fresher who can support HR operations through data analysis, reporting, dashboards, and modern AI tools.
   

  

 This role is suitable for freshers or early\-career candidates who are interested in Human Resources, data analytics, Power BI, Excel/Google Sheets, and AI\-enabled work. The ideal candidate should not only understand HR processes but should also be comfortable working with data, creating reports, identifying patterns, and using AI tools to complete work faster and more accurately.
   

  

 The person will work closely with the HR team to analyze recruitment, employee, attendance, performance, and workforce data, build dashboards and reports, and use AI tools to improve speed, accuracy, and decision\-making.
   

  

**Core Job Responsibilities**
* HR Data Analysis \& Reporting Collect, clean, organize, and analyze HR data related to recruitment, employee records, attendance, onboarding, performance, attrition, and workforce planning.
* Power BI Dashboards \& MIS Reporting Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and MIS trackers using tools such as Power BI, Excel, Google Sheets, or similar reporting platforms.
* Recruitment Analytics Track hiring funnel metrics such as applications received, shortlisted candidates, interview status, offer rollout, joining status, turnaround time, source effectiveness, and drop\-off points.
* Workforce Analytics Analyze employee data to identify trends related to headcount, attrition, attendance, performance, engagement, skills, and manpower requirements.
* AI\-Assisted Workflows Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar platforms to speed up data cleaning, report writing, formula creation, dashboard planning, insight generation, documentation, and process improvement.
* Data Interpretation \& Business Insights Convert raw HR data into clear insights and summaries that help the HR team and business leaders make better decisions.
* HR Operations Support Support day\-to\-day HR operations such as onboarding tracking, employee documentation, HRMS data updates, employee query tracking, and process documentation.
* Automation \& Process Improvement Identify repetitive HR reporting or operational tasks and suggest ways to automate or simplify them using Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI, AI tools, or other workflow tools.
* Data Accuracy \& Quality Checks Validate reports and AI\-generated outputs to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability before sharing them with internal stakeholders.
* Data Privacy \& Responsible AI Use Handle employee and candidate data responsibly, maintaining confidentiality and ensuring AI tools are used carefully and ethically.


**Key Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong interest in HR analytics, people data, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, charts, filters, lookup functions, and data cleaning.
* Familiarity with Power BI or willingness to build dashboards using Power BI.
* Ability to interpret data and explain insights in simple business language.
* Hands\-on usage of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar tools for work\-related tasks.
* Ability to write clear prompts, verify AI\-generated outputs, and improve responses through iteration.
* Good communication skills and ability to present findings clearly.
* Strong attention to detail and comfort working with structured data.
* Curiosity to learn new HR tech, analytics tools, and automation methods.


**Preferred Skills**
* Knowledge of Power BI, Power Query, DAX, or dashboard creation.
* Basic understanding of SQL, Python, or data visualization concepts.
* Experience with HRMS, ATS, payroll systems, or employee management tools.
* Prior internship, academic project, or personal project involving data analysis, dashboards, or HR analytics.
* Experience using AI tools to create reports, clean data, generate formulas, summarize trends, or automate repetitive work.
* Understanding of recruitment, onboarding, attendance, performance management, or employee lifecycle processes.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* B.E. / B.Tech degree is Mandatory
* MBA degree is Mandatory
* Freshers are eligible to apply.
* Candidates with internships, projects, certifications, or practical exposure in HR analytics, Power BI, Excel, or AI tools will be preferred.

title: Sr. Manager - Employee Relations (International) - 2246
description:
**Job Summary**
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
 The Employee Relations (ER) Manager will be responsible for strengthening Medline’s International employee relations framework and practice by proactively addressing workplace issues, coaching managers \& employees, ensuring legal compliance, and promoting a culture of openness and fairness.
   

  

 This role will work in close collaboration with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) across all International markets to ensure consistent, timely, and effective handling of people matters and to enable managers to build high\-performing, compliant, and engaged teams.
   

  

 The role will also be accountable for managing investigations into cases raised via EthicsPoint (Medline´s case management system for concerns raised by employees).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Employee Relations \& Compliance Management**
 Act as an advisor to local HR teams on employee relations matters and partner with HRBPs for holistic case handling. Conduct fair, thorough, and unbiased investigations into workplace concerns, escalated via EthicsPoint or through other channels, domestic enquiry, grievances, misconduct, or policy violations, in accordance with Medline policy and with adherence to principles of natural justice. Maintain detailed case documentation, track trends, and share monthly insights with internal stakeholders. Partner with Legal on cases involving significant risk and ensure preventive risk mitigation. Liaisons with corporate ER and legal team for reporting and global process alignment Support statutory and internal audits related to employee relations, disciplinary actions, and compliance processes. Monitor adherence to HR policies and escalate deviations; recommend policy upgrades as needed. Manages the templates for formal communications that are outcomes of investigations and provides coaching \& guidance for local HR to complete them appropriately, in line with local requirements Provide guidance on the consistent application of disciplinary actions, PIPs, coaching plans, and corrective processes.
   

  

**Manager \& HRBP Enablement, Culture \& Process Strengthening**
 Upskill HRBPs and investigators around the management of the International investigation processes to ensure consistency and fairness in process Work closely with HRBPs to coach managers on handling performance issues, conflict resolution, conduct concerns, and difficult conversations. Build preventive ER capability through manager training, employee awareness sessions, playbooks, checklists, and communication resources. Strengthen team\-level trust, psychological safety, and communication by identifying patterns and early\-warning indicators. Collaborate with L\&D to embed ER best practices into manager development programs, including the facilitation of upskilling sessions for HR. Support HRBPs by reviewing performance documentation, PIP design, and ensuring process robustness. Partner with the international HR leadership team to identify, analyse and action plan recurring issues across our markets as an input to our employee relations agenda Ensure transparent, consistent, and timely communication with all stakeholders on ER matters.
   

  

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 15 years of experience in Employee Relations roles, with demonstrated capability to operate in multinational organizations
* Experience operating in multiple countries in the context of a global capability center (as a center of expertise that provides corporate guidance and coaching across markets)
* Strong communication skills, with ability to engage at senior leadership level with credibility and impact
* Track record in strong cross functional collaboration, including with Legal and Compliance stakeholders. Coaching, influencing, documentation and follow\-up must be strengths.
* Hands\-on experience in managing investigations and drafting formal legal notices and letters.


**About Medline India**
 Medline India was setup in 2010 in Pune, primarily as an offshore Development centre and to augment resources for Medline Industries LP headquartered in Chicago, USA. We are a 1500\+ strong and growing team of technology, finance \& and business support professionals who support our businesses worldwide towards a mission to make healthcare run better. We are proud to be certified as a ‘Great Place to Work’ by the Great Place to Work Institute® (India) for the duration May 2023 – May 2024\.
   

  

 We are an organization with a conducive work environment, ample opportunities to learn, contribute and grow with a highly empowered \& engaged team. We encourage our people to share their best ideas and create new opportunities for our customers and ourselves to work together to solve today’s toughest healthcare challenges.
   

  

**About Medline Industries, LP**
 Established in 1966, Medline Industries LP is a renowned global healthcare organization boasting 56 years of consecutive sales growth, exceeding $21 billion in annual sales. With a workforce of over 36,000 professionals spread across the globe, we operate in more than 125 countries and territories. As the largest privately held manufacturer and distributor of medical supplies in the United States, Medline is uniquely positioned to offer comprehensive products, education, and support across the continuum of care.
   

  

 At present, Medline Industries, LP holds the esteemed position as the \#1 market leader, delivering an extensive portfolio of over 550,000 medical products and clinical solutions. Our clientele includes hospitals, extended care facilities, surgery centres, physician offices, home care agencies, providers, and retailers. We are proud to be recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Large Employers and Best Employers for Women. Additionally, the Chicago Tribune has consistently named us a Top Workplace for the past 12 years.

We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: Sr Labor Relations Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission\-focused execution.
   

  

 Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.
   

  

 Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.
   

  

 Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.
   

  

 Honeywell Aerospace Products And Services Are Found On Aircraft Across Commercial Aviation, Defense And Space. We Operate Through Three Business Areas
   

  

* Electronic Solutions develops the avionics, navigation systems, sensors and electromagnetic defense technology on board 90% of the world's aircraft
* Engines \& Power Systems provides the propulsion, auxiliary power and electrical systems that keep those aircraft flying
* Control Systems supplies the thermal and motion control systems that support takeoff, landing and the safety of everyone on board


 With approximately 58,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17\.4B in 2025, we are also advancing systems for autonomous and supersonic platforms — bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com
   

  

 As a Labor and Employee Relations Manager at Honeywell Aerospace, you will lead labour and employee relations and labour compliance across our operations in India.
   

  

 This role will be a trusted advisor to business leaders, responsible for managing industrial relations risk, ensuring compliance with labour laws and statutory requirements, fostering positive employee relations, and building effective relationships with labour authorities and key stakeholders.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead labor and employee relations strategy across India operations.
* Develop and execute proactive employee engagement and union avoidance initiatives.
* Monitor labor relations risks and implement site\-specific mitigation plans.
* Manage union\-related activities, workforce concerns, grievances, disciplinary matters, and industrial relations issues.
* Support business restructuring, acquisitions, site expansions, and organizational change initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws, labor codes, and statutory requirements.
* Conduct labor compliance audits and employee relations assessments across sites.
* Manage contractor and vendor labor compliance programs, including audits and corrective actions.
* Oversee statutory filings, registrations, licenses, and labor compliance governance processes.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with labor authorities, government agencies, and regulatory bodies.
* Partner with Legal on labor disputes, employment litigation, government inspections, and regulatory inquiries.
* Lead investigations relating to employee relations, workplace conduct, and policy violations.
* Develop compliance dashboards, reporting mechanisms, and labor relations metrics.
* Provide strategic guidance to business leaders on labor relations, compliance risks, and workforce matters.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen labor relations, compliance, and employee experience across India operations.


**Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in Labour Relations, Industrial relations or similar field
* Strong experience in supporting manufacturing or industrial environments
* Strong knowledge of labor laws and regulations
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to build and maintain positive relationships with employees
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Labor Relations, or related field


**WE VALUE**
* Leadership, problem and conflict solving skills
* Attention to detail, analytical skills, process orientation
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information

description:

 You are someone who thrives in a high\-performance environment, bringing a growth mindset and entrepreneurial spirit to tackle meaningful challenges that have a real impact.
   

  

 In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we’ll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities to help you quickly broaden your expertise, grow into a well\-rounded professional, and contribute to work that truly makes a difference.
   

  

 When you join us, you will have:
   

  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* Exceptional benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.


**Your Impact**
 Leveraging your expertise in talent management and stakeholder collaboration, you will drive the Professional Development domain operations and actively support the execution of our core Talent/PD strategy for the global VG\&Media function.
   

  

 As a member of the HR\&Talent and VG\&Media People \& Culture teams, you will apply your end\-to\-end program management and planning skills to spearhead initiatives and PD operations to ultimately advance our talent objectives. You will be recognized and relied upon as a subject matter expert in the professional development domain.
   

  

 You will leverage a core set of capabilities to drive the following outcomes:
   

  

**Talent Strategy Design \& Execution**
 Apply Business Acumen: Translate functional business strategies into actionable talent priorities, defining and executing targeted talent measures within the VG\&Media function.
   

  

 Leverage Organizational Design: Maintain and administer the path talent architecture, including defining role progressions, mapping skill codes, and structuring clear career paths.
   

  

 Drive Stakeholder Alignment: Partner with key functional leaders to build clarity and consensus on overarching talent and performance management strategies.
   

  

**Professional Development Domain Management**
 Provide Strategic Advisory \& Coaching: Serve as a trusted advisor to people leaders and individuals, offering expert counsel on career development, review and recognition cycles, and navigating performance issues (integrating subject matter experts to resolve complex challenges).
   

  

 Execute Operational Excellence: Independently lead and seamlessly execute developmental milestones, Annual Reviews, and essential PD operations across VG\&Media.
   

  

 Facilitate \& Influence: Convene and guide VG\&Media managers to align on professional development strategies, share best practices, and cultivate a culture of continuous growth.
   

  

**Project Management**
 Drive Strategic Projects: Drive and manage cross\-cutting HR\&Talent initiatives that reinforce and scale the broader talent strategy across the global VG\&Media function.
   

  

 Optimize Global Processes: Champion consistency across people processes by scaling and standardizing best practices for annual reviews and ongoing performance management.
   

  

**Data Management \& Insights\-driven Collaboration**
 Apply Analytical Problem\-Solving: Analyze people and team metrics (e.g., advancement data, historical performance trends) to uncover insights that directly inform and shape our talent strategy.
   

  

 Drive Data\-Informed Interventions: Track progress against developmental milestones, proactively identify core challenges, and architect creative solutions to achieve key PD outcomes in VG\&Media. Ensure Data Integrity: Manage core organizational data accuracy within firm systems (e.g., MyDev).
   

  

 You will be based in Chennai or Bangalore, two of our primary India centers supporting the VG\&Media function.
   

  

**Your Qualifications and Skills**
* 5\+ years of experience in shaping talent strategy and developing people, either through direct people leadership or as a subject matter expert
* Demonstrated ability to confidently advise, build trust, and establish credibility with leadership at multiple levels
* Capable of driving cross\-functional strategic initiatives from conception to execution, managing change, and ensuring global consistency
* Proficiency in analysing people metrics to uncover actionable insights, inform strategic decisions, and solve complex organizational challenges
* Exceptional written and verbal communication abilities, with a proven capability to partner effectively across diverse, global teams and functions
* High level of self\-direction and organization, capable of managing competing priorities and delivering results in a complex, largely autonomous work environment

title: HR Analytics Associate-B.Tech + MBA
description:
A great entry\-level opportunity for
 **B.E./B. Tech \+ MBA** 
 graduates passionate about HR, data, and AI.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are hiring a Human Resources Fresher who can support HR operations through data analysis, reporting, dashboards, and modern AI tools.
   

  

 This role is suitable for freshers or early\-career candidates who are interested in Human Resources, data analytics, Power BI, Excel/Google Sheets, and AI\-enabled work. The ideal candidate should not only understand HR processes but also be comfortable working with data, creating reports, identifying patterns, and using AI tools to complete work faster and more accurately.
   

  

 The person will work closely with the HR team to analyze recruitment, employee, attendance, performance, and workforce data, build dashboards and reports, and use AI tools to improve speed, accuracy, and decision\-making.
   

  

**Eligibility Criteria**
* B.E./B.Tech \+ MBA — both degrees required
* Freshers are eligible to apply
* Candidates with internships, projects, certifications, or practical exposure in HR analytics, Power BI, Excel, or AI tools will be preferred


**Core Job Responsibilities**
**HR Data Analysis \& Reporting** 
 — Collect, clean, organize, and analyze HR data related to recruitment, employee records, attendance, onboarding, performance, attrition, and workforce planning.
   

  

**Power BI Dashboards \& MIS Reporting** 
 — Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and MIS trackers using tools such as Power BI, Excel, Google Sheets, or similar reporting platforms.
   

  

**Recruitment Analytics** 
 — Track hiring funnel metrics such as applications received, shortlisted candidates, interview status, offer rollout, joining status, turnaround time, source effectiveness, and drop\-off points.
   

  

**Workforce Analytics** 
 — Analyze employee data to identify trends related to headcount, attrition, attendance, performance, engagement, skills, and manpower requirements.
   

  

**AI\-Assisted Workflows** 
 — Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar platforms to speed up data cleaning, report writing, formula creation, dashboard planning, insight generation, documentation, and process improvement.
   

  

**Data Interpretation \& Business Insights** 
 — Convert raw HR data into clear insights and summaries that help the HR team and business leaders make better decisions.
   

  

**HR Operations Support** 
 — Support day\-to\-day HR operations such as onboarding tracking, employee documentation, HRMS data updates, employee query tracking, and process documentation.
   

  

**Automation \& Process Improvement** 
 — Identify repetitive HR reporting or operational tasks and suggest ways to automate or simplify them using Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI, AI tools, or other workflow tools.
   

  

**Data Accuracy \& Quality Checks** 
 — Validate reports and AI\-generated outputs to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability before sharing them with internal stakeholders.
   

  

**Data Privacy \& Responsible AI Use** 
 — Handle employee and candidate data responsibly, maintaining confidentiality and ensuring AI tools are used carefully and ethically.
   

  

**Key Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong interest in HR analytics, people data, and data\-driven decision\-making
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, charts, filters, lookup functions, and data cleaning
* Familiarity with Power BI, or willingness to build dashboards using Power BI
* Ability to interpret data and explain insights in simple business language
* Hands\-on usage of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar tools for work\-related tasks
* Ability to write clear prompts, verify AI\-generated outputs, and improve responses through iteration
* Good communication skills and ability to present findings clearly
* Strong attention to detail and comfort working with structured data
* Curiosity to learn new HR tech, analytics tools, and automation methods


**Preferred Skills**
* Knowledge of Power BI, Power Query, DAX, or dashboard creation
* Basic understanding of SQL, Python, or data visualization concepts
* Experience with HRMS, ATS, payroll systems, or employee management tools
* Prior internship, academic project, or personal project involving data analysis, dashboards, or HR analytics
* Experience using AI tools to create reports, clean data, generate formulas, summarize trends, or automate repetitive work
* Understanding of recruitment, onboarding, attendance, performance management, or employee lifecycle processes

description:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

**About The Data Catalog Team**
* The Data Catalog team is the semantic intelligence layer of Rippling's platform. Our mission is to make Rippling's data schema — spanning millions of fields across every product — discoverable, trustworthy, and actionable for both humans and AI. We are the authoritative source of truth for "data about data" within Rippling.
* We sit at the intersection of platform infrastructure and AI, powering core product surfaces like Workflow Automator, Reports, Supergroups, and Data Manager, while increasingly serving as the data backbone for Rippling's AI products — including the AI Assistant and AI Field Selection features.


**What We Build**
 The team delivers across four strategic pillars:
   

  

* Data Discoverability: Catalog browse, search, and field\-selection experiences used throughout Rippling, enabling users to find the most relevant data for their use case across a vast and growing schema.
* Data Enrichment: AI\-generated semantic descriptions, glossary tagging, sampled values, usage signals, and RQL formula examples — adding business context that makes raw schema meaningful.
* Data Governance: PII classification, sensitive data flagging, compliance tagging, and integration with access controls and auditing infrastructure.
* Data Lifecycle: Upstream and downstream dependency tracking, lineage visualization, and event\-driven metadata sync to ensure the Catalog stays live and accurate as Rippling's data model evolves.


**What You Will Need**
* 2\+ years of professional experience with a focus on Backend development, demonstrating the ability to deliver reliable, end\-to\-end products using a backend language (e.g., Python/Go).
* Demonstrated ability to deliver reliable, well\-scoped projects end\-to\-end with a high standard of quality.
* Prioritize projects based on business impact, ensuring high\-quality implementation without unnecessary complexity.
* Ability to thrive in dynamic environments, quickly switching context between frontend and backend work as needed to accelerate delivery
* Strong engineering judgment: ability to translate open\-ended requirements into clean technical designs and make pragmatic trade\-offs.
* Clear, concise communication of technical ideas — in design documents, code reviews, and cross\-functional discussions.
* Growth mindset: you proactively seek feedback, act on it, and hold yourself accountable to continuous improvement.


****Bonus:****
* Working experience on frontend components for your own projects on and frontend technologies like React/TypeScript
* Experience with search infrastructure (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or similar).
* Exposure to AI/ML\-adjacent systems — LLM integrations, semantic embeddings, or metadata enrichment pipelines.
* Familiarity with data governance concepts: PII classification, data lineage, or access control systems.


**Additional Information**
 Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com
   

  

 Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.
