The Admin Agentic Experiences team owns a strategic, board\-visible bet: making the administrator experience agentic, so that IT professionals can reason, plan, and act across Copilot, Agents, and Microsoft 365 with the trust, safety, and auditability enterprises require.
   

  

 We are looking for a customer\-obsessed, analytical Product Manager to own a major slice of the Admin Agentic Experiences charter end to end, from strategy through shipped experience. The product is at an inflection point: we are moving from an experience that primarily informs to one that reasons, plans, and acts across Microsoft 365 workloads, at the trust, safety, and auditability bar enterprises require.
   

  

 Administrators are the decisive gatekeepers of Copilot and Agents adoption. They decide when a capability is safe, compliant, and ready to roll out. Your work will close the reasoning and actionability gaps these admins are explicitly asking for, and will span scenarios that reach across Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, Copilot, Commerce, Message Center, Service Health, and more. The scope carries real ambiguity and demands influence well beyond your own team, so you should be comfortable setting direction where none exists yet and bringing partner teams along with you.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the strategy\-to\-execution plan for high\-frequency, high\-impact admin scenarios, and define what success looks like in measurable terms.
* Engage directly with IT administrators and partners to understand their jobs to be done, and translate that understanding into agentic experiences that reason, plan, and act.
* Define AI\-powered experiences that meet the enterprise bar for trust, safety, grounding, and auditability, working closely with responsible AI and compliance partners.
* Drive cross\-domain orchestration with the Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, Copilot, Commerce, and Message Center and Service Health teams to expand persona and scenario coverage.
* Partner with data science and analytics teams to build the telemetry, evaluation, and quality loops that show whether the agent is genuinely helping admins.
* Refine and scope front\-end requirements from deep empathy for the admin journey, delivering experiences that feel simple even when the underlying orchestration is not.
* Build strong working relationships with engineering teams across geographies, and hold a clear bar for on\-time, high\-quality delivery.
* Drive the operational processes for capturing, prioritizing, and removing adoption blockers, and connect the work to downstream outcomes such as Copilot license assignment, sustained usage, and support incident deflection.
* Support our goals for diversity and inclusion through everyday actions and communications.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in technical or business discipline, or equivalent work experience.
* 4 to 7 years of product management experience, including running complex matrixed programs with detailed product definition and interpersonal negotiation.
* Hands\-on experience with AI and current developments in the field, including practical exposure to building or shipping AI\-powered experiences.
* Demonstrated ability to use data to influence and drive decisions.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Microsoft 365 administration, enterprise IT management, or adjacent control\-plane products, and an understanding of what enterprise administrators are accountable for.
* Knowledge of agentic or conversational AI systems, including orchestration, grounding, evaluation, and the trust and safety considerations that come with taking action on a customer's behalf.
* Proven track record of going technically deep and delivering cloud\-scale technologies.
* Skill in navigating complex organizational structures with loose affiliations and competing priorities, and in negotiating common ground to drive prioritization of key deliverables.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to listen, distill information into insights, and tailor the message to different audiences from engineers to executives.
* Experience with prototyping or wireframing tools to communicate ideas quickly to stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and make progress in ambiguous environments.
* This is a chance to shape how millions of administrators run Microsoft 365 in an agentic world, on a charter with executive visibility and a real user base. You will work with a growth\-minded group of product managers, engineers, and designers who care as much about the craft of the experience as about the metrics it moves. If you want to take an early\-traction product to the next inflection point and grow considerably while doing it, this is the role. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.
* \#CAPJOBS \#A365JOBS


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. title: Founder's Office
description:
**Founder’s Office** 




**Genloop · Full\-time · In\-office** 




  





**About Genloop** 




  





 Genloop is a data intelligence OS that connects to a company’s data estate, understands its business context, and enables analytics, reporting, and AI workflows for business users.
 



  





 The hard part isn’t putting a chat interface on top of data. It’s making the answers trustworthy. Genloop is ranked \#1 on Spider 2\.0 at 97% accuracy, and enterprises use our platform across real operational workflows, including thousands of retail stores.
 



  





 We’re a small, fast\-moving team. There are always more important problems than people available to solve them.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 This is a Founder’s Office role for an AI\-native operator.
 



  





 You’ll work directly with the founder and own some of the highest\-leverage problems in the company. Those problems will change as Genloop grows.
 



  





 One month you might build our content GTM. The next, automate an internal workflow. The next, ship a small internal product.
 



  





 You won’t wait for detailed briefs. You’ll understand the objective, figure out what needs to happen, and own the outcome.
 



  





 Our operating philosophy:
 



  





**Own it → systematize it → automate it → move to the next harder problem.** 




  





 We don’t want you to become great at repetitive work. We want you to eliminate it and keep moving toward higher\-order problems.
 



  





 Your first projects
 



  





**1\. Content GTM** 




  





 Own and build Genloop’s content engine across SEO, AEO, technical content, founder\-led content, and distribution. Figure out what our buyers are searching and asking AI about, create content that wins those conversations, and build systems to scale it.
 



  





**2\. Internal tooling \& automation** 




  





 Find repetitive workflows across the company and automate them. Build lightweight internal products using AI agents, APIs, scripts, no\-code tools, or code. If a tool you need doesn’t exist, you should be excited to build it.
 



  





**3\. Whatever matters next** 




  





 Customer research. Product experiments. GTM. Competitive intelligence. Messaging. Special projects.
 



  





 The task will change. Ownership won’t.
 



  





**What we’re looking for** 




  





**High agency:** 
 You see a problem and move toward it without waiting for a checklist.
 



  





**Entrepreneurial:** 
 You’re comfortable wearing multiple hats and operating with incomplete information.
 



  





**AI\-native:** 
 Using ChatGPT every day isn’t enough. You naturally ask: Why am I doing this manually? Can I automate 80% of it? Can I build a system for it?
 



  





**Builder:** 
 You like making things, whether that’s an automation, internal tool, landing page, content engine, workflow, or small product.
 



  





**Strong communicator:** 
 You can understand something complicated and explain it simply.
 



  





**Fast learner:** 
 You’ll regularly work on things you’ve never done before.
 



  





**Outcome\-oriented:** 
 You care about what changed, not how busy you were.
 



  





**You might be a fit if** 




  





 \* You have 1–4 years of experience in a startup, product, growth, engineering, consulting, Founder’s Office, or another high\-ownership environment
 



 \* You’ve built side projects, automations, tools, or products because you wanted them to exist
 



 \* You use AI deeply and constantly experiment with better ways of working
 



 \* You can write clearly and communicate across technical and business teams
 



 \* Ambiguity gives you energy rather than frustration
 



 \* You want unusually broad exposure to building a startup
 



  





 Exceptional fresh graduates with strong evidence of building and ownership should also apply.
 



  





**Probably not a fit if** 




  





 \* You need a detailed task list every week
 



 \* You want to stay inside one narrow function
 



 \* You prefer strategy while someone else executes
 



 \* You’re uncomfortable aggressively adopting AI and automation
 



 \* You want the Founder’s Office title more than the accountability that comes with it
 



  





**What you’ll get** 




  





 \* Work directly with the founder on company\-level problems
 



 \* Exposure across GTM, product, growth, research, and operations
 



 \* Autonomy to build systems and products, not just execute processes
 



 \* Access to the AI tools and software you need to move fast
 



 \* Increasingly difficult problems as you grow
 



  





**The reward for automating your job is a harder problem**

title: AI Product Manager - India
description:
At Dscout, we're building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world's top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us.
   

  

 We're looking for an
 **AI Product Manager** 
 who brings the full standard PM toolkit — user research, market and competitive analysis, roadmap and strategy, cross\-functional delivery, and strong collaboration instincts \- and applies it to products where the model underneath doesn't behave the same way twice. You have a real, hands\-on feel for what different LLMs are actually good and bad at, and you use that to prototype ideas yourself, sometimes shipping small, production\-quality AI features directly. You default to ownership: of the roadmap, of outcomes, of the quality bar that decides whether something's actually ready to ship, and of what an agent should be trusted to do on its own versus when a human needs to stay in the loop.
   

  

 That's because building AI\-native products means quality is a distribution, not a pass/fail — a feature can work correctly most of the time and still need a real answer for the failure tail, since the underlying system is non\-deterministic, not just complex.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Lead the roadmap and strategy for your product area, from problem discovery through delivery and post\-launch iteration
* Lead the evaluation bar for the model\-powered surfaces you're responsible for: define eval sets, identify failure modes, and know the rollback plan before a change ships
* Prototype product ideas directly using your own understanding of model strengths and weaknesses, and ship small, production\-quality AI features yourself when that's the fastest path to learning
* Lead product decisions about agent autonomy: what the agent should be trusted to decide and act on independently, what needs a human in the loop, and how that line should move as trust in the system grows
* Treat prompting and context design as a product lever you use directly to shape behavior
* Partner with engineers on technical architecture with enough depth to challenge assumptions, propose alternatives, and influence design decisions
* Partner with Design and Research on UX so features are genuinely usable and understandable, not just technically correct
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success around releases — shaping GTM messaging, training, and rollout, and closing the loop on adoption signal afterward
* Track the metrics that actually matter for a non\-deterministic system — quality/accuracy distribution, latency, cost\-per\-task — alongside the usual adoption and growth metrics


 What you bring
   

  

* 2\-5 years of product management experience owning a roadmap end\-to\-end, from strategy through shipped outcomes
* Direct experience shipping AI/LLM\-powered features in production, including owning evaluation and quality decisions for them
* A real, hands\-on feel for what different LLMs and model families are good and bad at, and the ability to prototype against that understanding rather than treating "AI" as a black box
* Real technical depth: comfortable in architecture discussions, and able to reason about tradeoffs (model choice, latency, cost, deterministic vs. LLM\-based logic) as a peer to the engineers you work with
* Comfort defining and reasoning about eval sets and failure modes, and treating quality as a property of a non\-deterministic system rather than a binary pass/fail
* Experience partnering cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success around releases to connect product decisions to business growth
* A high ownership mindset: treating outcomes, not deliverables, as the responsibility
* You live in AI tools like Codex, Claude, OpenClaw, Cursor, or similar, and you've built your own personal agents or automated workflows with them
* Experience shipping features within strict privacy, security, and compliance constraints — treating what the system can retain, or send to a third party as a first\-class product decision, not an afterthought.


 Nice to have
   

  

* Experience with LLM observability/eval tooling (e.g., Braintrust, LangSmith)
* Background in a technical role (engineering, data science) before moving into product
* Experience in B2B, ideal if a market adjacent to UX/market research or insights/feedback
* Comfortable with how a lot of our AI features actually get built: fast prototypes/spikes that get real usage early, then get hardened directly into the product when they land, rather than a big\-spec\-first process


 Of course, what is outlined above is an ideal set of expectations; however, business needs and other projects and tasks may shift, and additional tasks could be assigned at the discretion of your manager. If this role excites you but you're not sure you check every box, we'd still love to hear from you.
   

  

**Note:** 
 Some of the benefits listed below apply
 **only** 
 to U.S.\-based employees. We offer a similarly competitive benefits program in the UK with many comparable offerings, which we'll be happy to share with you during the interview process.
   

  

 Of course, what is outlined above is an ideal set of expectations; however, business needs and other projects and tasks may shift, and additional tasks could be assigned at the discretion of your manager.
   

  

**About Dscout**
 Dscout is a team of passionate, empathetic, and curious professionals. As a recognized leader in the Forrester Wave, we're at the cutting edge of experience research technology. The power of research drives us \- how in\-context insights from real people can build more enjoyable products and services.
   

  

 We prioritize learning, sharing, and building. We also deeply value being a diverse and inclusive team and company and look for team members who align with that belief. Join our dynamic team and help shape product roadmaps and business strategies for the world's most loved brands.
   

  

 It doesn't stop there. When you join the Dscout team, you will get:
   

  

* A strong and competitive compensation package with a built\-in bonus and equity program.
* An incredible and progressive benefits package (for both you and your dependents) to support work/life balance, including flexible PTO, 15 company holidays, 12 weeks of paid parental leave, 401k match, and much more.
* An education stipend to support your growth \& development, and a remote work stipend.
* A company that is open and transparent with our team. You will know what is happening and why it matters.


 Dscout is an equal\-opportunity employer that values diversity. We do not discriminate based on identity, including race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex, gender identity and expression, age, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, veteran or military status, unfavorable discharge from military service, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, order of protection status, citizenship status, arrest record or expunged or sealed convictions, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.
   

  

 If you need reasonable accommodations for any part of the employment process, please email us at accommodations@dscout.com with the nature of your request and your contact information. We'll do everything possible to ensure you're well\-prepared for success during our interview process, while also upholding your privacy, including accommodating any special requests. Please note that only inquiries regarding requests for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.
   

  

 When you apply at Dscout, we will process your job applicant data, including your employment and education history, transcript, writing samples, and references, as necessary to consider your job application for open positions. For more information about our privacy practices, please visit our Privacy Policy.
   

  

 Dscout participates in the E\-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.
   

  

**Location Flexibility:** 
 Dscout is proud to support a remote\-first workforce and enable employees to work from almost anywhere. At this time, however, we are unable to hire in the following locations: Montana, Hawaii, Alaska, and Washington DC.
   

  

**NOTE: DSCOUT NEVER CONTACTS JOB APPLICANTS VIA TEXT, MESSENGER, OR OTHER SIMILAR APPLICATIONS. BE AWARE OF PHISHING AND SPOOFING SCAMS, BOTH VIA TEXT AND EMAIL. ONLY RESPOND TO EMAILS FROM DSCOUT.COM**

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**About Atlys**
 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
   

  

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
 **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries** 
 . But we’re still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 We’re looking for a
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to own a critical part of the Atlys product and turn complex travel workflows into simple, scalable experiences.
   

  

 You’ll define the product direction, understand where users struggle, make the right trade\-offs and work closely with Engineering, Design and other teams to ship products that improve conversion, reliability and customer experience.
   

  

 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who can operate across strategy and execution, navigate ambiguity, and build products that work across markets, edge cases and rapidly changing requirements.
   

  

**The Job**
* Own product strategy and roadmap for a critical product area, defining priorities based on customer needs, business impact and long\-term product direction.
* Simplify complex user journeys by identifying friction, redesigning flows and building experiences that are intuitive, reliable and easy to scale.
* Drive growth and conversion through experimentation, funnel optimisation and product improvements across acquisition, onboarding and core journeys.
* Build products that scale globally by accounting for different destinations, requirements, compliance constraints and operational edge cases.
* Lead cross\-functional execution by partnering closely with Engineering, Design and other teams to define scope, make trade\-offs and ship high\-quality products quickly.


**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Have 5\+ years of product management experience, ideally in consumer technology, fintech, travel, mobility or another complex product environment.
* Have strong product judgment and a track record of owning meaningful product areas and improving core user journeys.
* Are highly analytical and comfortable using data, experimentation and customer insights to make product decisions.
* Can simplify complex workflows, edge cases and operational constraints into clear and intuitive product experiences.
* Have strong ownership, prioritisation and execution skills, and can work effectively with Engineering, Design and cross\-functional stakeholders.


**What You Can Expect**
 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
   

  

**Here’s What You Can Expect**
* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
   

  

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Associate Delivery Manager
description:
Overview of 66degrees
   

  

 66degrees is an end\-to\-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point," where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential.
   

  

 At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.
   

  

**Overview Of Role**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and collaborative Associate Delivery Manager with a strong Agile and Scrum background to support the successful delivery of customer\-facing technology programs across cloud, data, AI, analytics, and application development initiatives.
   

  

 This role is ideal for professionals with approximately 3\+ years of experience who have worked as a Scrum Master, Project Coordinator, Agile Delivery Lead, Technical Project Coordinator, or Associate Project Manager and are looking to grow into broader Delivery Management responsibilities.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will play a key role in facilitating Agile delivery, coordinating cross\-functional teams, removing delivery impediments, and ensuring timely execution of project milestones. You will partner closely with Delivery Managers, Product Owners, Architects, Engineering teams, and customers to deliver high\-quality technology solutions while continuously improving Agile maturity and delivery excellence. In addition to supporting larger and more complex programs, you will also have the opportunity to independently manage smaller customer engagements as the Delivery Manager, taking ownership of planning, execution, stakeholder communication, and successful delivery.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Coordination**
* Support the successful delivery of software, cloud, data, AI, and application development projects.
* Coordinate sprint execution, release planning, project tracking, and delivery milestones.
* Assist Delivery Managers in monitoring project health, risks, dependencies, and delivery schedules.
* Track project progress, team capacity, resource allocation, and delivery metrics.
* Escalate delivery risks and blockers proactively while driving timely resolution.
* Ensure project documentation, governance artifacts, and status reports are maintained accurately.
* Support multiple concurrent Agile projects and distributed engineering teams.
* Independently manage smaller customer engagements as the Delivery Manager, owning end\-to\-end delivery including planning, execution, stakeholder communication, risk management, and successful project outcomes.
* Balance responsibilities across independently managed engagements while providing delivery support to larger, strategic programs led by senior Delivery Managers.


**Agile Delivery \& Scrum Leadership**
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, Backlog Refinement, and Sprint Retrospectives.
* Coach Scrum teams on Agile principles, Scrum values, and continuous improvement practices.
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain healthy product backlogs and sprint priorities.
* Track sprint progress, velocity, burndown charts, and release readiness.
* Identify delivery bottlenecks and work with teams to remove impediments.
* Foster accountability, collaboration, transparency, and ownership across Agile teams.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on retrospective outcomes and delivery metrics.


**Project Governance \& Reporting**
* Prepare project status reports, dashboards, and delivery metrics for stakeholders.
* Monitor sprint health, schedule adherence, defect leakage, resource utilization, and delivery milestones.
* Maintain project plans, RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), and action trackers.
* Ensure compliance with delivery governance standards and organizational processes.
* Support forecasting activities, release planning, and sprint commitments.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and customer teams.
* Communicate project status, delivery progress, risks, and mitigation plans effectively.
* Coordinate cross\-functional activities to ensure alignment between business and engineering teams.
* Support customer meetings, sprint demos, governance reviews, and project updates.
* Serve as the primary Delivery Manager and customer point of contact for smaller engagements, ensuring effective stakeholder communication, governance, and customer satisfaction.
* Maintain a customer\-first mindset throughout project execution.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Promote Agile best practices across delivery teams.
* Encourage knowledge sharing, collaboration, and process improvements.
* Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, predictability, and team productivity.
* Contribute to organizational Agile maturity initiatives.
* Support Delivery Managers in implementing operational excellence initiatives.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Project Coordinator, Associate Project Manager, Delivery Coordinator, or similar role, with demonstrated ability or readiness to independently manage smaller customer engagements.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, Scrum framework, Kanban, and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and managing sprint execution.
* Hands\-on experience working with cross\-functional software engineering teams.
* Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Experience using Agile project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of Agile metrics including Sprint Velocity, Burndown Charts, Cycle Time, Lead Time, Defect Leakage, Resource Utilization, Schedule Adherence, and Delivery Milestones.
* Experience coordinating multiple workstreams within Agile projects.
* Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving and conflict\-resolution abilities.
* Ability to work effectively in fast\-paced, collaborative environments.
* Exposure to cloud technologies (Google Cloud Platform, AWS, or Azure) is preferred.
* Exposure to AI, Data, Analytics, or Application Development projects is an added advantage.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), SAFe Scrum Master, or equivalent Agile certification.
* Experience working in consulting, professional services, or customer\-facing organizations.
* Exposure to cloud migration, AI/ML, data modernization, analytics, or digital transformation projects.
* Experience supporting distributed or global engineering teams.
* Familiarity with delivery governance, release management, and Agile reporting.
* Experience independently managing small to mid\-sized customer engagements or end\-to\-end project delivery is preferred.
* Passion for coaching Agile teams and driving continuous improvement.


***Please note, we cannot sponsor or transfer any visas, of any kind, at this time.***
*66degrees is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.*

 As an AI transformation partner, 66degrees leverages intelligent solutions to enhance our recruitment experience. We utilize AI tools—including LinkedIn Recruiter’s Hiring Assistant and interview transcription technologies—to assist with sourcing, role analysis, and capturing interview highlights.

title: Visual Designer / Graphic Designer
description:
The Global Voice is an independent geopolitics media house. We report on the forces reshaping the world, including conflict, diplomacy, economy, and power, from an Indian point of view rather than a borrowed one, a perspective largely missing from global coverage that defaults to the West.
 



  





 We are committed to challenging established narratives and questioning convenient truths. The Global Voice aims to highlight underrepresented viewpoints and bring forward the side of the story that rarely makes the front page.
 



  





**THE ROLE** 




  





 This is an in\-office, founding team role based out of Goa.
 



  





 You will define how The Global Voice looks across every platform it exists on. Social posts, thumbnails, infographics, newsletter headers, article images, podcast covers, brand assets. You are not decorating content, you are making it more powerful.
 



  





**SALARY:** 
 3\.6 LPA
 



**JOINING DATE:** 
 BY END OF AUGUST, IN GOA
 



**EXPERIENCE:** 
 0\-3 YEARS
 



 (Please apply only if you're comfortable with the role, location, and expectations outlined)
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 




  




* Design social media content across Instagram, LinkedIn, and X. Multiple finished assets, daily.
* Create article feature images, YouTube thumbnails, and podcast cover art that people actually click
* Build infographics and data visualisations that make geopolitical complexity readable and shareable
* Own and evolve the TGV design system including colours, typography, layout grids, and component templates
* Design newsletter headers, email banners, and all email visual assets
* Collaborate with the video editor on motion graphics, title cards, and lower thirds
* Use AI\-assisted tools where useful (background removal, upscaling, reference/ideation) but final assets must be your own work. No fully AI\-generated final art, no Midjourney/DALL\-E/Firefly output passed off as finished design. We check for this.



  





**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




  




* NIFT graduates or design school freshers with a strong portfolio
* A strong portfolio. We want to see editorial design, social content at scale, and brand work. All three
* Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite including Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign
* A clear editorial design sensibility. Your work should look like a news brand, not a lifestyle brand
* The ability to produce multiple polished social assets in a morning without quality dropping, by hand
* Understanding of what works visually on each platform and designs that reflect that understanding
* Willingness to grow into video editing as the work demands it
* You can join us in Goa by the end of August



  





**WHO WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR** 




  




* Designers who lean on AI tools to generate or finish their work
* Designers who make things that look nice but do not perform
* People who need a week to turn around a social post
* People who do not understand what editorial design means or why it is different



  





**30 DAYS IN** 




  





 Every platform, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, the newsletter, has assets that look like they belong to the same brand. You've turned the brand direction into an actual design system, colours, type, grids, templates, and it's documented somewhere other than your head. You're a day or two ahead of the content calendar instead of designing same\-day. At least one thumbnail or infographic you've made has already outperformed the rest, and you know what made it work.
 



  





**60 DAYS IN** 




  





 You can point to a specific thumbnail or infographic and the numbers it moved, a click rate, a save count, a share. The design system is holding up without you re\-explaining it for every new asset. Someone can look at three posts from three different platforms and know they're all TGV without seeing the logo. You're the one flagging new formats to try, not waiting to be asked.
 



  





 Applications without proof of work will not be considered.

* Strong foundational experience with Azure Data Services and data platform modernization initiatives
* Handson exposure to Data Warehouse and analytics using platforms like Microsoft Fabric, and Azure Synapse Analytics; Azure Databricks is a plus
* Experience/knowledge of one or more SQL and NoSQL database systems
* Hands\-on experience building AI\-powered data pipelines using ETL/ELT tools like:
* Azure Data Factory (ADF), SSIS, Talend, Informatica, Airflow
* Exposure to data migrations, platform upgrades, and modernization efforts
* Understanding of multitenant data platform designs, basic security hardening, and access control concepts
* Knowledge of Big Data ecosystems like Spark, Databricks, Kafka, Hadoop, etc.


 AI / ML Foundations
   

  

* Experience building or supporting ML ready datasets and basic feature engineering
* Exposure to operationalizing ML pipelines and MLOps concepts, on Azure stack
* Foundational knowledge of:
* Large Language Models (LLMs)
* Model training, evaluation, and deployment workflows
* Azure cloud and AI stack like Azure Foundry, Azure OpenAI, etc
* Handson experience or knowledge in one or more of:
* NLP, Document Intelligence \& Indexing
* Computer Vision
* RAG frameworks or AI Search
* Basic understanding of Prompt Engineering
* Exposure to or knowledge of deep learning/Gen AI frameworks such as TensorFlow/PyTorch, and orchestration frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph
* Familiarity with Responsible AI principles – fairness, interpretability, and governance


 Engineering Practices \& Delivery
   

  

* Experience working in Agile teams with knowledge of/exposure to Azure DevOps
* Understanding of DataOps and MLOps practices, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment workflows, preferably on Azure Foundry
* Knowledge of secure coding practices, observability basics, and performance considerations
* Handson programming experience, preferably in Python

* Comfortable working in ambiguous environments, learning quickly, and adapting to change

description:
**Company Description** 
 Dev Information Technology Ltd. (DEV IT) is a global technology company listed on NSE and BSE, with nearly three decades of experience delivering innovative IT solutions. As a CMMI Maturity Level 5 organization with ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certifications, DEV IT focuses on high\-quality, predictable outcomes for clients worldwide. The company leads digital transformation through its ABCD framework: AI, Blockchain, Cybersecurity, and Datacentres \& Infrastructure, supported by strong cloud, application, and managed IT services. DEV IT is a Microsoft Solutions Partner, AWS Advanced Services Partner, and Adobe Partner, working with over 1000 professionals across India and Canada. Headquartered in Ahmedabad, the organization follows a “People First, Business Always” philosophy and offers opportunities to work on cutting\-edge cloud and digital initiatives.
 



  





**Website:** 
**http://www.devitpl.com/**




**Designation: Azure Cloud Architect** 




**Experience: 10\+ years** 




**Location:** 
**Fully remote, open across India.** 




  





**About the role** 




  





**We manage production Azure estates for enterprise customers and we're hiring an architect who can design it and stand behind it when it breaks. This is a hands\-on infrastructure architecture role. You will own how the platform is built, how it is secured, how it recovers, and how much it costs. You will be expected to know the version numbers running in your own environment and to explain the reasoning behind every tool in the stack.** 




  





**What you'll own** 



* **Infrastructure design end to end:** 
 Compute, storage account architecture (tier, redundancy, lifecycle, firewall and private endpoint design), managed disk selection and performance tuning, VNet topology, hybrid connectivity, and Azure Arc for servers and Kubernetes outside Azure.
* **Disaster recovery you have actually tested:** 
 Define RTO/RPO with the business, design the DR topology, build it in Azure Site Recovery and Azure Backup, and run real failover and failback drills. Documented\-but\-never\-executed DR is a failure state here.
* **Automation as the default:** 
 Author and maintain Terraform modules, manage remote state and drift, and build the pipelines that deploy them. Manual portal changes are the exception, and every exception has a reason.
* **AKS in production:** 
 Cluster and node pool design, version lifecycle and upgrade cadence, ingress controller selection and upgrades, networking model, and workload identity.
* **Platform operations at scale:** 
 Azure Lighthouse for delegated multi\-tenant management, Azure Policy, Azure Monitor and Log Analytics workspace design, Azure Update Manager, and Azure Backup.
* **Security and cost:** 
 Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Entra ID and RBAC, Key Vault, secure score remediation, plus FinOps ownership: cost modelling, right\-sizing, reservations and savings plans, and anomaly investigation.
* **Staying ahead of the platform:** 
 Track Azure Service Health advisories, service retirements, and roadmap changes, and drive the remediation work they trigger before customers feel them.



  





**What we're looking for** 



1. 10\+ years total IT experience with 5\+ years as a Cloud/Infrastructure Architect on Azure.
2. Genuine depth in core IaaS. You can talk through storage redundancy trade\-offs, disk SKU and IOPS decisions, and host caching without reaching for documentation.
3. Terraform written by you, not just reviewed by you. Module authoring, state management, and CI/CD integration.
4. DR design and execution experience — you have personally run a failover, not only planned one.
5. Production AKS operations, including at least one major version upgrade you led.
6. Ability to defend architectural decisions. If your estate uses a third\-party tool for backup, patching, or log management, you can explain precisely what the Azure\-native option could not do.
7. Experience operating multi\-tenant or multi\-subscription estates, ideally with Azure Lighthouse.
8. Direct, structured communication. Our interviews reward a clear answer to the question asked over a broad tour of adjacent topics.



  





**Strongly preferred** 



1. **Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\)**
2. **Azure Arc at scale across hybrid or multi\-cloud estates**
3. **FinOps Certified Practitioner**
4. **Regulated\-industry experience (BFSI, healthcare, public sector) with ISO 27001, SOC 2, RBI, or HIPAA controls**



  





**What we offer** 



1. 100% remote across India, \[flexible hours/core overlap]
2. Health insurance
3. Certification sponsorship and paid exam vouchers
4. Performance bonus / ESOPs

title: Mobile App Developers (Fully Remote) – Top US MNC
description:
We are hiring Mobile App Developers to join a Top US MNC building next\-generation mobile applications, digital products, and customer\-facing platforms used by thousands to millions of users worldwide.
 



 This is an opportunity to work on high\-impact mobile solutions while collaborating with globally distributed engineering, product, design, and cloud teams focused on delivering exceptional user experiences across iOS and Android platforms.
 



  




 Location
 
 100% Remote
 



  




 Start Date
 
 Immediate to 4 Weeks
 



  




 What You'll Do
 * Design, develop, test, and maintain high\-performance mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms.
* Build scalable, secure, and user\-friendly mobile experiences using modern mobile development frameworks and best practices.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, backend engineers, QA engineers, and architects to deliver high\-quality mobile applications.
* Develop reusable, maintainable, and well\-documented code.
* Integrate mobile applications with REST APIs, GraphQL services, third\-party platforms, and cloud\-based services.
* Optimize application performance, responsiveness, reliability, and security.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across multiple devices and operating system versions.
* Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, sprint planning, and Agile development activities.
* Ensure adherence to mobile development standards, security guidelines, and engineering best practices.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on code quality, performance, and user experience.



  




 Required Skills
 * 3\+ years of experience in Mobile Application Development.
* Strong experience developing mobile applications using Android, iOS, Flutter, React Native, Kotlin, Swift, or related technologies.
* Solid understanding of mobile application architecture, design patterns, and software engineering principles.
* Experience integrating mobile applications with REST APIs and backend services.
* Strong knowledge of application performance optimization, debugging, and troubleshooting techniques.
* Experience working with Git and modern version control practices.
* Understanding of Agile development methodologies and software development life cycle (SDLC).
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively within remote and distributed engineering teams.



  




 Preferred Skills
 * Experience with Flutter, React Native, Xamarin, or cross\-platform mobile development frameworks.
* Experience publishing applications to Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience working with Firebase, push notifications, analytics, and mobile monitoring tools.
* Knowledge of mobile security best practices and secure application development.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated mobile application deployment.
* Exposure to microservices architectures and cloud\-native application environments.
* Experience working on large\-scale consumer, fintech, healthcare, retail, or enterprise applications.



  




 Why Consider This Opportunity
 * Opportunity to work with a Top US MNC on large\-scale mobile products and digital platforms.
* Fully remote work environment.
* Long\-term project opportunities with extension potential.
* Exposure to modern mobile technologies, cloud\-native architectures, and enterprise\-scale applications.
* Collaborate with high\-performing engineering, product, and design teams.
* Build applications used by customers across global markets.
* Fast interview process and onboarding.



  





 If you are passionate about building exceptional mobile experiences, solving complex technical challenges, and delivering high\-quality applications at scale, we would love to hear from you.

title: Specialist - Embedded Firmware
description:
**What You’ll Do**
 The Specialist Embedded Software Engineer will be a critical member of the Power Systems Division’s team and will provide strong technical leadership in driving on time and on quality execution of new product development for the division's real\-time controls and protective relays portfolio. The person will also work closely with global engineering leadership team and central platform teams to develop embedded software/firmware platforms, Model Based Development methodologies, drive adoption of AI tools for productivity, and software process excellence.
   

  

* Act as a technical lead and drive the design and implementation of embedded platform features for power system intelligent electronic devices, analyzing and delivering features with new and existing technologies, in line with the technological roadmap
* Evaluate system performance requirements and model future requirements to evaluate suitability of firmware and hardware components and to identify and mitigate risks.
* Drive technical architecture decisions to align with product requirements and platform strategy.
* Stage work and delegate appropriate aspects of design and implementation to other developers, ensuring compliance with architecture and system/design requirements.
* Contribute to strategic embedded system platform evaluations, while demonstrating a strong product and technology lifecycle understanding.
* Analyze technology, product and development team needs to mitigate risks and to accelerate delivery of products/features.
* Create optimized and right\-sized solutions that meet or exceed product requirements with appropriate technical tradeoffs for constrained resources and serve as embedded software expert in the area of specifications, design, construction, test, test automation and maintenance
* Lead and guide complex system interface design activities and lead the resolution of integration issues across multiple engineering disciplines
* Collaborate with product owners, functional managers, systems engineering to distill and develop product/system/design requirements, use cases, identifying \& mitigating risks, sizing effort, staging work and creating design paths/designs.
* Collaborate with Product Line Managers to analyze competitor product landscape and contribute with technology solutions for product differentiation and technology and product roadmaps.
* Demonstrate technical leadership level contributions with Linux based embedded systems as well as coach and mentor other team members with respect to technology, architecture, design principles, and coding practices to achieve functional and project goals.
* Collaborate with internal CoE's and external resources to select appropriate platforms, technologies, tools, problem solve accelerating new features/products.
* Demonstrate fluency and awareness of open\-source software and understand best practices around integrating open\-source software into commercial products
* Identify, investigate, leverage and deploy new technologies to enhance product features, improve quality/efficiency/collaboration.
* Contribute to DevOps activities for embedded platforms by designing and maintaining Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery pipelines.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s/Master's degree in Computer Science /Electronics/Electrical Engineering
* 14\-18 years


**Skills**
* Embedded Linux, C\+\+, OOPS, SOLID, Design Patterns, Unit Testing
* Demonstrated competency with hardware drivers, embedded applications, multi\-core systems, networking and related areas primarily using C and C\+\+ as programming languages.
* Demonstrated competency with embedded software development environments and tools for Embedded Linux.
* Demonstrated competency using or designing systems that use network protocols such as Serial, TCP/IP, Ethernet
* Demonstrated competencies creating and implementing virtualized environments for embedded software designs.
* Strong understanding of Object\-Oriented Design (OOD) principles using C\+\+, secure coding and cybersecurity best practices
* Demonstrated experience modelling real\-time systems behavior and developing use cases using UML or similar methodologies as appropriate.
* Ability to work effectively in an Agile Scrum (or other iterative development) environment
* Experience with test\-driven development (TDD) and unit test frameworks.
* Experience using SDLC management tools in a team environment (e.g. Jira, Confluence, Git, etc.)
* Debugging experience \- Like J\-Link debugger with IAR ARM for NXP ColdFire, STM32 or TI AM64x
* Experience with Industrial Communication Protocols (ModBus TCP/IP, CAN, USB, RS232/485, SPI, I2C, SNMP).
* Experience with Peripherals (DMA, LCD, FLASH, RAM, ADC, DAC, PWM, voltage/current/temp sensors).
* Ability to read schematics and interpret the behavior of electronic systems.
* Familiar with BlackDuck, Coverity tools
* Familiar with the following concepts \- MQTT, TRAP,SNMP,SSL certificate, Boot loader, SYSLOG, Serial, Telnet, HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, FTPs, TLS,Free RADIUS, OpenLDAP and data encryption/decryption
* Familiar with JavaScript and Python
* Experience leading technical resources.


**Good To Have**
* Experience in RTOS – FreeRTOS, Zephyr or equivalent (threads/tasks, synchronization, scheduling, message queues, semaphores, mutexes and events).
* Experinece with power system protection and control devices, understanding of power system protection principles and time current charateristics


 Experience with Power Systems portfolio like Switchgears, Relays, Meters, Regulators, etc.
   

  

 Experience in handling end to end IoT devices lifecycle
   

  

* Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential, along with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and tasks while adapting swiftly to changing priorities.
* Ability to work in highly matrixed organization and thrive in globally distributed team environments.
* Must have strong drive for results and set high bar for self and others.
* Strong innovation leadership with the ability to influence across organizational levels.
* Creating technical proposals, stakeholder communication, process definition.

title: 3D Texturing Artist
description:
**Job Title:** 
 3D Texturing Artist.
 



**Department:** 
 Immersive Technologies.
 



**Location:** 
 Vapi, Gujarat.
 



**Reports To:** 
 XR Lead
 



**Experience:** 
 2–5 Years
 



**Job Purpose:** 




 To create high\-quality, physically based (PBR) textures and technical art maps for a physics\-driven robotic surgical training simulator built in Unity. The role will be responsible for texturing surgical instruments, medical devices, operating\-room environments, metals, plastics, sterile surfaces, and organic tissues while maintaining consistent texel density, material quality, memory efficiency, and real\-time rendering performance suitable for workstation GPU environments.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. PBR Texturing \& Material Creation** 




 • Create production\-ready PBR textures for surgical instruments, medical devices, robotic components, operating\-room environments, and organic assets.
 



 • Develop high\-quality Albedo/Base Color, Normal, Metallic, Roughness/Smoothness, Ambient Occlusion, and other required texture maps.
 



 • Create realistic material definitions for metals, plastics, glass, rubber, ceramics, surgical surfaces, sterile materials, and biological/organic tissues.
 



 • Develop textures from 3D model and sculpt handoffs while preserving required surface details and visual fidelity.
 



 • Ensure physically accurate material response appropriate for real\-time surgical simulation.
 



**2\. Channel\-Packed Texture \& Technical Art Workflows** 




 • Create and maintain channel\-packed textures to optimize GPU memory and material performance.
 



 • Implement project\-specific packing standards such as:
 


* R \= Metallic
* G \= Ambient Occlusion
* A \= Smoothness
* • Ensure gloss/smoothness and roughness maps are correctly converted and exported according to the defined Unity pipeline.
* • Validate packed textures for accuracy, consistency, and compatibility with Unity materials.
* • Support optimization of texture memory through efficient channel usage and resolution management.



**3\. Trim Sheet \& Modular Asset Texturing** 




 • Develop and maintain trim\-sheet workflows for modular surgical instruments, robotic components, and environment asset families.
 



 • Create efficient UV layouts that maximize texture\-space utilization.
 



 • Ensure consistent material appearance across assets using shared trim sheets and reusable texture libraries.
 



 • Support modular asset development while minimizing redundant texture memory and draw\-call overhead.
 



**4\. UV Mapping \& Texel Density Management** 




 • Create and optimize UV layouts using Maya, Blender, or equivalent tools.
 



 • Maintain consistent texel density across the complete asset library.
 



 • Ensure appropriate UV packing and utilization based on asset importance and camera visibility.
 



 • Support second UV channel creation for lightmap UVs where baked lighting is used.
 



 • Identify and resolve UV overlaps, stretching, distortion, seams, and inefficient texture\-space utilization.
 



**5\. Substance Painter / Designer Workflow** 




 • Create production\-ready textures using
 **Substance Painter, Substance Designer, or equivalent PBR tools** 
 .
 



 • Build reusable Substance materials, procedural textures, and graphs for frequently used materials and asset families.
 



 • Generate textures from high\-poly sculpt and low\-poly model workflows.
 



 • Incorporate baked information such as curvature, cavity, AO, thickness, and other maps into material creation where required.
 



 • Maintain reusable and scalable material libraries for the simulation project.
 



**6\. Medical, Surgical \& Organic Material Development** 




 • Develop realistic material definitions for surgical instruments, medical devices, operating\-room surfaces, and organic tissues.
 



 • Create material variations for:
 


* Stainless steel and surgical metals
* Medical\-grade plastics
* Rubber and silicone
* Glass
* Sterile OR surfaces
* Soft tissues
* Anatomical structures
* Other medical/surgical materials
* • Work with clinical and visual SMEs where required to ensure appropriate representation of medical materials and surfaces.
* • Support the development of realistic tissue characteristics including surface variation, subtle color variation, roughness, folds, wrinkles, and tension\-related details.



**7\. Unity Look\-Development \& Validation** 




 • Validate materials and textures directly within Unity to ensure correct visual output and real\-time performance.
 



 • Work closely with Look\-Dev Artists, Technical Artists, Unity Developers, and Simulation Engineers to resolve material and rendering issues.
 



 • Verify correct interpretation of Normal, Metallic, Smoothness/Roughness, AO, and other texture maps within Unity.
 



 • Evaluate materials under different lighting conditions and camera distances relevant to surgical training scenarios.
 



 • Support optimization for workstation GPU budgets without compromising required visual quality.
 



**8\. Technical Art \& Performance Optimization** 




 • Optimize texture resolution, compression, channel packing, material complexity, and texture memory usage.
 



 • Create instancing\-friendly materials and reusable texture systems where required.
 



 • Support efficient texture workflows for modular environments and large asset libraries.
 



 • Identify performance bottlenecks related to textures and materials and recommend appropriate solutions.
 



 • Work with Technical Artists to maintain consistent rendering and material standards across the simulator.
 



**9\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 • Work closely with 3D Modelers, Sculpting Artists, Look\-Dev Artists, Technical Artists, Unity Developers, Simulation Engineers, and Clinical SMEs.
 



 • Receive and process asset handoffs from modeling and sculpting teams.
 



 • Collaborate with Look\-Dev and Technical Art teams to establish and maintain material standards.
 



 • Participate in regular art pipeline reviews and production meetings.
 



 • Communicate texture quality issues, dependencies, and technical blockers proactively.
 



 • Explore new PBR, procedural texturing, technical\-art, and real\-time rendering techniques.
 



 • Contribute to improving texture production efficiency, material realism, and GPU performance.
 



 • Stay updated with emerging workflows in Substance, Unity, medical visualization, XR/VR/AR, gaming, and real\-time simulation.
 



 • Contribute to the development of reusable material libraries and procedural workflows for future simulation projects.
 



**Qualifications and Experience:** 




 • Diploma / Bachelor’s degree / equivalent qualification in 3D Design, Animation, Game Art, Multimedia, Visual Effects, Medical Visualization, or a related field.
 



 • 2–5 years of professional experience in 3D texturing, material creation, or PBR asset production.
 



 • Strong professional experience with
 **Substance Painter and/or Substance Designer** 
 , or equivalent PBR texturing tools.
 



 • Proven experience creating and optimizing PBR textures for real\-time applications.
 



 • Strong understanding of channel\-packed textures and trim\-sheet workflows.
 



 • Experience with UV mapping and maintaining consistent texel density.
 



 • Experience with high\-poly to low\-poly baking workflows.
 



 • Experience working with Unity or another real\-time engine is preferred.
 



 • Experience working within a multi\-artist production pipeline is preferred.
 



 • Experience in medical visualization, surgical simulation, gaming, XR/VR/AR, VFX, or digital\-twin projects will be an added advantage.
 



**Skills and Competencies:** 




 • Strong proficiency in Substance Painter and/or Substance Designer.
 



 • Strong understanding of PBR texturing and physically based material workflows.
 



 • Strong knowledge of Albedo/Base Color, Normal, Metallic, Roughness, Smoothness, AO, and other texture maps.
 



 • Strong understanding of channel packing and texture memory optimization.
 



 • Good understanding of trim\-sheet workflows and modular asset texturing.
 



 • Strong UV mapping and texel density management skills.
 



 • Good understanding of high\-poly / low\-poly baking workflows.
 



 • Basic to intermediate proficiency in Maya and/or Blender for UV and asset preparation.
 



 • Understanding of Unity material and texture validation workflows.
 



 • Understanding of real\-time rendering and GPU performance considerations.
 



 • Strong eye for material quality, surface realism, consistency, and detail.
 



 • Strong attention to naming conventions, file organization, and production standards.
 



 • Good communication and collaboration skills.
 



 • Ability to work effectively with artists, engineers, technical teams, and clinical SMEs.
 



 • Passion for immersive technologies, digital art, simulation, medical visualization, and healthcare innovation.
 



**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):** 




 • Quality and realism of PBR textures and materials created.
 



 • Accuracy and consistency of channel\-packed texture outputs.
 



 • Compliance with project texel density, UV, texture resolution, and naming standards.
 



 • Quality and efficiency of trim\-sheet and modular texturing workflows.
 



 • Successful Unity validation and visual consistency of materials.
 



 • Texture memory and GPU performance optimization.
 



 • Quality and usability of reusable Substance materials and texture libraries.
 



 • Successful handover of production\-ready texture assets to Look\-Dev and Unity teams.
 



 • Timely completion of assigned texturing activities.
 



 • Effective incorporation of artistic, technical, and clinical feedback.
 



 • Contribution to improving the visual quality and performance of the immersive surgical training simulator.
 



**Portfolio Requirement:** 




 • Candidates must submit a professional portfolio demonstrating strong PBR texturing and material creation capabilities.
 



 • Portfolio should preferably include:
 


* PBR texture breakdowns
* Packed texture examples
* Trim\-sheet layouts
* UV layouts and texel density examples
* High\-poly to low\-poly baking examples
* Surgical/medical materials where available
* Metal, plastic, glass, rubber, and organic materials
* Unity or other real\-time engine examples
* Substance Painter/Designer work
* Real\-time optimized assets

 As a Finance Operations professional in the Finance Operations team, you will enhance business processes, data flows, and operational controls.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* You will conduct financial analysis and reconciliations to ensure accuracy in monthly reporting of Actuals.
* You will develop and maintain financial models to support forecasting and budgeting processes.
* You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather and validate data for financial reporting.
* You will prepare and present monthly financial reports, highlighting key variances and insights.
* You will identify and resolve discrepancies in financial data, ensuring alignment with external reports.
* You will support the development and implementation of process improvements to enhance reporting efficiency.
* You will engage with stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and deliver actionable insights.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* MBA in Finance or Chartered Accountant qualification.
* 1 years of experience in financial services.
* Strong leadership, interpersonal, and time management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Analytical and logical thinking to understand complex business processes.
* Ability to work in a high\-paced environment and manage priorities.
* Team player with a positive attitude and commitment to high performance.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Proficiency with Business Intelligence tools such as Tableau and Alteryx.
* Intermediate proficiency with SQL

Morgan and Chase brands. description:
**What Makes Us, Us**
 Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say hello to SimCorp!
   

  

 At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success\-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
   

  

 If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
   

  

**Why is this role important to us?**
 The Financial Data Analyst in the Data Management team at SimCorp is responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting financial data to support business decisions. With typically 2\-4 years of experience in financial data analysis, this role involves assisting in the preparation of financial reports, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of data, and collaborating with teams across the organisation to streamline data workflows. The Financial Data Analyst plays a key role in supporting the finance team and business stakeholders by providing actionable insights and ensuring data quality.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
* Collect and analyze financial data to support business decision\-making, ensuring data accuracy and consistency
* Assist in the preparation of financial reports and dashboards, ensuring timely and accurate delivery to stakeholders
* Collaborate with IT, business teams, and finance professionals to ensure that financial data meets business requirements
* Validate and reconcile financial data to ensure consistency across systems and reports
* Monitor and track key financial metrics, providing insights on performance and trends
* Assist with data migration, integration, and system updates to ensure smooth data operations
* Help streamline data processes, identifying areas for improvement in data collection, validation, and reporting
* Maintain documentation related to data workflows and financial reporting processes
* Support the development and implementation of data governance policies to ensure compliance with regulatory standards
* Stay informed on emerging trends and best practices in financial data analysis, applying new techniques to improve data operations


**What We Value**
* Collecting, analyzing, and interpreting financial data to inform business decisions
* Assisting in the preparation of financial reports and dashboards for stakeholders
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure data quality and alignment with business needs
* Supporting data integration and reconciliation processes to maintain data accuracy
* Monitoring and tracking financial metrics, providing recommendations for improvement
* Contributing to process optimization and streamlining data workflows
* Ensuring compliance with data governance and regulatory standards


**BENEFITS:**
 Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid workplace model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.
   

  

 On top of that, we have IP sprints where you have 3 weeks per quarter you can spend on developing your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just only one route \- we practice a personalized approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.
   

  

**NEXT STEP:**
 Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
   

  

 If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
   

  

 We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
   

  

**WHO WE ARE:**
 For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general.
   

  

 SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.
   

  

**SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law.** 
 We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best\-in\-class solutions to our clients.

Learning Strategy \& Governance

Productivity Reinforcement \& Learning Impact

title: Principal Product Manager - HR Platforms & Technology
description:
**We're looking for a**
**Principal Product Manager \- HR Platforms \& Technology**
===========================================================


**This role is** **Office Based, Hyderabad Office****Principal Product Manager \| HR Technology \& Platforms \| Hyderabad**
  

  

**Summary**


Cornerstone OnDemand is seeking a Principal Product Manager to grow our performance and talent management agent portfolio, leading the delivery of AI\-native products and enterprise outcome agents that drive measurable customer value.
  

This is a customer\-facing AI\-native product management role for a hands\-on PM who can move quickly from customer discovery and requirements to working prototypes, using modern AI\-native product development tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co\-Pilot and similar platforms. The role requires close collaboration with customers, FDEs, engineering, and cross\-functional teams to validate solutions early, iterate rapidly, and launch outcome agents that solve meaningful business problems. As our agent portfolio grows, individual agents increasingly work together to compound value for customers, and this role will help shape how new agents fit into that broader picture.
  

The ideal candidate is highly execution\-oriented, comfortable working in ambiguity, and able to translate customer needs into prototypes, product direction, and shipped capabilities with speed and rigor


**About the Team**


You'll join a growing product team building AI\-native agents for the performance and talent management domain, part of a broader portfolio of enterprise outcome agents at Cornerstone. Our agents help enterprise customers connect everyday work to business outcomes, from goal\-setting to performance reviews to coaching and development. As the portfolio expands, we're increasingly focused on how individual agents can work together to create more value than any single agent alone. This role is an opportunity to help shape that next chapter, taking ownership of new agent areas as the team grows.


**What Success Looks Like**


In your first 6 to 12 months, you will:
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of one or more new agent initiatives within the performance and talent domain, from customer discovery through working prototype.
* Build strong relationships with customers, FDEs, and engineering partners, establishing a fast, repeatable feedback loop between discovery and prototype iteration.
* Ship a working AI\-native prototype that customers and internal stakeholders can review, test, and validate against real business problems.
* Identify meaningful opportunities for your agent(s) to complement others in the portfolio, contributing to how the team thinks about multi\-agent value.
* Establish yourself as a trusted, execution\-oriented voice on the team, someone who can take ambiguous customer problems and turn them into shipped product direction with minimal oversight

**In This Role You Will**


* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of new AI\-native products and enterprise outcome agents within the performance and talent management domain, from customer discovery and requirements gathering through prototype creation, iteration, and launch.
* Partner directly with customers to understand business problems, workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes in performance management, goal\-setting, and talent development.
* Translate customer needs into clear product requirements, use cases, and solution concepts that can quickly be tested and refined.
* Identify opportunities for new agents to complement existing ones in the portfolio, contributing to a cohesive experience as agents are increasingly deployed together.
* Build and evolve working prototypes using AI\-native tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co\-Pilot and similar rapid prototyping platforms, using prototypes as the new PRD motion so customers, FDEs, and engineering can review, test, and refine solutions directly.
* Collaborate closely with FDEs and engineering to validate feasibility, refine user flows, and prepare solutions for launch, working in tight feedback loops to confirm value and shape deliverable product capabilities.
* Drive cross\-functional execution across product, engineering, design, data science, architecture, and go\-to\-market teams to bring validated concepts into production.
* Turn customer specific outcome agents into re\-sellable out\-of\-the box agents.
* Ensure launched outcome agents are practical, scalable, and easy for enterprise customers to adopt.
* Use customer feedback, adoption signals, and business\-impact metrics to continuously improve product execution and outcomes.


**You Have Got What it Takes If you Have**


* 5\+ years of experience in product management, including significant experience delivering enterprise software, SaaS, AI, or platform products.
* Hands\-on experience using AI\-native prototyping and product development tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co\-Pilot or similar tools to accelerate product definition and validation.
* Strong track record in customer\-facing product delivery for enterprise SaaS or AI\-native products.
* Demonstrated ability to go from customer discovery and requirements to working prototypes and launched solutions.
* Experience collaborating closely with customers and technical delivery partners such as FDEs to iterate rapidly and launch customer\-ready solutions.
* Strong product execution skills, including prioritization, prototype validation, release planning, cross\-functional coordination, and delivery tracking.
* Experience translating ambiguous customer problems into structured product requirements and testable product experiences.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast\-moving, matrixed environments and drive alignment across technical and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications
* Experience in the performance management or broader HR technology space, for example goal\-setting platforms, performance review tools, or coaching and enablement platforms.
* Experience contributing to a multi\-product or multi\-agent portfolio, with an understanding of how individual products can be designed to work well together.
* Experience delivering AI agents, copilots, workflow agents, or decision\-support products.
* Demonstrated success using rapid prototyping to accelerate product\-market fit and customer adoption.
* Experience working in close partnership with customer success, services, sales, and solution delivery teams.

  

  

**Our Culture:**


Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.


**Who We Are:**


Cornerstone powers the potential of organizations and their people to thrive in a changing world. Cornerstone Galaxy, the complete AI\-powered workforce agility platform, meets organizations where they are. With Galaxy, organizations can identify skills gaps and development opportunities, retain and engage top talent, and provide multimodal learning experiences to meet the diverse needs of the modern workforce. More than 7,000 organizations and 100 million\+ users in 180\+ countries and in nearly 50 languages use Cornerstone Galaxy to build high\-performing, future\-ready organizations and people today.
