title: Talent Acquisition Lead
description:
About Us  

We are India's first 60\-minute fashion delivery platform, bringing curated, trend\-forward clothing and accessories to consumers within an hour across Bengaluru. We are building India's premium quick\-commerce destination for fashion\-where trend, speed, and curation come together for the modern, style\-conscious consumer.  

Backed by a recent $10M Series A funding round led by top\-tier global venture capital firms, we are one of the fastest\-funded fashion\-tech startups in India. We are aggressively scaling our core teams across tech, product, design, merchandising, category management, and operations, and we are looking for a relentless TA Lead to drive hyper\-growth hiring.  

The Role  

As our Talent Acquisition Lead, you will take complete ownership of our end\-to\-end talent engine. You will partner directly with the Founders, Business Heads, and Hiring Managers to build and execute high\-velocity hiring roadmaps.  

This is not an administrative HR role\-it is a fast\-paced, high\-ownership mandate for a hands\-on recruiting leader who thrives in early\-stage, 0\-to\-1 environments, loves headhunting exceptional talent, and knows how to close top\-tier candidates fast.  

Key Responsibilities  

End\-to\-End Ownership: Own the entire recruitment lifecycle across non\-tech and tech verticals\-including Fashion Design, Merchandising, E\-Commerce/Shopify Operations, Product, Marketing, and Field Ops.  

Proactive Sourcing \& Headhunting: Leverage non\-traditional sourcing channels, deep Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, Behance/Dribbble, and talent networks to build strong active and passive candidate pipelines.  

Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Founders and Vertical Heads to understand team capacity plans, craft role profiles, and set clear scorecard\-based evaluation frameworks.  

Candidate Experience: Ensure a transparent, seamless, and high\-touch candidate journey from initial outreach to offer negotiation and onboarding.  

Data\-Driven Recruiting: Track, analyze, and optimize core TA metrics\-including Time\-to\-Hire, Cost\-per\-Hire, Sourcing Channel ROI, Offer Acceptance Rates, and Pipeline Velocity.  

Employer Branding: Help establish our company as the premier employer brand in the quick\-commerce and fashion\-tech space through engaging talent campaigns and campus/industry outreach.  

What We Are Looking For  

Experience: 4 to 8 years of core talent acquisition experience, with a heavy emphasis on early\-stage, high\-growth startup environments (Series A/B preferred).  

Multi\-Discipline Hiring: Proven success hiring across cross\-functional domains (Retail/Fashion/Category, Creative, Operations, and Core Tech).  

Headhunting Prowess: Strong outbound sourcing DNA; someone who relies on proactive outreach and market mapping rather than just waiting for inbound applications.  

Speed \& Agility: Demonstrated capability of closing high\-priority positions within aggressive turnaround times without compromising on talent quality.  

Negotiation \& Closing: Excellent interpersonal communication and negotiation skills with a proven track record of converting passive talent into enthusiastic hires.  

Availability: Immediate joiners or candidates with a notice period of 15 days or less.  

Why Join Us?  

Hyper\-Growth Phase: Be at the center of building the foundational team for India's fastest\-growing fashion\-tech platform.  

High Visibility: Direct collaboration with the Founding Team and functional leaders.  

Compensation: Competitive salary, performance bonuses, and wealth creation opportunities via ESOPs.  

Culture: High ownership, fast\-paced execution, and a flat hierarchy where great work is recognized immediately.

**Company Overview:**

**Trellance** is a leading provider of data analytics, technology, and talent (including consulting) services for credit unions. Founded in 1989 (CSCU) to provide credit card processing services and rebranded in 2019, Trellance has been serving the credit union industry for 35\+ years. Headquartered in Tampa, FL, Trellance provides services across the United States through its 3 brands – Rise Analytics, ProBridge and Optiri.

**CU Rise Analytics Pvt. Ltd.** is a wholly owned subsidiary of Trellance, Inc. CU Rise Analytics is an offshore development centre of Trellance Inc., working collaboratively to offer comprehensive solutions for data analytics, technology and talent to allow our credit union clients to provide high\-quality service to their members and remain competitive. Our core expertise lies in data science and technology, encompassing data analytics, predictive modelling, business intelligence, and technology services.

**Role Summary**


We are looking for a hands\-on and proactive **Human Resource Specialist with 3–5 years of experience** to support the organization's recruitment and day\-to\-day HR operations. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in IT recruitment, along with good exposure to employee lifecycle management, HR processes, employee engagement, HR documentation, and general HR administration.


This role requires someone who can independently manage recruitment activities while also supporting the HR team in executing day\-to\-day HR processes.

**Key Responsibilities** **1\. IT Recruitment*** Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process for technical and non\-technical positions.
* Understand job requirements and work closely with hiring managers to define candidate profiles.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, recruitment agencies, and other channels.
* Screen and shortlist candidates based on technical skills, experience, compensation, and organizational fit.
* Conduct initial HR screening and coordinate technical/managerial interviews.
* Maintain regular follow\-up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Manage offer discussions, salary negotiations, documentation, and joining formalities.
* Ensure a smooth candidate experience from sourcing through onboarding.
* Maintain recruitment trackers, MIS, and hiring reports.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline for critical IT positions.

**2\. Day\-to\-Day HR Operations*** Support the complete employee lifecycle, including onboarding, confirmation, transfers, promotions, exits, and employee documentation.
* Maintain accurate and updated employee records in the HRMS.
* Assist employees with HR\-related queries regarding policies, leave, attendance, payroll, benefits, and other HR matters.
* Coordinate onboarding activities and ensure all joining documentation is completed.
* Support employee exit and full\-and\-final processes, including exit documentation and clearance.
* Monitor attendance, leave, and employee records and coordinate with payroll for necessary updates.
* Assist in implementing and communicating HR policies and processes.
* Prepare HR reports, dashboards, and MIS as required.

**3\. Employee Engagement \& HR Initiatives*** Support employee engagement activities, events, celebrations, and internal initiatives.
* Assist in organizing training and development programs.
* Support employee communication and HR announcements.

* Cascale Approved Higg FEM Verifier (Generalist/Chemical Specialist)

description:
Req ID:524691

  


At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  



Alstom is hiring a Training Development Manager to support the growing Bid, Project, Planning Management Academy. In this role, you will oversee learning \& competencies development by defining, designing and creating the global training curriculum for the global Bid \& Project Management as well as Commercial communities.



Purpose:



The role is key to enable our global communities with the best knowledge of Tender, Project and Commercial Management processes and usage of applications and tools. All aspects of competency and capabilities need to be continuously developed and updated to cover the actual business demand of Alstom operating model. Bid and Project Management competencies are to be defined and developed as per Learning and Development roadmap for the academy to ensure a global approach across Regions and Product Lines.

  



Main Responsibilities:



Main point of contact reporting to the Senior Training Manager for all operational aspects of competence development regarding the global training offer and the Academy digital learning global catalog offer in Alstom University.


Continuously develop and update based on defined job competencies, the learning and development strategy to cover growing community and business demand of Alstom operating model.


* Manage and coordinate the development and deployment of the global training curriculum for the community to complement existing offer on Academy digital page. Align with other function / métiers, Alstom University and HR, across all Regions and Product Lines to ensure a high level of competency development.
  


* Based on competency/training gaps and learning orientation roadmap, follow\-up training development roadmap with Métier Owner/Subject Matter Expert to ensure timely delivery of various projects in parallel.

  


* Build a strong link between the competency matrixes for each Métier and the learning curriculum. Based on available learning material and yearly competency development gap analysis per métier, identify weak areas and propose corrective actions for training development.

  


* Coordinate training definition, design developments including updates/enhancements of training material with Subject Matter Experts and potentially external agencies.

If an external development is needed, support Request for Proposal process by synthesizing request and following up proposals and selection.


If an internal development is needed, Create/Review training material to ensure compliance with objectives and user\-friendly digital training experience in partnership when required with Alstom University for complex developments.

  


* Liaise with Alstom University to ensure timely deployment as per defined training target audience and format. Follow\-up on participation and feedback to propose any corrective action.

title: Control Business Partner – ICG / TIPMO / Others
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Job Description:** Control Business Partner – TIPMO / ICG / Others (Suggested Designation : Infrastructure Risk \& Control Analyst – TIPMO / Shared Governance)

**Location:** Pune

**Job Description**
-------------------


Northern Trust is seeking a new team member to join the Infrastructure Control Governance team as a Control Business Partner aligned to TIPMO, ICG, and other shared governance functions. This role will provide embedded advisory support across project governance, infrastructure delivery oversight, reporting, documentation, and cross\-functional control activities. The position will work closely with project managers, TIPMO governance, ADO capability teams, ICG leads, and infrastructure stakeholders to improve control execution, strengthen evidence quality, surface risks early, and support a disciplined governance operating model across project and shared service functions.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------

* **Project \& Governance Risk Support –** Assess risks and controls across TIPMO and related governance activities including initiation, planning, execution, change control, closure, reporting, and project artifact quality.
* **Control Design \& Operating Effectiveness Reviews –** Evaluate design and operating effectiveness of key project governance and shared\-service controls; identify control gaps, process breakdowns, and opportunities to simplify or automate governance activities.
* **Planning \& Approval Readiness –** Support review of project planning artifacts, risk mitigation plans, communication plans, governance gates, and design approval evidence to improve readiness and consistency before projects move forward.
* **Issue \& Action Plan Governance –** Partner with owners to track governance\-related findings and action plans, validate remediation quality, and escalate aging or high\-impact items to the appropriate leadership forums.
* **KRI / KPI \& Executive Reporting –** Prepare metrics, dashboards, and concise reporting views on project governance health, delivery risk, artifact compliance, and recurring themes for leadership, control meetings, and oversight councils.
* **Documentation \& Evidence Management –** Help ensure project and governance documentation is complete, current, version controlled, and audit\-ready across repositories such as SharePoint, ADO, OneNote, Clarity, and associated tooling.
* **ADO / ServiceNow / Governance Tooling Advisory –** Support the practical use of enterprise tooling for planning, tracking, evidence retention, and governance transparency; identify enhancements that strengthen traceability and control consistency.
* **Cross\-Functional Coordination –** Serve as a liaison among TIPMO governance, ADO capability teams, infrastructure stakeholders, control officers, and ICG functions to align expectations, close gaps, and improve response times.
* **Broader Shared Governance Support –** Provide flexible risk and control support to adjacent ICG or other shared governance domains as priorities evolve, including audit support, reporting initiatives, documentation governance, and operational process reviews.
* **Assessment Documentation \& Evidence –** Produce audit\-ready assessment packs, walkthrough records, risk summaries, and evidence repositories using approved tools and templates with strong version control and traceability. Participate in RCSA exercise for Infrastructure Tower RAU.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**
-------------------


As a partner at Northern Trust, you must actively manage and mitigate risk and act with integrity. In accordance with our core values of service, integrity, and expertise, you are expected to:

* Adhere to all applicable risk management programs, policies, and procedures.
* Complete all mandatory training by the deadline.
* Understand how your behavior could expose Northern Trust, its clients, and financial markets to different types of risk.
* Ensure that Northern Trust or its clients are not exposed to inappropriate or excessive risk.
* Escalate any risk concerns, including those resulting from mistakes / errors to a manager or business unit risk officer.
* Exercise diligence regarding cybersecurity.
* Cooperate with internal control functions (including first\-line Control, Risk, Compliance, Audit, self\-assigned, etc.) and applicable regulatory bodies.
* Avoid conflicts of interest or behaviors that might produce unfair outcomes for Northern Trust or its clients or damage the integrity of financial markets.

**Must Haves**
--------------

* Proven experience in Infrastructure Control, IT Risk Management, PMO / project governance, infrastructure delivery oversight, or audit / compliance support.
* Strong understanding of project lifecycle governance, artifact quality, action tracking, reporting disciplines, and change / issue governance in a regulated technology environment.
* Hands\-on experience with ADO, ServiceNow, SharePoint, OneNote, Power BI, and / or Clarity PPM, with the ability to use these platforms to strengthen governance and transparency.
* Ability to assess adherence to defined processes, translate operational observations into risk\-based conclusions, and drive action with diverse technical and business stakeholders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, meeting facilitation, and follow\-up discipline with strong attention to detail and delivery quality.
* Comfort operating across multiple workstreams, resolving ambiguity, and balancing advisory support with execution rigor.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* CISA, CRISC, PMP, Agile / Scrum, ITIL, or equivalent governance / delivery credentials.
* Knowledge of SDM, Paragon or comparable project governance frameworks, control libraries, and audit / regulatory expectations within financial services.
* Experience supporting documentation governance, control metrics, or broader ICG tower initiatives.

**Qualification**
-----------------

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Project Management, Business Systems, Risk Management, or related field.
* 8\-10\+ years of experience in project governance, infrastructure controls, IT risk, delivery oversight, or related governance functions.

*\- End of Document* *\-*

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  

  



  

**About Our Pune Office**

  

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

  

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: HR Shared Services Administrator
description:
Description:

The HR Shared Services Administrator delivers accurate, timely and compliant HR administration across the employee lifecycle, covering onboarding, employee changes, contractual documentation, HR systems,payroll coordination and offboarding. The role provides a consistent and responsive service to employees, managers and the wider People Team, while maintaining accurate records, supporting standardised global processes and ensuring approved HR activities are executed efficiently and with appropriate control.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Employee Lifecycle Administration**

*Drives Results • Ensures Accountability • Customer Focus*

* Manage HR administration across the employee lifecycle, from onboarding through to offboarding.
* Prepare offer letters, contracts and employment documentation using approved country templates.
* Process approved employee changes including promotions, transfers, salary changes, working arrangements and contractual amendments.
* Coordinate probation administration and employee exit processes, ensuring required actions and documentation are completed on time.
* Maintain complete, accurate and compliant employee records and personnel files.

**HR Systems \& Data Administration**

*Ensures Accountability • Drives Results • Collaborates*

* Maintain accurate employee data within Paylocity and other HR systems.
* Manage onboarding workflows and move approved candidates from recruitment through to onboarding.
* Maintain employee master data, organisational structures and reporting relationships.
* Monitor workflow completion and follow up outstanding documentation or actions.
* Maintain high standards of HR data quality, confidentiality and integrity.

**Payroll \& Benefits Coordination**

*Ensures Accountability • Customer Focus • Collaborates*

* Coordinate payroll administration for new starters, employee changes and leavers within agreed payroll deadlines.
* Ensure payroll information and supporting documentation are accurate and complete before submission.
* Support benefits enrolment and routine benefits administration.
* Liaise with Payroll and external providers to resolve routine queries and support accurate employee processing.

**HR Service, Documentation \& Compliance**

*Customer Focus • Collaborates • Courage • Ensures Accountability*

* Act as a first point of contact for routine HR administrative enquiries from employees and managers.
* Manage shared HR mailboxes and provide timely guidance on standard HR processes, documentation and systems.
* Maintain approved HR templates and ensure employment documentation follows relevant country and company requirements.
* Maintain appropriate records and audit trails in accordance with data privacy, document retention and compliance requirements.
* Escalate employee relations, policy or other non\-routine matters to the appropriate HR Business Partner.

**Process Improvement \& Reporting**

*Drives Results • Ensures Accountability • Collaborates*

* Maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process documentation and guidance for HR Shared Services activities.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve service delivery and reduce manual administration through HR system workflows and automation.
* Produce routine HR reports and monitor key activities including onboarding, probation and outstanding employee actions.
* Support HR audits, compliance reviews and continuous improvement initiatives across HR Shared Services.

**Our Values in Action:**

* **Be Humble and Curious:** by learning from colleagues, asking questions and looking for practical ways to improve HR processes and service delivery.
* **Inspire, Empower and Prosper:** by providing reliable HR support that enables employees, managers and colleagues to succeed.
* **Team Up to Be Better:** by working collaboratively across the People Team, Payroll and other functions to deliver a consistent employee experience.
* **Be Passionate About Our Customers:** by providing accurate, responsive and professional HR support to employees and managers.
* **Take Ownership and Get Stuff Done:** by completing HR administration accurately, on time and with clear accountability for follow\-through.
* **Be Eager to Win:** by looking for ways to simplify administration, improve service levels and make better use of HR systems.
* **Build a Better Future:** by supporting scalable, efficient and compliant HR processes that enable Unilode’s continued growth.

**The Small Print**


This role operates within a global HR Shared Services environment supporting employees and managers across multiple countries and time zones. The successful individual will be expected to manage competing priorities while maintaining high standards of accuracy, confidentiality, compliance and customer service.


This job description outlines the general scope and expectations of the role and is not intended to represent a complete or exhaustive list of responsibilities. Duties may evolve in line with business requirements and the continued development of Unilode’s HR Shared Services model.


Requirements:
**Experience \& Skills**

* Experience in HR Administration, HR Operations or HR Shared Services.
* Good understanding of the employee lifecycle and standard HR administration processes.
* Experience preparing employment contracts and HR documentation.
* Experience using an HRIS such as Paylocity or a similar platform.
* Basic understanding of payroll administration and employee change processes.
* Strong organisational skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work within agreed deadlines.
* Strong customer service orientation with a proactive and reliable approach.
* Ability to handle confidential employee information with professionalism and discretion.
* Confidence working with HR systems, employee data and standard process controls.

Founded in 2014 by Khadim Batti and Vara Kumar, Whatfix is a leading global B2B SaaS provider and the largest pure\-play enterprise digital adoption platform (DAP). Spearheading the category with serial innovation and unmatched customer\-centricity, Whatfix is the only DAP innovating beyond the category, positioning itself as a comprehensive suite for GenAI\-powered digital adoption, analytics, and application simulation. Whatfix has seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore, and Australia and a presence across 40\+ countries.



Customers: 700\+ enterprise customers, including over 80 Fortune 500 companies such as Shell, Microsoft, Schneider Electric, and UPS Supply Chain Solutions.



Investors: Raised a total of \~$270 million. Most recently Series E round of $125 Million led by Warburg Pincus with participation from existing investor SoftBank Vision Fund 2\. Other investors include Cisco Investments, Eight Roads Ventures (A division of Fidelity Investments), Dragoneer Investments, Peak XV Partners, and Stellaris Venture Partners.

  

* With over 45% YoY sustainable annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, Whatfix is among the “Top 50 Indian Software Companies” as per G2 Best Software Awards.
* Recognized as a “Leader” in the digital adoption platforms (DAP) category for the past 4\+ years by leading analyst firms like Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and Everest Group.
* The only vendor recognized as a Customers’ Choice in the 2024 Gartner® Voice of the Customer for Digital Adoption Platforms has once again earned the Customers’ Choice distinction in 2025\. We also boast a star rating of 4\.6 on G2 Crowd, 4\.5 on Gartner Peer Insights, and a high CSAT of 99\.8%
* Highest\-Ranking DAP on 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ North America for Fourth Consecutive Year
* Won the Silver for Stevie's Employer of the Year 2023 – Computer Software category and also recognized as Great Place to Work 2022\-2023

* On the G2 peer review platform, Whatfix has received 77 Leader badges across all market segments, including Small, Medium, and Enterprise, in 2024, among numerous other industry recognitions.

**What you’ll get to do?**

* Develop a strong understanding of the business, its priorities, operating context, culture, and people challenges. Translate this understanding into effective people interventions, while driving the execution of strategic HR projects and identifying opportunities for future initiatives.

* Leverage insights from employee pulse surveys, offline feedback mechanisms, platform data, and employee conversations to understand employee sentiment and identify areas for improvement.
* Conduct exit interviews to understand reasons for attrition, explore potential retention opportunities, and systematically document insights to strengthen attrition analysis and prevention efforts.
* Utilize MIS, people analytics, data reporting, and visualization to generate meaningful insights that support business and people decisions. Maintain a high standard of data accuracy across systems and periodically review reports and employee data to ensure reliability.
* Support employees and managers in understanding and navigating the Performance Management System (PMS), career development processes, and other people programs, ensuring alignment with the Whatfix Program Calendar. Partner with HRBPs and relevant COEs to implement initiatives across talent management, organizational development, employee engagement, and other people priorities.

* Ensure consistent implementation of HR policies, processes, and procedures in accordance with organizational guidelines and applicable legal requirements. Support employees and managers in navigating policies while ensuring appropriate governance and documentation.
* Promote ethical behavior and professional conduct across the organization. Stay informed about relevant global compliance, employment practices, and benefits requirements to support a compliant and ethical workplace.
* Partner with managers and HR stakeholders to address employee relations matters, including conflict resolution, performance concerns, disciplinary actions, grievances, and other sensitive employee situations, ensuring appropriate and timely resolution.
* Support Compensation \& Benefits (C\&B) and People Operations requirements for the supported business, including compensation benchmarking and analysis, compensation review exercises, benefits\-related data requirements, employee data audits, and other operational activities. Partner closely with relevant COEs and central teams to ensure timely and accurate execution.
* Contribute to central and cross\-functional HR projects beyond the immediate Business Unit, as required. This may include workforce and headcount analysis, compensation or talent analytics, organizational data reviews, benchmarking exercises, HR process improvements, audits, and other ad\-hoc analytical or operational requirements.
* Undertake data\-driven deep dives and special projects based on evolving business or organizational needs. Work with multiple stakeholders to structure ambiguous problems, analyze relevant data, derive actionable insights, and support recommendations and execution.


**What you should have**


* 5\+ years of solid HR/Business Partnering experience, preferably within a fast\-paced, high\-growth technology organization.
* Strong understanding of core HR practices, with hands\-on exposure to areas such as employee engagement, performance management, talent management, employee relations, people analytics, and HR operations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with the ability to work with people data, identify trends, derive insights, and translate them into actionable recommendations.
* Strong research skills with a self\-directed, proactive approach and the ability to structure and navigate ambiguity effectively.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with a high degree of discretion and judgment.

**Job Overview:** As a Recruitment Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the acquisition of top talent for our BPO operations in the telecom sector. You will be responsible for sourcing, screening, and selecting candidates who possess the skills and expertise necessary to excel in various roles within our organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Talent Sourcing:** Utilize various channels such as job boards, social media platforms, networking events, and referrals to attract potential candidates with telecom industry experience.

* **Collaboration:** Work closely with hiring managers and department heads to understand their staffing needs and develop tailored recruitment strategies.

* **Market Research:** Stay updated on industry trends, best practices, and competitor activities to inform recruitment strategies and decision\-making.
* **Data Management:** Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of candidate information, interviews, and hiring status using our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) or other relevant tools.
* **Compliance:** Ensure compliance with all relevant employment laws, regulations, and company policies throughout the recruitment process.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify opportunities to optimize and streamline recruitment processes, driving efficiency and effectiveness in talent acquisition.

**Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Fresher or Proven experience in recruitment, preferably within the telecom or BPO industry.
* Familiarity with applicant tracking systems and other recruitment tools.

title: Senior Associate Workforce Planning
description:
**About the Role**
------------------



Support Operations is one of our core operations teams, responsible for making sure that when things go wrong, there's always someone there to make it right. The team designs, manages, and operates a large and growing global network of support centers, with the goal of delivering a world\-class customer experience every time.



We're looking for an experienced Workforce Planner to help develop and scale our support lines of business. This role is central to planning monthly, daily, and hourly staffing levels, and to keeping hiring plans current so we consistently deliver best\-in\-class service. You'll play a key part in improving forecast accuracy, reporting, and how we plan around floor staff utilization and efficiency — for a 24/7/365 organization, wherever it operates.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


**Capacity planning**


* Build and maintain support capacity plan models at the monthly, weekly, and interval level, using a quantitative model to determine the staff required to service forecasted volumes
* Match staffing supply to required staff to ensure efficient service level attainment, and make hiring, ramp, and staff\-reduction recommendations
* Keep capacity plans and assumptions accurate, current, and aligned to source\-of\-truth headcount data, auditing regularly for accuracy
* Ensure alignment from the smallest site/team level of detail up through the broader org\-wide capacity plan
* Maintain documentation of planning methodology, assumptions, and processes, and continually improve the planning tools, models, and templates themselves


**Forecasting \& scenario planning**


* Forecast incoming contact volume using historical and benchmark data, tracking deviations between forecast and actuals on a regular cadence
* Build, update, and present "what\-if" scenarios to evaluate potential changes and support upcoming initiatives, as well as annual, half\-year, and quarterly planning scenarios for long\-range and financial planning
* Build and validate capacity models for new lines of business, queues, or markets, and identify overtime activation needs while ensuring compliance with local labor regulations in each region you support

title: Workforce Transformation HR Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
===============


The Workforce Transformation Analyst supports the design, analysis, and implementation of initiatives that reshape how the organization's workforce operates — including workforce planning, skills\-based talent strategies, organizational restructuring, automation/AI adoption impacts, and change management. This role combines data analysis, strategic thinking, and project execution to help the organization anticipate future talent needs and adapt its workforce model to meet evolving business demands.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Analyze current workforce data (headcount, skills, roles, costs, attrition) to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and transformation opportunities
* Support workforce planning models that forecast future talent needs based on business strategy, technology adoption, and market trends
* Assess the impact of automation, AI, and process changes on roles, skills requirements, and staffing levels
* Develop skills taxonomies and competency frameworks to support reskilling/upskilling initiatives
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Finance, and business leaders to design organizational structures that align with strategic goals
* Build dashboards and reports (e.g., in Excel, Power BI, Tableau) to track workforce transformation KPIs and present findings to leadership
* Support change management efforts, including communication plans, training needs assessments, and stakeholder engagement
* Conduct benchmarking and market research on workforce trends, labor market shifts, and industry best practices
* Assist in developing business cases for workforce restructuring, redeployment, or reduction initiatives
* Document processes, playbooks, and standard methodologies for workforce transformation projects

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Organizational Psychology, or related field
* 2–5 years of experience in HR analytics, workforce planning, organizational design, management consulting, or a related analytical role
* Strong proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, modeling); experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) a plus
* Familiarity with HRIS systems (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or similar)
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings to non\-technical stakeholders
* Project management skills and comfort working across cross\-functional teams

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Master's degree in a related field, or HR certification (SHRM\-CP/SCP, PHR/SPHR)
* Experience with change management frameworks (Prosci/ADKAR, Kotter's model)
* Exposure to workforce automation, AI impact assessments, or future\-of\-work research
* Consulting background in organizational transformation or workforce strategy
* Experience with statistical analysis tools (SQL, R, or Python) for advanced workforce modeling

**Key Competencies**
====================

* Analytical rigor and data\-driven decision making
* Strategic and systems thinking
* Stakeholder management and influence

You will work with other team members to provide situational awareness through detection, containment, and remediation of IT threats. This job requires great attention to detail and general awareness of Cyber Security tools like SIEM, XDR, EDR, IDS/ IPS, ability understand various logs – network logs, sys logs, Firewall logs. As a SOC Analyst you are expected to have working knowledge in areas of networking, malware analysis, incident response, vulnerability management.

* General understanding of related technologies (Networking, Operating Systems)

* Able to produce documentation for use by team and customer.

 Understanding of ITIL process

title: Generalist / Founder’s Associate — Early Career
description:
**What if your first job let you understand how an entire business works — instead of putting you inside one tiny department?**

I’m looking for a **curious, driven early\-career professional**. You’ll work directly with the Founder, gaining exposure to real business decisions, problems and opportunities that are rarely accessible to someone at the beginning of their career.

This isn't a traditional role with a fixed script.

You might work on operations one day, coordinate with an international client the next, test an AI tool, improve a process, solve a customer problem, work with our CRM, or support a marketing/business initiative.

**The common thread: you'll be expected to think, learn quickly, figure things out and take ownership.**

**About Chess Gaja**

**Chess Gaja** is a global online chess academy founded by **Grandmaster Priyadharshan Kannappan**, serving students across 5**0\+ countries**.

We combine world\-class chess coaching with structured operations, technology and automation to deliver a consistent experience to students and families around the world.

We're a growing business, and we're looking for people who don't just want a job — **but want to grow with the company.**

What you'll work on

The work will evolve as you grow. Depending on what the business needs and where your strengths develop, you could be involved in:

* Improving operational workflows and processes
* Coordinating with international clients, students and internal teams
* Exploring and implementing AI and digital tools
* Working with our CRM and business systems
* Identifying and solving day\-to\-day business problems
* Coordinating with coaches and other stakeholders
* Supporting marketing and business development initiatives
* Finding ways to make existing processes faster, simpler or better

You'll get exposure to multiple parts of the business rather than being confined to one department.

What this role can become

You may start by supporting different areas and learning how the business works.

As you become more capable, you'll progressively move from:

**Learning → Executing → Owning → Leading**

The goal is **not** for you to remain a trainee.

Over time, you'll be trusted with increasingly important projects, processes and business functions.

If you spend the next **1–2 years** here, I want you to come out with something far more valuable than just another job title:

**a strong practical understanding of how a real business works.**

You'll develop practical skills across operations, communication, technology, project coordination, problem\-solving and business fundamentals.

Who we're looking for

You don't need prior corporate experience. Freshers and early\-career professionals welcome

What matters more to us:

**Curiosity** — You genuinely want to understand how things work.

**Initiative** — When you don't know something, you make a reasonable attempt to figure it out before waiting for instructions.

**Common sense** — You can make good decisions without everything being explicitly spelled out.

**Communication** — You can communicate clearly, professionally and politely in English. You'll be interacting with international clients and teams, so strong written communication matters.

**Adaptability** — You're comfortable learning new software, systems and ways of working.

**Reliability** — You follow through on commitments and don't need to be constantly reminded.

**Process discipline** — You take pride in keeping things organized, following up properly and getting the small details right.

**Learning speed** — You pick things up quickly and apply what you've learned.

**Chess is a plus, but not a requirement.** If you play chess or regularly enjoy playing online, we'd love to know. A **1000\+ rating on Chess.com or Lichess** is a bonus, but we're equally happy to hear from casual players.

One of the advantages of this role is that you'll work with the actual systems and tools used to run a growing international business.

You'll get hands\-on experience with **Zoho One**, including its CRM and business automation capabilities, as well as other digital and AI tools.

You won't just learn these tools theoretically — **you'll use them to solve real business problems.**

You prefer:

* A rigid job description
* Doing the same type of work every day
* Being told exactly what to do at every step
* Waiting for someone else to solve problems
* A role where learning new tools or skills isn't part of the job

This opportunity is best suited to someone who wants to build **depth through breadth** early in their career and gradually take on more responsibility.

* **Experience:** Freshers and early\-career professionals welcome

* **Equipment:** You must have your own reliable laptop and mobile phone, along with a **50\+ Mbps internet connection** at home.

Sales Business Development Executive – IT Services

**Company:** NextGen Info Solution  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Work Arrangement:** Fully Remote  
**Experience:** 0–2 years  
**Salary:** ₹1\.5–₹2\.5 lakh per year

About the Company

NextGen Info Solution provides web development and digital marketing services to businesses. Our services include website development, WordPress, eCommerce solutions, mobile applications, SEO, social media marketing, paid advertising, and website maintenance.

About the Role

We are looking for a **Sales Business Development Executive (BDE)** to support our business development activities and help identify and develop new business opportunities.

The role involves prospect research, lead generation, client communication, requirement understanding, follow\-ups, proposal coordination, and supporting the conversion of qualified prospects into clients.

This position is suitable for candidates interested in building a career in **B2B sales, IT services sales, and business development**.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify potential business clients through professional and business\-focused channels.
* Generate and qualify leads for IT and digital marketing services.
* Conduct prospect outreach through email, telephone, LinkedIn, and other approved channels.
* Understand client requirements related to websites, applications, SEO, digital marketing, and related services.
* Conduct introductory and discovery conversations with prospective clients.
* Explain relevant services based on the client's requirements.
* Prepare or coordinate proposals, quotations, and service information.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups with prospective clients.
* Keep lead, prospect, and follow\-up information updated in the company's records.
* Coordinate with internal technical or delivery teams when additional project information is required.
* Maintain a professional relationship with prospects and clients.
* Support the development and management of the sales pipeline.
* Work toward agreed sales activity and business development targets.
* Provide regular updates regarding lead status, follow\-ups, opportunities, and potential closures.

Services

The BDE may work on business opportunities related to:

* Website Design and Development
* WordPress Development
* WooCommerce and eCommerce Development
* Custom Web Application Development
* Mobile App Development
* Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
* Social Media Marketing
* Pay\-Per\-Click (PPC) Advertising
* Digital Marketing
* Local SEO
* Website Maintenance and Support

Required Skills

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Professional communication with prospective clients.

\- Support the Sales/Business Development team with relevant marketing content, campaigns and audience insights.

This is a performance\-based opportunity with no fixed salary or guaranteed monthly income.

The Marketing Executive will be eligible for a Performance Incentive of up to 8% on every successful sale generated by the Company, irrespective of which authorised Business Development Executive completes the sale.

The applicable incentive will be based on the Executive's work, performance and demonstrated marketing results.

Incentive eligibility will begin after completion of the first month from the date of joining, subject to satisfactory performance and the Company's applicable incentive policy.

\- Good written and verbal communication skills.

\- Creative thinking and ability to develop practical marketing ideas.

\- Comfortable with performance\-based compensation.

\- Location: India

\- Work Mode: Work From Home

The Company will provide the necessary business understanding, product/service information, marketing direction, operational guidance, SOPs and relevant training required to understand TradeInfra's business and target audiences.

The Executive will be expected to independently apply their marketing skills using available free digital platforms, free tools and AI technologies to produce measurable marketing results.

**Immediate joiners will be preferred**

Experience: Fresh graduates, freshers with internship experience, or up to 10 months of experience

**About** **Airtribe**

Airtribe is an AI\-first upskilling platform for working professionals. From Product Management to Backend Engineering, our programs are designed around real\-world use cases, AI tools, and hands\-on learning.

We work with instructors from companies like Microsoft, Meta, Razorpay, Coinbase, Gojek, and Uber, and have helped 5,000\+ professionals accelerate their careers. Backed by Better Capital, 640 Ventures, and Kunal Shah, we are building a fast\-growing learning platform focused on real outcomes.

**The Context**  
At Airtribe, Business Development is not about pushing sales. It is about helping working professionals make the right career decisions.

As we scale, the volume of learners and conversations increases, but maintaining trust, clarity, and quality in each interaction becomes harder. This role exists to ensure that every learner interaction is thoughtful, consultative, and outcome\-driven, not transactional.

**The Role**  
As a Business Development Associate, you will work closely with learners to understand their goals and guide them toward the right programs. You will own the journey from the first conversation to final enrolment, ensuring clarity, trust, and a strong learner experience throughout.

This is a role built for people who are early in their careers and hungry to grow fast. We will give you the training, the environment, and the support. What we are looking for is the drive to make it count.

**What You'll Own**

* End\-to\-end learner conversations from first touchpoint to enrollment
* Understanding learner goals and guiding them with clarity and empathy
* Follow\-ups, objection handling, and decision support
* Maintaining quality and consistency across all interactions
* Accurate documentation of conversations, follow\-ups, and outcomes
* Building relationships through calls, events, and networking opportunities

**What Problems You'll Solve**

* Helping learners make informed decisions instead of rushed choices
* Reducing drop\-offs caused by confusion or lack of clarity
* Building trust in a high\-volume, fast\-moving sales environment
* Ensuring conversations are consultative, not script\-driven

**How This Role Evolves**

* In the initial phase, your focus will be on understanding the product, learner personas, and running effective conversations.
* Over time, you will be expected to improve conversion quality, handle more complex conversations, and contribute to refining sales processes.

 ZOID is a deep\-tech R\&D startup developing advanced defence and aerospace technologies for the Indian Military and UAV manufacturers. Our work spans AI, electronics, robotics, autonomous systems and UAV platforms.
   

  

 Our current projects include AI\-based FOD detection for naval air stations, GNSS\-denied navigation, aerial intelligent mapping, reusable off\-board missile decoys, vision\-based kinetic strike systems and drone swarming solutions.
   

  

**Role Overview\-**
 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Systems Engineer** 
 to support the end\-to\-end design, integration, testing, flight operations and deployment of UAV systems.
   

  

 The role requires strong practical knowledge of drone hardware, avionics, flight controllers, power systems, communication links, payload integration and field testing. The candidate must be comfortable manually flying small to medium\-category UAVs and travelling to test locations across India.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities\-**
**UAV Systems \& Integration**
* Lead, design and assemble end\-to\-end integration of UAV subsystems: propulsion, avionics, control, payload and power.
* Hands\-on with various frame designs — Quad/Hex/Octa copters, fixed\-wing, VTOL, etc.
* Select suitable drives, electronic components, sensors and hardware.
* Knowledge of motors, ESCs, propellers — their specs and configuration.
* Configure, integrate, calibrate and auto\-tune flight controllers (Pixhawk, Cube Orange\+, PX4, etc.).
* Analyse flight logs using Mission Planner, QGroundControl or MAVLink tools for pre\- and post\-flight debugging.
* Knowledge of standard flight modes (stabilize, althold, poshold, loiter, land, rtl, guided, auto), fail\-safes (RC, GCS, battery, geofence, EKF) and mission planning.
* Familiar with standard Pixhawk Cube parameters and setting them via Mission Planner.


**Communication \& Networking**
* Ability to configure IP networks — IP addressing, subnet masks, gateways, routing — and get companion computers, flight controllers, payload processors, routers and ground stations talking on the same network.
* Knowledge of serial communication protocols: UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, RS\-232, including baud rates and debugging.
* Understanding of telemetry radios, RC links, video links, mesh networks, Ethernet, LTE/5G modems, VPN/routing and IP\-based payload communication.

title: Sales & Marketing Executive
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Marketing, Sales \& Technical Support ExecutiveSelexic Pay — Labour Contractor HRMS

**Company:** Deccan India Development Corporation Pvt. Ltd. (DIDC)  
**Product:** Selexic Pay – Labour Contractor Payroll \& HRMS  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Location:** Pune / Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Work Mode:** Field \+ Office \+ Customer Site  
**Department:** Sales \& Customer Success  
**Reporting To:** Business Development Manager / Management

1\. About DIDC

Deccan India Development Corporation Pvt. Ltd. (DIDC) is a technology company focused on building practical digital solutions for businesses and organizations.

We are looking for a dynamic, target\-oriented and technology\-friendly **Marketing, Sales \& Technical Support Executive** to drive the growth of **Selexic Pay**, our specialized Labour Contractor Payroll \& HRMS platform.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for the complete customer journey—from identifying prospects and generating leads to conducting product demonstrations, closing sales, supporting implementation and maintaining customer relationships.

2\. About Selexic Pay

**Selexic Pay** is a specialized HRMS and payroll management solution designed for labour contractors and organizations managing large workforces.

The platform helps businesses manage areas such as:

* Labour/Employee Management
* Employee onboarding
* Aadhaar/PAN/Bank verification
* Attendance management
* Salary processing
* Salary structures
* Advances and loans
* Deductions
* Compliance calculations
* Minimum wages compliance
* Salary slips
* WhatsApp communication
* Client/company management
* Material management
* Pay\-per\-work
* Mobile access
* Payroll and workforce reporting

The candidate will be trained on the complete Selexic Pay platform.

3\. Role Purpose

The primary objective of this role is to **generate revenue and ensure customer success for Selexic Pay in Pune and Mumbai.**

The employee will perform three interconnected functions:

A. Marketing

Create awareness and generate qualified leads.

B. Sales

Convert prospects into paying Selexic Pay customers.

C. Technical Support

Help customers understand, configure and use Selexic Pay successfully.

This is therefore a **revenue \+ customer\-success role**, not a purely administrative support position.

4\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Marketing \& Lead Generation

* Identify potential Selexic Pay customers in assigned territories.
* Conduct market research to identify labour contractors and workforce\-management businesses.
* Identify companies employing/managing large numbers of contract labour.
* Generate leads through:
* Field visits
* Cold calling
* WhatsApp
* Email
* LinkedIn
* References
* Business networking
* Local business associations
* Industry contacts
* Digital campaigns and marketing activities
* Build a database of prospective customers.
* Maintain accurate lead information in the CRM.
* Conduct regular market visits.
* Identify new business opportunities in Pune and Mumbai.
* Participate in exhibitions, seminars, networking events and promotional activities.
* Support DIDC marketing campaigns and local promotional initiatives.

5\. Sales ResponsibilitiesLead → Demo → Follow\-up → Closure

The employee will be responsible for managing the complete sales cycle.

Lead Qualification

Understand:

* Number of employees/labourers
* Number of clients/sites
* Current payroll process
* Attendance process
* Salary processing method
* Compliance requirements
* Current software/Excel usage
* Existing problems
* Decision\-maker
* Budget
* Expected implementation timeline

Product Demonstration

Conduct professional Selexic Pay demonstrations for:

* Labour contractors
* Contractors' HR teams
* Payroll teams
* Accounts teams
* Admin teams
* Business owners
* Company management

Demonstrate the product according to the customer's actual business problem rather than simply showing software screens.

Sales Conversion

* Prepare proposals and quotations.
* Explain packages and pricing.
* Handle objections.
* Conduct follow\-ups.
* Negotiate within approved limits.
* Coordinate with management wherever special pricing is required.
* Close sales.
* Collect required customer information for onboarding.
* Coordinate with the implementation/support team.

6\. Technical Support Responsibilities

The candidate will provide **Level\-1 product support** to Selexic Pay customers.

Responsibilities include:

* Help customers understand Selexic Pay features.
* Assist customers with basic configuration.
* Help users resolve common application issues.
* Guide customers during employee import.
* Assist with attendance data upload.
* Help users understand salary processing.
* Explain salary structures and deductions.
* Assist with basic payroll configuration.
* Help customers understand reports and salary slips.
* Assist customers with WhatsApp\-related workflows.
* Guide customers through application usage.
* Reproduce customer\-reported issues where possible.
* Record issues in the support/ticketing system.
* Escalate technical bugs to the development team.
* Follow up on escalated issues until closure.
* Maintain communication with customers during issue resolution.
* Conduct basic customer training.

**Important:** The employee is not expected to be a software developer.

However, the candidate must have sufficient technical understanding to **diagnose basic problems, understand software workflows and communicate technical issues clearly to the development team.**

7\. Customer Onboarding

After a successful sale, the employee will assist with customer onboarding.

Activities may include:

* Customer information collection
* Product configuration coordination
* Employee data import
* Attendance setup
* Salary configuration
* User creation
* Basic training
* First payroll assistance
* Customer handover
* Follow\-up after implementation

The objective is to ensure that the customer does not simply purchase Selexic Pay but **starts using it successfully.**

8\. Customer Relationship Management

* Maintain regular contact with existing customers.
* Understand customer problems and requirements.
* Identify opportunities for additional modules/add\-ons.
* Generate upselling and cross\-selling opportunities.
* Collect customer feedback.
* Identify dissatisfied customers early.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer issues.
* Maintain long\-term relationships with key customers.
* Generate referrals from satisfied customers.

9\. Field Sales \& Travel

This is a **field\-oriented role**.

The candidate should be comfortable travelling across assigned territories in:

Pune

Pune city and surrounding industrial/business areas.

Mumbai

Mumbai and surrounding business/industrial areas as assigned.

Regular customer meetings, prospect visits, demonstrations and support visits will be part of the job.

**Two\-wheeler ownership and a valid driving licence will be preferred.**

10\. Daily Responsibilities

A typical working day may include:

* Prospect research
* Cold calls
* Lead follow\-up
* Customer meetings
* Field visits
* Product demonstrations
* Proposal preparation
* Sales follow\-up
* Customer support
* CRM updates
* Customer onboarding
* Internal coordination
* Daily activity reporting

The candidate will be expected to maintain proper records of:

* Calls
* Leads
* Meetings
* Demos
* Follow\-ups
* Opportunities
* Closures
* Customer issues
* Support activities

11\. Key Performance Indicators — KPIs

Performance will be measured using a combination of **activity, sales and customer\-success metrics.**

Marketing KPIs

* New leads generated
* Qualified leads
* New prospects added to CRM
* Market visits
* Networking activities
* Campaign participation

Sales KPIs

* Customer meetings
* Product demonstrations
* Qualified opportunities
* Proposals submitted
* Follow\-ups completed
* New customers acquired
* Monthly sales revenue
* Conversion rate

Customer Success KPIs

* Successful customer onboarding
* First payroll completion
* Customer support response
* Issue resolution
* Customer retention
* Customer satisfaction
* Upselling/cross\-selling
* Customer referrals

12\. Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

* Confident
* Energetic
* Self\-motivated
* Target\-oriented
* Customer\-focused
* Technology\-friendly
* Good at communication
* Comfortable with field work
* Good at explaining software
* Good at problem\-solving
* Comfortable speaking with business owners
* Willing to learn payroll/HRMS concepts
* Able to work independently

The candidate should have the ability to **sell a solution, not just a product.**

13\. Required SkillsSales Skills

* Lead generation
* Cold calling
* Field sales
* B2B sales
* Product demonstration
* Negotiation
* Follow\-up
* Closing
* Relationship management

Technical Skills

* Basic understanding of web applications
* Basic computer knowledge
* MS Excel/Google Sheets
* CRM usage
* Ability to understand software workflows
* Basic troubleshooting
* Ability to document technical issues

Communication Skills

* Excellent verbal communication
* Good presentation skills
* Professional customer communication
* Good written communication

Language

Preferred:

* Marathi
* Hindi
* English

Strong Marathi communication will be particularly useful for the Maharashtra market.

14\. Educational Qualification

**Minimum:** Graduate in any discipline.

Preferred backgrounds:

* BBA
* BMS
* B.Com
* BCA
* B.Sc.
* MBA – Marketing/Sales
* IT/Computer\-related graduation

However, **sales ability and attitude will be given more importance than the degree.**

15\. ExperiencePreferred Experience

**1–3 years** in:

* Software sales
* SaaS sales
* ERP sales
* HRMS sales
* Payroll software sales
* B2B sales
* IT product sales
* Field sales
* Customer support \+ sales

Candidates with strong field\-sales ability but no direct SaaS experience may also be considered.

**Freshers with excellent communication, confidence, technology aptitude and strong sales potential may be considered selectively.**

16\. Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates from the following industries will be preferred:

* HRMS
* Payroll software
* ERP
* Accounting software
* Attendance systems
* Biometric solutions
* Workforce management
* Labour contractor solutions
* B2B SaaS
* Business software
* IT services

Experience with products such as billing, accounting, HRMS, ERP or workforce\-management software will be an advantage.

17\. CompensationSuggested Structure

**Fixed Salary:** ₹20,000 – ₹30,000 per month  
**\+ Performance Incentives**  
**\+ Approved Travel/Field Expenses**

Final compensation will depend on:

* Experience
* Previous sales performance
* Software/SaaS experience
* Communication ability
* Technical capability
* Territory experience

A strong candidate with proven B2B SaaS sales experience can be considered above the standard range.

The incentive structure should be designed so that **high performers can significantly increase their monthly earnings through sales achievement.**

18\. What Success Looks LikeFirst 30 Days

The employee should:

* Understand Selexic Pay completely.
* Learn the target market.
* Learn the sales process.
* Learn CRM usage.
* Conduct supervised demos.
* Start prospecting.
* Build the initial pipeline.

60 Days

The employee should:

* Independently generate leads.
* Conduct product demonstrations.
* Handle basic objections.
* Manage follow\-ups.
* Start closing customers.
* Handle basic customer support.

90 Days

The employee should be able to independently manage:

**Prospecting → Lead Qualification → Demo → Proposal → Follow\-up → Closure → Onboarding → Basic Support**

and consistently contribute to the assigned revenue target.

19\. Who Should NOT Apply

This role may not be suitable for candidates who:

* Do not want field work.
* Are uncomfortable making cold calls.
* Do not want sales targets.
* Prefer only desk\-based work.
* Are uncomfortable travelling to customers.
* Do not want to interact directly with business owners.
* Have no interest in learning software.
* Expect a purely technical support role.
* Expect a purely marketing role.
* Are uncomfortable with performance\-based incentives.

20\. Why Join DIDC?

* Work with a growing technology company.
* Work on a specialized B2B SaaS product.
* Gain experience across sales, technology and customer success.
* Exposure to HRMS, payroll and workforce\-management technology.
* Direct interaction with business owners and decision\-makers.
* Performance\-based career growth.
* Opportunity to develop into a Senior Sales Executive / Business Development Manager / Customer Success Manager.

21\. Career Path

**Marketing, Sales \& Technical Support Executive**

↓

**Senior Sales \& Customer Success Executive**

↓

**Business Development Executive / Manager**

↓

**Business Development Manager**

↓

**Regional Sales Manager**

Core ObjectiveGenerate business, acquire customers, help them successfully implement Selexic Pay, and build long\-term customer relationships.

This role is expected to become the **local face of Selexic Pay in Pune/Mumbai** and act as the bridge between **DIDC, prospects, customers and the technical team.**

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: On the road

title: SEO Executive
description:
**SEO Executive** 

**Company:** E Care Infoway LLP  
**Location:** Vadodara, Gujarat  
**Job Type:** Full\-time, Permanent  
**Experience:** Freshers \& Experienced Candidates

**Job Summary**

E Care Infoway LLP is looking for a **results\-driven SEO Executive** to join our Digital Marketing team. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of **SEO, AEO, GEO, and PPC**, with the ability to improve website visibility, organic traffic, search rankings, and digital performance.

Freshers with relevant knowledge, certifications, internships, or practical project experience are encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct comprehensive **Website SEO Audits** and identify On\-Page, Off\-Page, and Technical SEO issues.
* Perform **Keyword Research**, competitor analysis, and develop effective keyword strategies.
* Implement On\-Page SEO including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, content optimization, internal linking, and schema markup.
* Execute ethical Off\-Page SEO and link\-building strategies.
* Conduct **Backlink Analysis**, monitor backlink quality, and analyze competitors' backlink profiles.
* Monitor website indexing, crawlability, broken links, redirects, canonical tags, and Core Web Vitals.
* Implement **AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)** strategies for featured snippets, FAQs, PAA, and conversational search.
* Work on **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)** to improve visibility across AI\-powered search and answer engines.
* Create, manage, and optimize **Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook \& Instagram), and LinkedIn Ads** campaigns.
* Monitor campaign metrics including CTR, CPC, CPA, conversions, and ROI.
* Track organic traffic, keyword rankings, backlinks, and campaign performance.
* Prepare weekly and monthly SEO/PPC reports.
* Stay updated with the latest SEO, AEO, GEO, PPC, AI search, and digital marketing trends.

**Required Skills**

* Strong understanding of **On\-Page, Off\-Page, and Technical SEO**.
* Good knowledge of **Website SEO Audit, Keyword Research, Competitor Analysis, and Backlink Analysis**.
